title: Backend Developer, Lund
description:
**Job Title**
-------------

Backend Developer, Lund
**Job Description**
-------------------


*Do you want to work on the core engine of our business? As a Backend Developer, you'll design, build and maintain robust server-side applications that power Axis Communications' core business systems. You'll work on both new features and the modernization of existing platforms, improving performance and reliability at scale. Join us at our headquarters in Lund, Sweden, and help shape the future of smart and secure technology solutions.*

  

**Who is your future team?**

We are a diverse group in terms of nationalities, ages and education, with a strong sense of camaraderie. In our team, you can always find someone to discuss your ideas with, even if you're not working on the same project. There's always someone to have a coffee break or share a laugh with. Word around the corridors at Axis is that our team welcomes everyone, and people feel part of the team from day one.  



  

In this role, you'll have a unique opportunity to work in development where the road from idea to implementation is short. You'll see that your contribution makes a difference, and your colleagues are eager to hear your ideas and put them into practice!  



  

**What you'll do here as Backend Developer**

You'll work on the core engine of our business, improving the systems that our most critical operations rely on. The work combines new feature development with maintaining and modernizing existing systems. Because the role combines backend development with DevOps responsibilities, you'll work across the full application lifecycle.  



  

In this role, you will:


* Develop, test and maintain scalable, reliable backend services and APIs, primarily in Python and PHP
* Manage and troubleshoot our applications and infrastructure in a Linux environment
* Write and maintain Bash scripts to automate deployment, monitoring and operational tasks
* Collaborate with front-end developers and other team members to deliver high-quality features
* Take ownership of features and systems, from concept to deployment and maintenance
* Maintain, refactor and improve existing legacy codebases

Identify and propose new ideas for improving our systems and development processes  

* 

  

**Who are you?**

You're a problem-solver at heart, with a strong sense of responsibility. You take ownership of your work and see it through to completion. You're comfortable navigating different technologies, and your curious mind means you're always eager to learn something new and stay up to date. You enjoy bringing new ideas to the table to solve problems and improve processes. You thrive in a collaborative environment where your ideas are valued, and you're a team player who brings a positive attitude and helps make work fun.  



  

**We'd love to hear that you have:**

* Strong proficiency in backend development with Python and/or PHP.
* Solid experience working within a Linux environment, including command-line proficiency.
* Demonstrable ability to write clean, efficient Bash scripts for automation.
* Experience with databases such as MySQL.

Experience with building and consuming RESTful APIs and queue systems.  

* 

  

**Bonus Points for Experience With:**

* Cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure)
* Ansible
* Monitoring and logging tools
* Debian packaging

Domain driven design  

* 

  

**What Axis has to offer**

We are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact.  



  

Here, you’ll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance — developing solutions used worldwide.  



  

As a fast-growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities. You’ll grow professionally through continuous learning, supported by a collaborative team that values creativity, innovation, and work-life balance.  



  

Our Lund HQ Campus, including the impressive Grenden building, offers a dynamic environment with spaces crafted to encourage collaboration, whether through informal “fika” chats, formal meetings, or after-hours activities. Check it out: Axis HQ  



Your well-being matters to us. We offer a range of benefits, including a company bonus, Friday cake, wellness allowance, health insurance — and even your own Axis bicycle.

  

To learn more about Axis, our innovative products, solutions, and vibrant company culture, explore:


Axis Career Hub


Life at Axis blog


Engineering at Axis blog


Innovation at Axis  



  

**Ready to Act?**

Axis is a company realizing the benefits of a diverse workforce. We know that diversity in groups creates a better working environment and promotes creativity, something that is fundamental for our success. We welcome all applications.  



  

We go through applications continuously so don’t wait – send in your application today!  



  

In case of questions, please reach out to recruiting manager Jenny Johnson, Jenny.Johnson@axis.com


**Type of Employment**
----------------------


Permanent Employment
**Posting End Date**
--------------------


2026-10-28
*Certain roles at Axis require background checks, which means applicable verifications will be done in these recruitments.* *Notice will be provided before we take any action.*

**About Axis Communications**
-----------------------------


We enable a smarter and safer world by creating innovative solutions for improving security and business performance. As a network technology company and industry leader, we offer solutions in video surveillance, access control, intercom, and audio systems, enhanced by intelligent analytics applications.

  

  

With around 6,000 committed employees in over 50 countries, we collaborate with partners worldwide. Together, we thrive in our friendly, open, and collaborative culture and inspire each other to think beyond the expected. United by our commitment to inclusion, diversity, and sustainability, we consistently seek to develop our skills and way of working.

  

  

**Let´s create a smarter and safer world**

  

For more information about Axis, please visit our website www.axis.com .


Listen to Axis Communications Playlist

title: Systemutvecklare
description:
Är du passionerad kring industriell automation, produktionsoptimering och avancerade styrsystem i ett toppmordernt green field projekt med det större syftet att producera stål helt fossilfritt? Vi söker nu en Systemutvecklare som vill ansluta till vårt projektteam och spela en nyckelroll i Luleås nya mini mill-projekt genom alla projektfaser och efter drifttagning arbeta med produktionsutveckling och systemunderhåll.


**Om tjänsten**

Som systemutvecklare agerar du teknisk expert i nära samarbete med process-, automations- och IT/OT-intressenter. Du stödjer projektet från tidig design till driftsättning och acceptanstestning och säkerställer en robust och komplett systemleverans.


Det här är en roll där din expertis verkligen gör skillnad. Ansvarsområdet anpassas efter dina kunskaper och intressen. Du erbjuds ett arbete i ett internationellt industriellt projekt med stor påverkan.


I rollen ingår samarbete med ledande OEM leverantörer och teknologipartners och du får möjligheter till professionell utveckling inom avancerad automation och digitalisering.


Resor ingår som en del i ett internationellt projektarbete.  



**Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden**

* Agera expert inom automation level 2-system genom alla projektfaser.
* Stödja designarbete i nära dialog med produktionsautomation och utrustningsleverantörer för att säkerställa teknisk efterlevnad.
* Delta i systemuppbyggnad, inklusive modellutveckling och systemintegrationer.
* Bidra till testplanering och testutförande som del av ett multidisciplinärt team.
* Ge driftsättningsstöd på plats.
* Utföra acceptanstester tillsammans med kunder och partners.
Efter drifttagning arbeta som systemutvecklare.  
* 

**Om dig**

**För rollen behöver du ha kunskap och praktisk erfarenhet inom några eller flera av följande områden:**

* IT/OT-system, särskilt Automations Level 2 -system som optimerar produktionsprocesser.
* Integration med Level 3-system (MES/MOM) och Level 1-system (PLC-baserad automation).
* Produktionsprocesser och OT/IT för: stålsmältverk, varmvalsverk, kallvalsverk, matematiska modeller, uppställningsberäkningar eller algoritmer och applikationslogik.
* Systemintegrationsteknologier såsom IBM MQ och OPC UA.
* Datamanagement teknologier.
* Kandidatexamen eller masterexamen inom IT/OT är meriterande.

**Vi ser det som meriterande om du har erfarenhet av** :


* Microsoft Windows Server
* SQL Server och PostgreSQL
* Tidsseriedatabaser
* IBA system
* Microsoft BI verktyg
* Visual Studio

**Som person söker vi dig som:**

* Har goda kunskaper i både svenska och engelska i såväl tal som skrift.
* Har en god samarbetsförmåga samt ett proaktivt och lösningsorienterat arbetssätt.
Har viljan att utvecklas och lära dig nytt.  
* 

  

**Vårt erbjudande**

Vi erbjuder ett brett spektrum av uppskattade förmåner till våra medarbetare. Här är några exempel på det:


* Vinstdelning
* Flexibla villkor för arbetstidsförkortning
Friskvårdsbidrag  
* 

**Rekryteringsprocessen**

* Ansök
* Intervju
* Kom och träffa oss
* Hälsoundersökning

Signera  

* 
**Har du några frågor angående tjänsten?**

Kontakta gärna Robert Lundberg, Manager System Development Luleå, robert.lundberg2@ssab.com


*Vi undanbeder oss kontakter från rekryteringsföretag, annonssäljare och liknande beträffande denna annonsering.*

Facklig information lämnas av Akademikerföreningen, Unionen och Ledarna som nås via vår växel på tfn 0920-920 00  



**Några ord från din blivande chef**

Jag som blir din chef heter Robert Lundberg. Jag älskar att arbeta med industriella IT-system och brinner för att digitalisera industrin. Kommer du till oss får du arbeta med engagerade medarbetare och vara med på vår förändringsresa mot en grön framtid. Vi söker dig som vill vara med och bidra till att driva utvecklingsarbetet framåt och du kommer ha stora möjligheter att vara med och påverka våra framtida arbetssätt.

title: .net utvecklare med några års erfarenhet till tillverkande bolag i
description:
Vi söker nu en junior/medior .net utvecklare till kund i Jönköpingstrakten. Uppdragets fokus ligger på utveckling i .net och Azure och är ett s.k. Try & Hire, där du blir uthyrd av Påverka Nu i 12 månader för att sedan bli anställd av kunden. Påverka Nu är inte störst, men hos oss blir du sedd!
  
  

Urval och intervjuer kommer att ske löpande så tveka inte med din ansökan! Om uppdraget Du kommer att arbeta med att utveckla både produkter och interna mjukvaruverktyg inom R&D och arbetet sker i SCRUM-miljö med arbete med andra funktioner och avdelningar. Du kommer att ingå i ett team innehållande utvecklare, lead developers, tekniska projektledare, arkitekter och systemtestare. Du och ditt team har en har en stor frihet att använda den teknik som passar bäst, kreativ frihet med andra ord.
  
  

Du kommer att arbeta med hela produktlivscykeln från design och implementation till testning och verifiering. Teamet utvecklar nya produkter samtidigt som befintliga lösningar underhålls och vidareutvecklas för att möta verksamhetens behov. Rollen är placerad på kontoret och resor till produktionssiter runt om i Europa förekommer. Vem är du?
  
  

Vi söker dig som har en relevant akademisk examen och ett par års erfarenhet av fullstackutveckling med fokus på .net och C#. Vi tror även att du har erfarenhet av backend i form av ASP.NET Core och Blazor samt god kunskap kring Azures molntjänster och infrastruktur. Du har god kommunikativ förmåga i Svenska och Engelska. Meriterande erfarenheter utöver ovan nämna är; WPF, Python-utveckling, MES-system, automatiserad testning, agila arbetssätt och embeddedutveckling.
  
  

Detta är en roll som mixar utveckling och operativt arbete ute på produktionssiter, där du både utvecklar och löser praktiska problem nära produktionen. Som person är du drivande och vågar ta initiativ, prestigelös och kan hugga i där det behövs. För frågor och liknande ta kontakt med Senior Rekryteringskonsult Marcus Rosenblom på marcus.rosenblom@paverka.nu. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!
  
  

Vi rekryterar med både hjärta och hjärna. På Påverka Nu ser vi bortom titlar och fokuserar istället på vad som verkligen skapar resultat: människor, relationer och rätt matchning. Med ett tydligt HR-perspektiv bygger vi broar mellan individens drivkrafter och företagets mål. För oss är en lyckad rekrytering alltid en win-win, där rätt person får växa i rätt miljö, och där företaget stärker både kultur och lönsamhet.
  
  

Vi tror på långsiktighet, tydlighet och att hållbar tillväxt börjar med människan.

title: Senior Android Developer
description:
TeamPilot is looking for a Senior Android Developer. This is a long-term consulting opportunity connected to one of Sweden’s most business-critical digital platforms. The assignment focuses on further development, performance optimization, and innovation within a modern cloud-native environment. You will be part of a cross-functional product team working with high-volume applications where user experience, security, and scalability are central to success.


**The role and technical environment:**



You will contribute to the continued development of a modern Android application built on a cloud-based architecture. A key part of the assignment is integrating the application with distributed backend services while ensuring excellent performance, stability, and security. You will work closely with backend developers, DevOps engineers, and product stakeholders to deliver new functionality and improve existing user journeys. The role also includes implementing real-time features, supporting AI-driven experiences, improving observability, and optimizing application responsiveness in a large-scale production environment.



Android Development in Production Environments  

Kotlin and/or Java  

Android Architecture Patterns (MVVM or equivalent)  

Backend API Integration  

CI/CD and Automated Mobile Testing  

Mobile Security and Secure Authentication Flows  

Performance Optimization and Scalability  

Cloud-Native and Distributed Systems Understanding  

AI-Assisted Development and Testing Practices



Knowledge in Swedish is a requierment


**Who you are:**



We are looking for a senior professional who can independently drive development work in complex environments. You have a structured approach to problem-solving and can balance technical quality with business needs. You are comfortable collaborating across disciplines and translating product requirements into reliable mobile functionality. You proactively identify risks, communicate clearly with stakeholders, and contribute to continuous improvement within the team. You are curious about emerging technologies and understand how AI can enhance both development processes and user experiences.


**Good to know but not must haves:**



Experience with Google Cloud environments  

Real-Time Data and Event-Driven Applications  

Banking, Payments, or Digital Identity Solutions  

AI-Powered User Experiences and Personalization  

Customer-Facing Applications with Large User Bases


**Why take assignments through TeamPilot?**



As an independent contractor with TeamPilot you get access to exciting development projects with Nordic companies without having to spend time on administration. We match your expertise with the right assignment and handle all sales and contract management. You become part of a verified network focused on quality where you retain your full freedom as a independent contractor. The entire collaboration is digital and efficient which allows you to focus your energy on what you do best, the technology. We offer flexible assignments both on-site and off-site.

title: Senior Project Developer
description:
**About us Ingrid was born out of a simple belief:** the energy transition must move faster and work smarter. We're pioneers at the forefront of the global energy transition — pushing boundaries, turning bold ideas into reality, and solving the problems that matter most. The INtelligent GRID of tomorrow needs to absorb and release more power. We develop, build and operate high-performance batteries — the lungs of modern energy infrastructure — enabling a more flexible and resilient energy supply across Europe.
  
  

With 500 MW already deployed across the Nordics and rapid expansion into continental Europe, we manage, optimize and trade both our own assets and those of third parties through our sophisticated tech platform, making every battery — and the entire grid — stronger. Watch our film About the role Do you have a proven track record of bringing high-quality projects to Ready-to-Build — with a deep understanding of what it takes to develop assets that perform over their full lifetime? We are looking for an experienced and hands-on senior project developer to lead the development of our energy storage projects in the Nordics. You will become a senior team member within the project development team, taking full ownership over projects – leveraging your negotiation and execution skills based on a thorough understanding of what makes a project bankable and sound from a financing perspective.
  
  

You thrive with ambiguity and have a proven track record of high-quality project deliveries while working with a wide range of stakeholders (landowners, grid owners, authorities, utilities as well as internal stakeholders –transaction, engineering, procurement). You enjoy the mix of hands-on execution, strategic planning, negotiation, independent work and collaboration. Travel within the Nordics occurs occasionally - traveling to sites for assessments, stakeholder meetings, and ensuring that development milestones are met. You will report to Head of Development.
  
  

**Key tasks and responsibilities:** Drive project development efforts, to secure land, permits, and grid connections to reach RtB status. Negotiate agreements and build strong relationships with key stakeholders. Representing Ingrid at industry events, fostering strategic partnerships and collaborations. Ensure strong financial viability and technical excellence as well as drive continuous improvements in all aspects of development.
  
  

Navigate regulatory processes and stay ahead of market trends to ensure compliance and long-term project viability. Identify and proactively address project risks through strategic planning and problem-solving. Oversee project documentation to ensure compliance with industry standards, and seamless project handover. Work cross-functionally to align technical, financial, and regulatory aspects of projects to drive innovation and contribute to Ingrid’s long-term growth and success.
  
  

**Your work experience:** 10+ years of experience in project development in renewable energy or energy storage – proven track record of projects reaching RtB, experienced with specific Nordic regulatory/permitting framework coupled with financial/bankability knowledge University degree in engineering, business, management or related field. Technical expertise in energy markets and understanding of grid infrastructure. Fluency in English; additional languages are a plus. Your personal skills In addition to relevant work experience, we’re looking for someone with the right personal skills and motivation, and a genuine passion for renewable energy.
  
  

Strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage effectively at all levels. Structured problem-solver who enjoys tackling complex challenges creatively and pragmatically. A relationship-builder who understands counterparties' perspectives and resolves issues with a positive impact. Self-driven and proactive — takes initiative, leads projects independently, and continuously seeks to improve.
  
  

Resilient and collaborative, thriving in fast-paced environments while keeping internal and external stakeholders aligned. Why join us? At Ingrid, we're pioneers at the forefront of the global energy transition — pushing boundaries, turning bold ideas into reality, and solving what matters most. Our culture is built on Bold Impact · Curious Grit · Inspiring Collaboration.
  
  

We believe a thriving organisation runs on trust, growth, and learning from mistakes — and that wellbeing matters as much as work. From team workouts to social activities, we make space to connect, recharge, and thrive together. Next step We’ll make selections on an ongoing basis and finalize the recruitment as soon as we’ve found the perfect match. We look forward to hearing from you!
  
  

/Team Ingrid

title: Mjukvaruutvecklare med intresse för realtidssystem? ﻿
description:
*Vill du påverka och göra skillnad på riktigt? Här bidrar du till att skapa trygghet för människor och samhällen. Det du gör spelar roll.*

  

  

Vi söker nu en utvecklare som vill vara med och vidareutveckla Gripens realtidssystem som är avgörande för flygplanets funktion och operativa förmåga.


I den här rollen arbetar du nära hårdvaran och är med och förbättrar allt från mjukvaruprocesser till verktyg och metodik. Det du utvecklar används i system som bidrar till att försvara Sverige.


Om du drivs av tekniska utmaningar, systemnära utveckling och att arbeta tillsammans med erfarna ingenjörer kan detta vara rollen för dig.

  

  

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!  



### 
**Din Roll**

Du ingår i ett team av engagerade ingenjörer som arbetar med hårdvarunära programmering och inbyggda system. Vi värdesätter öppen kommunikation, kunskapsdelning och balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Rollen innebär stora tekniska utmaningar och möjligheter till personlig utveckling.

  

  

Dina arbetsuppgifter omfattar bland annat:


* Utveckla och testa kod för prestandakritiska inbyggda system.
* Optimera och förbättra kod med fokus på robusthet, effektivitet och lång livslängd.
* Felsöka och analysera avancerade tekniska problem samt ta fram hållbara lösningar.
* Delta aktivt i kodgranskningar och bidra till kontinuerliga förbättringar av kodkvalitet och arbetssätt.
* Samarbeta nära andra utvecklare i ett agilt team
  

  

Vem är du?


Som person arbetar du analytiskt och strukturerat och trivs med att förstå hur saker hänger ihop på djupet. Du är nyfiken, tar gärna till dig ny kunskap och uppskattar möjligheten att utvecklas.


Genom nära samarbete med erfarna kollegor förväntas du bidra till teamet med din kompetens och erfarenhet, men du kommer också att få stöd och möjlighet att lära dig och växa in i din roll. Du kommer vara delaktig genom hela utvecklingscykeln och kunna engagera dig i olika delar av processen, inklusive systemarbete, kravhantering, design, test/verifiering, felsökning och leverans.

  

### 
**Din Profil**

Du har:


* Har minst 3–5 års erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling
* Har djupgående kunskaper och erfarenhet av att arbeta i C och Python
* Har arbetat med mjukvarutestning och kvalitetssäkring i något av dessa språk
* Är van att arbeta i agila team och drivs av samarbete, utveckling och kunskapsdelning
  

  

Det är meriterande om du även har erfarenhet av:


* Utveckling av säkerhetskritiska system
* Realtidsprogrammering och inbyggda system
* Assemblerprogrammering
* Programmering i ADA, Bash och Perl
* Kompilatorkonstruktion
* Git
* Jenkins
  

  

Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap.

  

### 
**Vad du blir en del av**

Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas.


Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med uppdrag att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidrar till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 26,100 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld.


Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här.

title: Backend Developer – Robotics - Husqvarna Group
description:
**Last date to apply:**


03 November 2026
Build the cloud platform behind the world's leading robotic lawn mowers!


At Husqvarna Robotics, you will help develop the cloud services behind hundreds of thousands of connected Husqvarna Automowers™ used by consumers and professionals worldwide.

  

Robotics Digital Backend is a team of around 14 engineers responsible for services that enable positioning, navigation, fleet management and connected experiences for our robotic products. Our solutions run on AWS and play an important role in Husqvarna's continued investment in autonomous and connected products.  

  

Our teams own the full lifecycle of their services, from development to production. Working in a modern DevSecOps environment, you will use cloud-native technologies, AWS, microservices, Docker, and AI-powered solutions while collaborating through code reviews, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.

 **About the role**


As a Backend Developer, you will design, build and operate scalable cloud services that power the next generation of robotic solutions. You will collaborate closely with product owners, app teams, embedded software teams, platform engineers, architects, and AI and data teams to deliver reliable solutions used around the world.  



  

Key responsibilities include:

* Developing backend services primarily in Kotlin and Java
* Building and operating cloud-native solutions on AWS
* Developing distributed systems and microservice-based architectures
* Contributing to CI/CD, observability and production operations
* Driving technical improvements, architecture discussions and engineering best practices

  

At Husqvarna Robotics, you will be part of a team developing products that are used by customers worldwide. You will build solutions that make a real difference, work closely with both the product and its users, and have the opportunity to influence technical decisions and architecture. Combining Robotics, Cloud and AI, you will work with modern technologies at scale and quickly see the impact of your contributions as part of a global leader in robotic lawn care.

 **About you**


You are an experienced developer who enjoys taking ownership, driving initiatives forward and solving complex challenges together with others. You are curious about new technologies, willing to share your knowledge, and motivated by building high-quality solutions. We believe you have:

* Several years of backend software development experience
* A B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering or equivalent experience
* Strong proficiency in Kotlin and/or Java
* Experience building distributed systems and microservice architectures
* Experience working with AWS and modern cloud-based development
* Experience with CI/CD, containers and Infrastructure as Code
* Professional proficiency in English

  

Experience with Quarkus, Gradle, clean architecture principles, Databricks or other data-intensive platforms is considered an advantage.

 **Location**  

Huskvarna. We believe the best ideas happen when we are connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This is consistent across all our global offices and helps us maintain a strong culture, support learning and development, and ensure everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive.

 **Your application**  

Please apply with CV and Cover Letter. We do not accept applications via email due to GDPR regulations. For more questions regarding the position please contact:


Hiring Manager: Gustaf Lagercrantz, gustaf.lagercrantz@husqvarnagroup.com. For more information about the recruitment process, please contact: Recruiter: Gorjana Dubovina,gorjana.dubovina@husqvarnagroup.com.

 *Processing of personal data*


When you send in your application we will process your personal data. In case we choose to proceed with your application, we may ask you to verify your identity before giving you a job offer. For more information about how we process your personal data, who we may share it with and what rights you have, please see our privacy notice.

 **Winning Through Culture**  

We believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters.

  

Our culture is built on three core themes:

title: Software Developer within Energy Management Systems (EMS)
description:
**Software Developer – Energy Management Systems (EMS)**
========================================================


**Hönö, Gothenburg | Berg Propulsion**


Would you like to develop software that contributes to the future of electrified and energy-efficient shipping? We are looking for a **Software Developer within Energy Management Systems (EMS)** who wants to work at the intersection of software, automation, power electronics, and marine technology.


At Berg Propulsion, you will develop solutions that manage and optimize electrical energy and power onboard vessels. You will be part of an experienced development team and have the opportunity to follow your work throughout the entire process – from system design and programming to testing and commissioning onboard.

**About Berg Propulsion**
-------------------------


Berg Propulsion develops propulsion and energy solutions for the global marine industry, with a strong focus on innovation, technical excellence, and more efficient and sustainable shipping.


At our Hönö site, engineers from different disciplines work closely together to develop complete solutions for the vessels of the future. Software is becoming an increasingly important part of our systems, particularly as electrification and the use of battery and energy storage solutions continue to grow.

**About the Role**
------------------


As a Software Developer within Energy Management Systems, you will contribute to the development of our next generation of onboard energy and power management solutions.


Your main focus will be **software development in C and C++ in a Linux environment**, but the role extends well beyond programming. You will work throughout the entire development lifecycle – from requirements, system design, and architecture to implementation, integration, testing, validation, and troubleshooting.


Our systems interface with **battery systems, power electronics, propulsion systems, and other onboard control systems**. This means you will work closely with software, hardware, and the complete system, giving you the opportunity to see how your solutions perform in real-world operation.


You will join a software team of approximately 17 developers with different levels of experience and technical specializations. You will also collaborate closely with engineers within automation, electrical systems, propulsion, and systems engineering, as well as colleagues across R&D, Contract, and Production.


In this role, you will:

* Develop and maintain software for Linux-based Energy Management Systems.
* Design and implement functionality in **C and C++**.
* Help shape how our systems and their functions are designed and operate.
* Develop interfaces and communication with battery systems, power electronics, and other onboard systems.
* Contribute to system architecture and software design.
* Perform software and system testing, verification, and validation.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues.
* Develop and maintain HMI functionality and system interfaces.
* Contribute to test environments, simulation, and automated testing.
* Support integration and commissioning in laboratory environments and onboard vessels.
* Contribute technical expertise to the development of future energy and power management solutions.


The role may involve international travel to shipyards, vessels, customers, and partners in connection with integration, commissioning, and troubleshooting.

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Education**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in **Software Engineering, Computer Science, Automation, Electrical Engineering**, or another relevant technical field.
* We are open to different technical backgrounds – your expertise and understanding of software development and complex systems are what matter most.

### **Technical Knowledge**


We are looking for someone with:

* Strong knowledge of **C and/or C++**.
* Experience developing in a **Linux environment**.
* A good understanding of software design, debugging, and testing.
* Knowledge of version control and modern software development practices.
* Professional proficiency in English.


Experience or knowledge in one or more of the following areas is considered an advantage:

* Energy Management Systems (EMS), Battery Management Systems (BMS), or Power Management Systems (PMS).
* Battery systems, power electronics, converters, or electrical power systems.
* Industrial communication protocols and network-based control systems.
* Embedded or real-time software development.
* Control systems and automation.
* HMI development.
* System and software architecture.
* Simulation, automated testing, or Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL).

### **Experience**

* Experience in professional software development using C and/or C++.
* Experience working in Linux-based development environments.
* Experience with testing, debugging, and problem-solving in software systems.


Experience with **system testing, validation, troubleshooting, marine propulsion systems, vessel automation, or other maritime systems** is considered an advantage.


Ideally, you have a few years of relevant professional experience, but we do not have a specific requirement regarding the number of years. Your technical expertise, potential, and ability to contribute in the role are more important.


Swedish language skills are an advantage but not a requirement.

**Skills and Competencies**
---------------------------


We are looking for someone who is able to:

* Develop robust and reliable software for complex technical systems.
* Understand the interaction between **software, hardware, and complete systems**.
* Analyze and troubleshoot complex technical issues in a structured way.
* Work throughout the entire development lifecycle – from requirements and design to implementation, testing, and integration.
* Take ownership of technical topics and drive them forward independently.
* Collaborate across engineering disciplines and contribute to shared technical solutions.
* Share knowledge and communicate technical topics clearly and effectively.

**Personal Qualities**
----------------------


To succeed in this role, we believe you are:

* **Analytical and solution-oriented**, with a genuine interest in understanding why problems occur and finding sustainable solutions.
* **Independent and accountable**, with the ability to take initiative and drive your work forward.
* **Communicative and collaborative**, and comfortable working with people across different disciplines, backgrounds, and areas of expertise.
* **Structured and goal-oriented**, with the ability to take technical challenges from problem to solution.
* **Curious and technically minded**, with an interest in understanding the complete system and how its different components interact.
* **A team player** who values knowledge sharing and contributes to the development of the team as a whole.


You enjoy having ownership and freedom in your work while seeing collaboration as a natural part of developing strong technical solutions.

**What We Offer**
-----------------


At Berg Propulsion, you will have the opportunity to develop software that has a direct impact on real systems onboard vessels. You can follow your work from the first technical decisions and lines of code, through testing and integration, all the way to a system operating in the field.


You will be part of an experienced development team with both junior and senior colleagues, in a culture where **collaboration, technical curiosity, and knowledge sharing** are important parts of how we work.


The role offers a high degree of ownership and the opportunity to influence technical solutions and future systems. You will work in an environment where **software, automation, electrical engineering, energy systems, and marine technology** come together to solve real-world technical challenges.

**Contact Details and Practical Information**
---------------------------------------------

**Location:** Hönö, Gothenburg  

**Hiring Manager:** Hanna Hvarfven  

**Email:** Hanna.Hvarfven@bergpropulsion.com


If you have any questions about the position or would like to learn more about what it is like to work with us, you are very welcome to get in touch.

**Applications will be reviewed, and interviews held, on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. We look forward to hearing from you!**

title: Software Developer – Propulsion Control Systems
description:
**Software Developer – Propulsion Control Systems**
===================================================


**Hönö, Gothenburg | Berg Propulsion**


Would you like to develop software that controls and monitors marine propulsion systems? We are looking for a **Software Developer within Propulsion Control Systems** who wants to work closely with both hardware and advanced control systems for the future of shipping.


At Berg Propulsion, you will develop embedded software for our propulsion systems and have the opportunity to follow your work throughout the entire process – from system design and programming to testing and real-world operation onboard vessels.

**About Berg Propulsion**
-------------------------


Berg Propulsion develops propulsion and energy solutions for the global marine industry, with a strong focus on innovation, technical excellence, and more efficient and sustainable shipping.

Software and control systems are becoming increasingly important parts of our propulsion solutions and play a central role in system functionality, performance, and reliability.

**About the Role**
------------------


As a Software Developer within Control Systems, you will work with improvements of our current platform as well as contribute to the development of our next generation of control systems for Berg Propulsion’s propulsion solutions.


Your main focus will be **embedded development in C, with software running directly on microcontrollers in a bare-metal environment**. The software interacts closely with sensors, I/O, communication interfaces, and other onboard control systems.


The role extends well beyond programming. You will work throughout the entire development lifecycle – from requirements, system design, and architecture to implementation, integration, testing, and troubleshooting.


As the software directly controls physical equipment, you will work closely with both the hardware and the propulsion system. This gives you the opportunity to follow your software from development and testing in a laboratory environment all the way to a propulsion system operating onboard a vessel.


You will be part of our software team and collaborate closely with engineers within areas such as automation, electronics, and electrical integration. The team also includes developers working with Energy Management Systems, Digital Solutions, and other software solutions.


In this role, you will:

* Develop and maintain software for marine propulsion control systems.
* Design and implement software, primarily in **Embedded C**.
* Develop and maintain interfaces with sensors, I/O, and other onboard systems.
* Work with communication interfaces and industrial and marine communication protocols.
* Contribute to system architecture and the design of new solutions.
* Perform software and system testing, verification, and troubleshooting.
* Contribute to test environments, simulation, and automated testing.
* Collaborate across engineering disciplines to develop complete propulsion control systems.
* Contribute technical expertise to the roadmap and architecture of future control systems.


The role may involve international travel to shipyards, vessels, customers, and partners in connection with integration, commissioning, and troubleshooting.

------------------

### **Education**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in **Software Engineering, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, Electronics, Automation**, or another relevant technical field.
* We are open to different technical backgrounds – what matters most is your expertise and understanding of embedded development and hardware-near systems.

### **Technical Knowledge**


We are looking for someone with:

* Strong programming skills in **Embedded C**, as well as knowledge of C++ and Python.
* Experience working with **microcontrollers and low-level development**.
* An understanding of embedded software architecture.
* An understanding of debugging and testing embedded software.
* Knowledge of version control and modern software development practices.
* The ability to understand the interaction between software and physical hardware.


Experience or knowledge in one or more of the following areas is considered an advantage:

* Real-time systems and deterministic control systems.
* **CAN, CANopen, Modbus, and Ethernet**, or other industrial communication protocols.
* Safety-critical or other embedded systems with high reliability requirements.
* Bootloaders and firmware update mechanisms.
* Simulation and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing.
* Marine propulsion, vessel automation, or other maritime systems.

### **Experience**

* Experience in embedded software development.
* Experience working with microcontrollers and low-level software.
* Experience with debugging, testing, and problem-solving in embedded systems.


Experience with **system testing, simulation, HIL testing, industrial communication protocols, or marine control and propulsion systems** is considered an advantage.


Ideally, you have a few years of relevant professional experience, but we do not have a specific requirement regarding the number of years. Your technical expertise, potential, and ability to contribute in the role are more important.

**Skills and Competencies**
---------------------------


We are looking for someone who is able to:

* Develop **robust and reliable embedded software** for systems where correct behaviour, predictability, and performance are critical.
* Understand what happens throughout the entire chain – from **software code to the physical equipment being controlled**.
* Analyse and troubleshoot issues at the intersection of software and hardware.
* Work throughout the entire development lifecycle – from requirements and design to implementation, testing, and integration.
* Approach complex technical problems in a structured way and drive them through to resolution.
* Collaborate across engineering disciplines to develop complete control systems.
* Communicate technical topics clearly and share knowledge with others in the team.

----------------------


To succeed in this role, we believe you are:

* **Analytical and solution-oriented**, with a genuine interest in understanding how both software and hardware work.
* **Independent and accountable**, with the ability to take initiative and drive your work forward.
* **Communicative and collaborative**, and comfortable working with people across different disciplines, backgrounds, and areas of expertise.
* **Structured and goal-oriented**, particularly when troubleshooting complex technical issues.
* **Curious and technically minded**, with a desire to understand the entire chain from code to physical operation.
* **A team player** who values knowledge sharing and contributes to the development of the team as a whole.


You enjoy having ownership and working independently, while seeing collaboration with other developers and engineering disciplines as a natural part of developing robust and reliable systems.

**What We Offer**
-----------------


At Berg Propulsion, you will have the opportunity to develop **software that directly controls real propulsion equipment**. You can follow your work from the first lines of code and laboratory testing all the way to a system operating onboard a vessel.


You will be part of an experienced development organization where **software, electronics, automation, and marine propulsion technology** come together to solve complex technical challenges.


The role offers a high degree of ownership and the opportunity to influence both technical solutions and future systems. You will work alongside other software developers, including colleagues within Energy Management Systems, giving you the opportunity to work closely with a wide range of technologies and systems across the vessel.

**Job Description:**

**The opportunity**  

  

At **Hitachi Energy** our purpose is advancing a sustainable energy future for all. We bring power to our homes, schools, hospitals and factories. Join us and work with fantastic people, while learning and developing yourself on projects that have a real impact to our communities and society. Bring your passion, bring your energy, and be part of a global team that appreciates a simple truth: **Diversity + Collaboration = Great Innovation**

Imagine waking up every day to develop a system that is essential to create a sustainable and reliable energy system for societies and people around the globe.  



MACH is the real-time, high-performance control system platform we, in Technology and Solution Development at Hitachi Energy, develop in-house. The MACH platform is needed to connect offshore wind power, create synthetic inertia, connect energy systems over long distances and create a robust electricity grid prepared for the future.  



The MACH system comprises of hundreds of circuit boards covering measurement, processing, semiconductor controls and the digital signal interface used in our power electronics solutions. For the bespoke hardware, we also develop software, system solutions, engineering tools and configuration tools. To effectively drive innovation, we develop the MACH platform in agile, cross-functional teams.  



In the Embedded Systems department, we are now looking for enthusiastic FPGA designers who would like to strengthen our team and to grow together on our journey towards a sustainable energy future. This position is located in Ludvika or Västerås.  



**How you'll make an impact**

* As a FPGA Design Engineer, you will work on complex functions where high performance, availability and robustness are key elements. Example designs are proprietary high speed optical communication protocols, high-speed buses, EtherCAT, data collection, filters and functions for HVDC control and protection
* We work in a modern environment where both rapid prototyping and productification takes place. To our help we have modern tools and labs for the complete development cycle, from early prototype testing to final system verification
* We have an innovative spirit, and nothing is impossible for us to solve. The team works with challenging tasks in an agile set-up. High level of collaboration is required with all stakeholders where speed of response is the key
You will be living Hitachi Energy core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business  
* 

**Your background**

* You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical engineering, Electronics engineering or another related field, or have equivalent work experience
* Experience in FPGA design using VHDL, Verilog
* Using Modelsim for simulation of FPGA designs
* General knowledge about HW design
* Experience with tools like Xilinx ISE, Vivado, Lattice Diamond, Intel, MicroSemi or similar
* Capable of writing technical documentation such as Requirement Specs, Design Specs, Verification Specs etc.
* Knowledge in ECAT communication
* Advantageous to have Basic Python knowledge
Proficiency in English is a must while Swedish is an added advantage  
* 

**More about us**

Are you ready for a new exciting challenge? Does the above description sound like you? Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so don’t delay – apply today! We are hiring for multiple positions.  



We are interested to learn more about you and what you can contribute with so don’t hesitate to apply even though you don’t meet all requirements. A team with great cooperation and with diverse backgrounds is waiting for you to join!

description:

We are a leading SaaS company driving the digital transformation of the construction industry through innovative technology, making it safer, more productive and more sustainable. Through smart platforms and data-driven solutions, we help our customers gain better control of their workforce, sites and assets – while contributing to a more sustainable development in one of the world’s largest industries.


We are looking for **experienced .NET Developers** who want to solve meaningful technical problems and help us continue developing our Workforce Management solutions for the construction industry.  

  

**About the role**


Our products help construction companies manage their workforce and processes on construction sites. Your work will contribute to better control, compliance, safety and efficiency.


You will join our tech team in Jönköping and work with three of our Workforce Management products used in the construction industry across the Nordics.


The role combines new development with modernization and maintenance of established products.


You will:

* Develop and maintain our products using C# and .NET.
* Build backend functionality and APIs.
* Work with SQL and data-driven applications.
* Develop new functionality and modernize existing solutions.
* Contribute to technical and architectural decisions.
* Write maintainable, well-tested code.
* Work with analysis, estimation and technical documentation.
* Review code and help improve our development practices.
* Support and mentor other developers.

 **Who you are**


We value developers who can analyse problems independently, understand the broader context and compare different technical solutions and their trade-offs. You take ownership of the code you develop and are comfortable learning new technologies when needed.


You have at least 5 years of professional software development experience and strong skills in:

* C# .NET
* Object-Oriented Design
* SQL
* Source Code Quality
* Software Development Lifecycle
* Analysis and Modelling, UML
* Unit Testing
* Estimation
* Documentation


You also have good knowledge of:

* ASP.NET Web API, RESTful APIs
* Web development, HTML, JS, CSS
* IIS
* Architectural skills


Experience with any of the following is an advantage, but not a requirement:

* AI-assisted software development
* Microsoft SQL Server
* Microsoft Entity Framework
* ASP.NET Web Forms
* Angular
* TypeScript
* JIRA
* TFS


English is required. Good proficiency in Swedish is an advantage.

##### **What we offer**


At Infobric, technology, innovation and people who want to make a real impact come together. You’ll have the opportunity to grow, challenge established ways of working and help shape the future of construction.


As an Infobric employee, you also have access to benefits including:

* 25 days of annual leave plus public holidays
* Pension and insurance
* Wellness benefits and activities
* Parental leave support
* Flexible working
* Social activities with colleagues

##### **Interested?**


We are continuously interested in getting in touch with experienced .NET developers who could be a good fit for our team.


If your experience matches the profile and you're interested in developing software for the construction industry, we'd like to hear from you.

title: R&D Engineer - FPGA Developer
description:
**Location:**

Ludvika, Dalarna County, Sweden
**Job ID:**

R0130392
**Date Posted:**

2026-05-21
**Company Name:**

HITACHI ENERGY SWEDEN AB
**Profession (Job Category):**

Engineering & Science
**Job Schedule:**

Full time
**Remote:**

No
**Job Description:**

**The opportunity**  

  

At **Hitachi Energy** our purpose is advancing a sustainable energy future for all. We bring power to our homes, schools, hospitals and factories. Join us and work with fantastic people, while learning and developing yourself on projects that have a real impact to our communities and society. Bring your passion, bring your energy, and be part of a global team that appreciates a simple truth: **Diversity + Collaboration = Great Innovation**

Imagine waking up every day to develop a system that is essential to create a sustainable and reliable energy system for societies and people around the globe.  



MACH is the real-time, high-performance control system platform we, in Technology and Solution Development at Hitachi Energy, develop in-house. The MACH platform is needed to connect offshore wind power, create synthetic inertia, connect energy systems over long distances and create a robust electricity grid prepared for the future.  



The MACH system comprises of hundreds of circuit boards covering measurement, processing, semiconductor controls and the digital signal interface used in our power electronics solutions. For the bespoke hardware, we also develop software, system solutions, engineering tools and configuration tools. To effectively drive innovation, we develop the MACH platform in agile, cross-functional teams.  



In the Embedded Systems department, we are now looking for enthusiastic FPGA designers who would like to strengthen our team and to grow together on our journey towards a sustainable energy future. This position is located in Ludvika or Västerås.  



**How you'll make an impact**

* As a FPGA Design Engineer, you will work on complex functions where high performance, availability and robustness are key elements. Example designs are proprietary high speed optical communication protocols, high-speed buses, EtherCAT, data collection, filters and functions for HVDC control and protection
* We work in a modern environment where both rapid prototyping and productification takes place. To our help we have modern tools and labs for the complete development cycle, from early prototype testing to final system verification
* We have an innovative spirit, and nothing is impossible for us to solve. The team works with challenging tasks in an agile set-up. High level of collaboration is required with all stakeholders where speed of response is the key
You will be living Hitachi Energy core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business  
* 

**Your background**

* You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical engineering, Electronics engineering or another related field, or have equivalent work experience
* Experience in FPGA design using VHDL, Verilog
* Using Modelsim for simulation of FPGA designs
* General knowledge about HW design
* Experience with tools like Xilinx ISE, Vivado, Lattice Diamond, Intel, MicroSemi or similar
* Capable of writing technical documentation such as Requirement Specs, Design Specs, Verification Specs etc.
* Knowledge in ECAT communication
* Advantageous to have Basic Python knowledge
Proficiency in English is a must while Swedish is an added advantage  
* 

**More about us**

Are you ready for a new exciting challenge? Does the above description sound like you? Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so don’t delay – apply today! We are hiring for multiple positions.  



We are interested to learn more about you and what you can contribute with so don’t hesitate to apply even though you don’t meet all requirements. A team with great cooperation and with diverse backgrounds is waiting for you to join!  



More information: Recruiting Manager, Sonia Sarikhani, sonia.sarikhani@hitachienergy.com, will answer your questions about the position. Union representatives - Sveriges Ingenjörer: Mikael Hjort, +46 107-38 29 86; Unionen: Fredrik Holmgren, +46 107-38 21 85; Ledarna: Frank Hollstedt, +46 107-38 29 12. All other questions can be directed to Talent Acquisition Partner Tomasz Szawica, tomasz.szawica@hitachienergy.com  



Hitachi Energy is a global technology leader that is advancing a sustainable energy future for all. We serve customers in the utility, industry and infrastructure sectors with innovative solutions and services across the value chain. Together with customers and partners, we pioneer technologies and enable the digital transformation required to accelerate the energy transition towards a carbon-neutral future. We are advancing the world’s energy system to become more sustainable,#flexible#and secure whilst balancing social, environmental and economic value. Hitachi Energy has a proven track record and unparalleled installed base in more than 140 countries. Headquartered in Switzerland, we employ around 40,000 people in 90 countries and generate business volumes of approximately $10 billion USD. www.hitachienergy.com

 På Sveriges Radio är vi cirka 350 medarbetare som inte bara jobbar med att göra radio, vi har även egen ljudteknik och bygger dessutom de flesta av våra produktionsverktyg internt. Det innebär tekniska utmaningar men också stora möjligheter att påverka. Du får sätta dig in i helheten, navigera mellan olika beroenden och omsätta verksamhetens behov till lösningar som används brett. Observera att denna rekrytering kräver arbetsprov på plats och vi söker dig som bor i Stockholm.
   

  

**Vidare om rollen**
 Som backendutvecklare i teamet Publicera ingår du i ett team där vi tillsammans bygger en distribuerad, green-field applikation enligt moderna Microsoft‑standarder. Applikationen är kärnan i Sveriges Radios digitala publiceringsförmåga och ställer höga krav på moduläritet, robusthet och portabilitet med hög kvalitet i fokus.
   

  

 Vi har även väletablerade arbetssätt, verktyg och forum för vår AI-utveckling där du kan vara med och påverka hur vi arbetar med tekniken framåt.
   

  

**Vår Tech Stack**
 Frontend
   

  

* React 19 med React Compiler, TypeScript, Micro frontends med ett delat komponentbibliotek. Vi använder Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui och Sveriges Radios egna designsystem.


 Backend
   

  

* .NET 10 (C#), OAuth med Azure som IdentityProvider, CodeQL, Penntest, Neuvector, CDN & reverse proxy lösningar, automatiserade flöden GitHub Actions, TestContainers, Argo & Kargo, REST Api (Https), SignalR(websockets), RabbitMQ(Masstransit), Datahantering: PostgresSQL, S3 objektlagring, Redis


 Arkitektur
   

  

* En distribuerad applikation orkestrerad med .NET Aspire byggt på principer från Domain Driven Design samt CQRS. 7st apier(inklusive BFF).


**Vi söker dig som har**
* Ett genuint intresse för nyheter, journalistik och samhällsfrågor
* Relevant erfarenhet av produktutveckling för publika digitala tjänster
* Minst 5 års erfarenhet av backendutveckling
* .NET erfarenhet
* Vana att arbeta datadrivet och användarcentrerat
* God förmåga att uttrycka dig väl på svenska, både i tal och skrift


 Det är meriterande med erfarenhet från mediebranschen och erfarenhet av att arbeta i tvärfunktionella produktutvecklingsteam.
   

  

**Frågor och kontaktuppgifter**
 Det här är en tillsvidareanställning med 6 månaders inledande provanställning. Notera att Tjänsten är på heltid, med placering i Radiohuset på Gärdet i Stockholm. Frågor om tjänsten besvaras av gruppchef Helena Magnusson, helena.magnusson@sr.se. Vill du komma i kontakt med facket så hittar du alla fackliga kontakter här.
   

  

 Skicka in din ansökan senast den 31 oktober men rekryterar löpande under processens gång. Sveriges Radio krigsplacerar personal med anställning som överstiger 6 månader.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Backend) - Global Marts
description:
**About Wolt**
 At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.
   

  

 Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.
   

  

 Who We Are
   

  

 Global Marts builds the technology behind DoorDash's own grocery and retail operations across DashMart, Wolt Market, and Deliveroo Hop.
   

  

 Our systems decide what products our stores stock, how much inventory to purchase, which vendors to source from, how warehouses execute orders, and what prices customers see.
   

  

 We build everything from forecasting and replenishment systems to vendor management, warehouse execution, labor scheduling, space optimization, and pricing. Our in-house forecasting platform has replaced third-party solutions and now powers production globally.
   

  

 This isn't a traditional CRUD backend environment. Much of our work involves designing new systems that solve complex operational problems at global scale.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll work primarily with Go or Kotlin and take end-to-end ownership of production systems and complex technical initiatives.
   

  

 You'll:
   

  

* Design, build, and operate backend systems that support inventory, purchasing, warehouse operations, pricing, and fulfillment.
* Own technical solutions from problem definition and design through implementation, deployment, monitoring, and production operation.
* Work on data-heavy systems where software engineering meets forecasting, optimization, and operational decision-making.
* Turn complex and sometimes ambiguous business problems into pragmatic, scalable technical solutions.
* Make and influence architectural decisions, balancing scalability, reliability, development speed, and long-term maintainability.
* Collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, data scientists, and operations teams to shape solutions and technical direction.
* Improve the reliability, observability, scalability, and operational excellence of the systems you own.
* Support and raise the engineering standards of the team through technical discussions, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.
* Use AI-assisted development tools effectively while applying strong engineering judgment to validate their output, improve development velocity, and identify opportunities where AI can create additional leverage.


 How We Work
   

  

* Autonomy & Ownership: Engineers have end-to-end responsibility for their services, from design and implementation to production and on-call.
* Collaboration: Architecture and technical direction are shaped together. Senior engineers are expected to contribute actively to decisions and help others arrive at strong solutions.
* Scalability & Simplicity: We value pragmatic solutions that solve today's problems while providing a sustainable foundation for tomorrow.
* Impact: We work closely with Product, Data Science, and Operations, connecting technical decisions directly to real-world retail and operational outcomes.


 Our Tech Stack
   

  

 Our primary backend languages are Go and Kotlin.
   

  

 We also use Kafka, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Snowflake, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, gRPC, GitHub Actions, and modern cloud infrastructure.
   

  

 You don't need experience with every technology in our stack. We're more interested in strong backend and distributed systems fundamentals and your ability to learn and make sound technical decisions.
   

  

 Our Humble Expectations
   

  

 We're looking for engineers who:
   

  

* Have strong experience designing, building, and operating production backend systems.
* Have professional experience with Go, Kotlin, or another modern backend language.
* Have experience owning services end-to-end, including design, implementation, deployment, monitoring, reliability, and production operations.
* Have strong knowledge of backend and distributed systems fundamentals, including APIs, databases, asynchronous processing, failure handling, testing, and observability.
* Are comfortable working with data-heavy systems and technologies such as Kafka, Snowflake, or similar streaming and data infrastructure.
* Can navigate ambiguous problems, break them into actionable steps, make appropriate technical trade-offs, and deliver incrementally.
* Can influence technical decisions beyond their immediate tasks and collaborate effectively with engineers and cross-functional partners.
* Communicate technical concepts and decisions clearly and concisely.
* Use AI-assisted development tools effectively in their everyday engineering workflow while critically evaluating generated solutions and taking full ownership of the resulting code and technical decisions.
* Look for opportunities to use AI to improve engineering productivity and solve problems more effectively, while understanding where human engineering judgment remains essential.


**Nice to Have**
 Experience in one or more of the following is a plus:
   

  

* Forecasting, optimization, scheduling, recommendation, or decisioning systems.
* Grocery, retail, logistics, supply chain, or warehouse technology.
* ERP, vendor management, procurement, or workforce management integrations.
* Replacing third-party or legacy platforms with internally built systems.
* High-throughput event-driven or streaming architectures.


 Why Join Us?
   

  

 You'll help build the technology that powers DoorDash's global grocery and retail business, solving complex operational challenges across inventory, forecasting, fulfillment, pricing, and supply chain.
   

  

 You'll have significant ownership over the systems you build and the opportunity to influence technical direction while working closely with experienced engineers, product managers, data scientists, and operations teams across multiple markets.
   

  

 📍 This role is based in our tech hub in Helsinki or Stockholm. We work in distributed teams, but may not be able to support fully remote work or relocation.
   

  

 Next Steps
   

  

 We're reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so don't wait to apply. We'll get back to you as soon as possible.
   

  

 You can read more about our recruitment process here.
   

  

 Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
   

  

 We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.
   

  

*Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .*

title: .Net utvecklare
description:
Hej! Jag heter Emelie 👋 och är konsultchef på Softronic. Jag letar just nu efter erfarna .NET-utvecklare som kombinerar stark teknisk kompetens med förmågan att förstå kunden och problemet vi faktiskt ska lösa.
 



 Hos oss får du arbeta hands-on med allt från modernisering av stora verksamhetskritiska .NET-system till allt från nyutveckling i Azure – och samtidigt påverka arkitektur, tekniska vägval och hur vi utvecklar mjukvara.
 



**Det här kommer du att göra** 



* Utveckla moderna och långsiktigt hållbara lösningar i C# och .NET
* Arbeta med systemdesign, arkitektur, API och integrationer
* Lösa komplexa problem tillsammans med kund och team
* Använda AI-verktyg aktivt i utvecklingsarbetet – från analys och implementation till test och kvalitetssäkring
* Bidra till hög kvalitet och bra leveranser genom hela utvecklingsprocessen
* Dela med dig av din erfarenhet och bidra till att både team och kollegor utvecklas



 Teknikstacken varierar mellan våra uppdrag, men du kommer ofta möta moderna versioner av .NET, Azure, CI/CD, integrationer och distribuerade system.
 



**Vi tror att du** 



* Har minst 6 års erfarenhet av professionell .NET-utveckling
* Är riktigt trygg i C# och .NET
* Har erfarenhet av större eller komplexa system
* Har ett stort teknikintresse, håller dig uppdaterad och är nyfiken på nya tekniker, verktyg och arbetssätt
* Använder AI som en naturlig del av ditt utvecklingsarbete
* Kan självständigt driva tekniska frågor och föra arbetet framåt
* Är bekväm i kunddialog och kan förklara tekniska vägval, ställa rätt frågor och utmana när du ser en bättre lösning
* Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska



 Bonus om du har erfarenhet av Azure, cloud-native, eventdriven arkitektur, tekniskt ledarskap eller säkerhets- och verksamhetskritiska system.
 



**Varför Softronic?** 




 För att du får vara utvecklare på riktigt – men sällan bara kodare.
 



 Vi arbetar nära våra kunder och ofta med verksamhetskritiska system som behöver fungera, utvecklas och hålla över tid. Som senior utvecklare får du både djupdyka tekniskt och påverka lösningen, från tekniska vägval till hur den skapar värde hos kunden.
 



 Softronic är stort nog för att ta ansvar för hela team och långsiktiga åtaganden, men tillräckligt nära för att du som individ ska kunna påverka. Och med många samhällsviktiga kunder får du möjlighet att bygga teknik som faktiskt används och gör skillnad.
 



 Självklart har vi också kollektivavtal, tjänstepension, friskvårdsbidrag och möjlighet till kompetensutveckling.
 



**Nyfiken?** 




 Då vill jag gärna prata med dig.
 



 Du behöver inte kunna bocka av varenda punkt ovan. Om du är en erfaren .NET-utvecklare som känner igen dig i beskrivningen – skicka in din ansökan eller hör av dig så berättar jag mer.
 



 / Emelie Mirhagen
 



 Konsultchef, Softronic

title: Backend Software Engineer (Node.js) - UniFi Talk
description:
**About Ubiquiti**
 At Ubiquiti Inc., we create technology platforms for Businesses, Smart Homes, and Internet Service Providers, driven by our goal to connect everyone, everywhere. To date, Ubiquiti has shipped over 100 million devices worldwide, from ISP networking products to next generation of IT solutions. Our growth is made possible by the dedicated team of hundreds behind the scenes. From software developers and product managers to designers and strategists, Team UI is driven to achieve our common goal: Rethinking IT. At Ubiquiti, you’ll heighten your potential and broaden your horizons - all while shaping the future of connectivity.
   

  

**Join forces with us on our mission to build a better IT industry. We are currently looking for a highly skilled Backend Software Engineer (Node.js) to join our team in Stockholm, Sweden.**
***Please note that applicants must live in Sweden and hold a valid work permit at the time of application to be considered for this role.***
**Team**
 You will join the UniFi Talk team that builds Ubiquiti's VoIP/phone system inside the UniFi ecosystem. UniFi Talk gives users desk phones plus the UniFi Talk application running on compatible UniFi consoles. This role is well suited to an engineer who enjoys solving complex product and platform problems, improving reliability, and working across backend, embedded, cloud, and application boundaries.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design, build, and maintain backend services in Node.js and TypeScript.
* Develop secure, scalable, and maintainable APIs and service workflows.
* Contribute to architecture and code design decisions across the team.
* Review code and help maintain strong engineering standards, release quality, and development workflows.
* Investigate production issues, debug complex failures, and ship robust fixes.
* Work closely with embedded, web, mobile, product, and design teams to deliver platform capabilities used across the UniFi ecosystem.
* Improve the reliability, observability, and developer experience of the services you work on.


**Requirements**
* 5+ years of professional experience with Node.js and TypeScript.
* 3+ years of experience working with SQL databases such as PostgreSQL.
* Solid knowledge of VoIP protocols - SIP, RTP, WebRTC, SDP, RTCP, TCP, UDP.
* Experience with configuring PBXs.
* Experience building software for connected devices, infrastructure products, networking systems, or similarly complex environments.
* Good understanding of web security, including OWASP, browser security fundamentals, and OAuth.
* Strong debugging skills and experience with defensive programming.
* Professional experience with Git, Unix/Linux, and Docker-based environments.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of technical work.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* High proficiency in English, both written and spoken.


**Nice To Have**
* Experience with Rust or Go.
* Experience with gRPC.
* Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, and build pipelines.
* Practical experience using AI tools and LLMs to improve engineering productivity and quality.


**Benefits**
* Competitive compensation.
* Occupational pension, health insurance, private health insurance, life insurance and work-injury insurance, and wellness allowance (5000 SEK).
* Flexible work hours and a hybrid work model.
* Access to all the latest Ubiquiti products for home use.


***Please note that a background check will be conducted in the final stage of the recruitment process***
