* 5+ years of professional experience with Node.js and TypeScript.
* 3+ years of experience working with SQL databases such as PostgreSQL.
* Experience building software for connected devices, infrastructure products, networking systems, or similarly complex environments.
* Good understanding of web security, including OWASP, browser security fundamentals, and OAuth.
* Strong debugging skills and experience with defensive programming.
* Professional experience with Git, Unix/Linux, and Docker-based environments.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of technical work.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* High proficiency in English, both written and spoken.


**Nice To Have**
* Experience with Rust or Go.
* Experience with gRPC.
* Experience with WebRTC.
* Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, and build pipelines.
* Practical experience using AI tools and LLMs to improve engineering productivity and quality.


**Benefits**
* Competitive compensation
* Occupational pension, health insurance, private health insurance, life insurance and work-injury insurance, and wellness allowance (5000 SEK)
* Flexible work hours and a hybrid work model
* Access to all the latest Ubiquiti products for home use


***Please note that a background check will be conducted in the final stage of the recruitment process***

title: Frontend Engineer
description:
**Introducing evroc**
 At evroc, we are building a secure, sovereign, and sustainable hyperscale cloud to reimagine the digital future of Europe. By joining our company, you have an exciting opportunity to contribute to the development of next-generation cloud services. We are seeking intellectually curious and highly motivated team members who are ready to embrace the thrilling challenge of building the first European-owned hyperscale cloud.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Stockholm
   

  

**Job type:** 
 Permanent position
   

  

**Join the Pioneers**
 As a Frontend Engineer on the Think team, you will shape the user experience of roc, enterprise AI you can trust with your data. roc delivers sovereign AI to European organizations that demand the highest levels of security and compliance, running on our own cloud and inference platform.
   

  

 You will help take roc beyond the chat window: building interactive artifacts alongside conversations, an embeddable assistant that organizations can integrate into their own sites, and experiences that bring roc into the tools people already use, from internal systems and knowledge bases to team chat.
   

  

 Along the way, you will influence our application architecture and engineering culture, building AI products where usability, trust, and transparency are part of the design from the start.
   

  

**What You'll Tackle**
* Design and build responsive, intuitive interfaces for enterprise AI chat, retrieval, and tool use.
* Build user experiences for streaming responses, background tool execution, and real-time state changes.
* Develop new ways for users to interact with roc beyond the traditional chat interface.
* Work closely with backend and platform engineers to ensure seamless integration across the product.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering practices that improve quality and maintainability.
* Build reliable frontend systems using testing frameworks such as Playwright and Vitest.
* Explore and apply new technologies, frameworks, and tools that improve both development workflows and user experience.


**Skills We Value**
* Typically 5+ years of professional experience in frontend development.
* Strong experience with modern JavaScript frameworks; familiarity with Svelte or SvelteKit is valued but not required.
* Strong knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, and modern frontend development practices.
* Experience building interfaces for LLM-based products, including streaming responses, markdown rendering, and conversational UX, is a plus.
* Experience with testing frameworks such as Playwright, Vitest, or similar.
* Proficiency with Git and modern collaborative development workflows.
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to both functionality and user experience.
* Ability to work closely with engineers, designers, and other stakeholders in a collaborative environment.


**Why Join evroc?**
 We offer a competitive salary and an equity package to attract the best talent. Come join us to help build the next generation cloud!
   

  

 At evroc, diversity is our strength. We champion an inclusive environment where every background - ethnicity, age, gender identity, beliefs, and culture - is celebrated.
   

  

 Applicants must possess a valid work permit.

title: Senior systemutvecklare .Net, Stockholm
description:
**Jobbeskrivning**
 Vill du att din kod och dina tekniska beslut ska bidra till ett mer effektivt och fungerande samhälle? Hos oss utvecklar du lösningar inom exempelvis vård, energi och telekom, där systemen är affärs- och verksamhetskritiska.
   

  

 I rollen som senior .NET-utvecklare arbetar du som konsult i långsiktiga uppdrag där du kombinerar utveckling med tekniskt ledarskap. Du tar ett starkt tekniskt ansvar i lösningen, från design och implementation till vidareutveckling, och bidrar aktivt i dialogen med kund. Du förväntas kunna analysera och förbättra befintliga lösningar, fatta tekniska beslut, sätta riktning i teamet och säkerställa att lösningar byggs med kvalitet, säkerhet och långsiktighet i fokus. Rollen innebär också att du delar kunskap, stöttar kollegor och driver förbättringar i arbetssätt, teknik och leverans.
   

  

 Tekniskt arbetar du brett genom hela stacken, backend i .NET, C#, ASP.NET Core och API:er, i kombination med databaser och moderna frontend-ramverk som React eller Angular. Våra uppdrag bedrivs i agila team tillsammans med utvecklare, arkitekter, testare och verksamhet, där samarbete och gemensamt ansvar är centralt.
   

  

**Vi söker dig som**
* Har omkring 8-12 års erfarenhet av .NET och C#
* Har arbetat med ASP.NET Core, API-utveckling och databaser
* Har erfarenhet av backendutveckling, särskilt inom affärslogik, bakgrundstjänster och systemintegrationer
* Har erfarenhet av moderna webbtekniker (JavaScript/TypeScript)
* Har vana av att ta tekniskt ansvar och arbeta nära kund
* Talar och skriver svenska och engelska obehindrat


**Meriterande**
* Molnplattformar (t.ex. Azure)
* Mikrotjänster eller integrationslösningar
* CI/CD, containerteknik och DevOps-arbetssätt


**Att arbeta på Sopra Steria**
 Hos oss får du kombinera stabiliteten i ett etablerat bolag med en kultur som präglas av kunskapsdelning och utveckling. Vi erbjuder varierande uppdrag där du kan växa tekniskt och professionellt, oavsett om du vill fördjupa dig i teknik eller ta större ansvar i team och arkitektur. Vi investerar i din utveckling, ditt välmående och din livsbalans. Läs mer här.
   

  

**Några av våra förmåner:**
* 5 000 kr i friskvård samt hälsostöd för dig och din familj
* 30 dagars semester samt två extra lediga dagar per år
* Certifieringsbonus och aktiv kompetensutveckling
* Initiativ för träning och gemenskap
* Stark föräldralön, tjänstepension och försäkringar
* Bidrag till hemmakontor och arbetsutrustning


**Rekryteringsprocess**
 Vi behandlar ansökningar löpande. Rollen ställer höga krav på kompetens och säkerhetsmedvetenhet. Inför eventuell anställning genomför vi bakgrundskontroll och vid intervju behöver du uppvisa giltig legitimation.
   

  

 Processen består av tre intervjuer, personlighet och logiktest, referenstagning samt bakgrundskontroll. Det ger oss en bred bild av dig och ger dig möjlighet att visa din kompetens ur flera perspektiv.
   

  

 Har du frågor om rollen är du välkommen att kontakta Clara Bozzi på clara.bozzi@soprasteria.com
   

  

 Välkommen till Sopra Steria i Stockholm! Vi ser fram emot din ansökan.

title: Systemutvecklare RPG
description:
Vill du vara med och utveckla affärskritiska lösningar som gör verklig skillnad för våra kunder? Hos oss på Folksam arbetar vi med moderna teknologier och komplexa system i en miljö där samarbete, kundvärde och innovation står i centrum, och du har möjlighet att utvecklas och göra skillnad!
 



  





 Vi söker nu en erfaren systemutvecklare inom RPG till ett av våra agila team. Har du erfarenhet av RPG, SQL och integrationer via MQ- och webbtjänster så har vi utmaningen för dig!
 



  





**Det här gör du som systemutvecklare RPG på Folksam** 




 Som systemutvecklare hos oss arbetar du genom hela utvecklingskedjan – från analys och kravhantering till utveckling, implementation, drift och förvaltning. Du får en central roll där du arbetar nära både teknik, verksamhet och leverans.
 



  





 Du blir en del av ett engagerat agilt team som fokuserar på att skapa affärsvärde genom täta leveranser och ett nära samarbete med verksamheten. Vi arbetar kontinuerligt med att utveckla våra arbetssätt, vår teknik och våra processer inom både utveckling och förvaltning. Teamet ansvarar för förvaltning och vidareutveckling av systemet som stödjer Folksams företagsaffär.
 



  





 Nyfiken på att läsa mer vad våra systemutvecklare jobbar med på Folksam? Gå in och läs
 
 här!
 




  





**Är du den vi söker?** 




 Vi söker dig som har:
 


* Flerårig erfarenhet av utveckling i RPG och SQL på IBM i-plattformen.
* Erfarenhet av integrationer via MQ-tjänster och webbtjänster.
* Erfarenhet av förvaltningsarbete, inklusive incident-, problem-, change- och releasehantering.
* Vana av att arbeta enligt agila arbetssätt.



  





 Det är meriterande om du har:
 


* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med API:er
* Erfarenhet av systemansvar
* Kunskap om eller erfarenhet från försäkringsbranschen



  





 Du har eftergymnasial utbildning inom IT, alternativt motsvarande erfarenhet förvärvad genom arbetslivet. Eftersom rollen innebär nära samarbete med både verksamhet och kollegor är det viktigt att du behärskar svenska mycket väl i tal och skrift.
 



  





 För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du är en person som trivs med samarbete och som gärna tar ansvar för både leverans och kvalitet. Du har ett genuint teknikintresse, är nyfiken på nya lösningar och drivs av att ständigt utveckla både dig själv och de system du arbetar med.
 



  





 Du är engagerad, initiativrik och lösningsorienterad. Samtidigt är du prestigelös och generös med att dela med dig av din kunskap. Vi värdesätter laganda, samarbete och ett positivt förhållningssätt – och ser gärna att du bidrar med både energi och humor i teamet.
 



 Välkommen att bli en del av teamet och bidra till att utveckla framtidens lösningar för våra företagskunder.
 



  





**Här kan du göra skillnad** 




 Välkommen till Folksam – här driver du viktiga frågor framåt. Från de avgörande detaljerna till de stora perspektiven, med fokus på att förenkla våra kunders vardag. Det gör att du bidrar till något större, oavsett roll. Här finns det många roliga, utvecklande jobb och du har goda chanser till en spännande karriär.
 



  





 Vi tror på ett hållbart arbetsliv och jobbar aktivt med inkludering och mångfald. Våra moderna kontor bjuder in till samarbete och lärande, här får vi saker att hända! Du har flexibiliteten att kunna varva arbete på kontoret med att jobba hemifrån, utifrån verksamhetens behov.
 



 Läs mer och se filmer om livet hos oss på
 
 folksam.se/jobb-och-karriar.
 




  





**Så söker du jobbet** 




 Välkommen att skicka in din ansökan senast den 1 november 2026.
 



  





 Vill du veta mer om jobbet är du välkommen att kontakta gruppchef Per Körner, 070-831 62 96.
 




 Här
 
 kan du läsa mer om vilka bakgrundskontroller som kan vara aktuella i den här rekryteringen.
 



  





 Fackliga representanter: Akademikerföreningen Per Hansson 070-831 57 66, Forena Mari Leppioja 070-831 54 29 och Handels Mikael Carlsson 070-831 51 32.

title: Creative Frontend Developer
description:
**Do you love turning creative ideas into playful, engaging experiences? Are you the kind of developer who sees something cool and immediately wants to build it?** 




  





 At GeoGuessr, we’re looking for a creative frontend developer who combines a strong eye for UI with solid technical skills and the curiosity to bring ideas to life.
 



 You’ll help shape the experience for millions of players worldwide, creating features that are not only functional but also fun, intuitive, and visually engaging.
 



  





**The role** 




 You’ll work at the intersection of
 **creativity, design, and technology** 
 , collaborating closely with designers and product managers to create engaging game experiences.
 



 We’re looking for someone who doesn’t just implement designs but brings ideas to the table, experiments, and takes ownership from concept to finished feature.
 



 You have hands-on experience building web applications and care about how things look, feel, and perform.
 



 Your main focus will be frontend development, but you understand how APIs and backend services work together.
 



  





**What you will do:** 




 Build playful, polished, and interactive experiences for millions of players.
 


* Turn ideas and designs into high-quality, production-ready features.
* Collaborate with Design and Product to explore ideas and improve the player experience.
* Take initiative, experiment, and drive solutions forward independently.
* Create reusable UI components with attention to performance, usability, and visual details.
* Work with APIs and occasionally make smaller backend changes, using AI tools where helpful.



  





**What we hope you’ll bring:** 



* **Hands-on experience with modern web development** 
 , particularly React and TypeScript.
* **A creative mindset and a strong eye for UI** 
 , interactions, and visual details.
* Experience turning ideas into working solutions, with an understanding of performance and code quality.
* **A self-starter mentality** 
 – you take initiative and enjoy figuring things out.
* A solid understanding of how web applications work, including APIs and frontend/backend communication.
* Curiosity about AI-assisted development and the ability to understand and evaluate the solutions you build.
* A collaborative mindset and a genuine interest in games and playful digital experiences.



  





**Its extra nice if you bring:** 



* Experience building games or other interactive web experiences.
* Experience with animations, motion design, Three.js, WebGL, or creative coding.
* Familiarity with Figma, design systems, or component libraries.
* Personal projects that showcase your creativity and technical skills.



  





**Who you are:** 



* You’re curious, creative, and love building things.
* You care about how something
 **looks, feels, and works** 
 – not just whether the code runs.
* You enjoy collaborating with others, but you’re equally comfortable taking ownership, exploring ideas, and making things happen.
* Most importantly, you love creating experiences that make people smile.
* Built something you’re proud of? We’d love to see it! Whether it’s a game, an interactive website, or a creative experiment, show us what you enjoy creating.



  





**Wait, there's more!** 




 We're offering a package of perks to keep you charged up and ready to create wonders:
 


* Daily breakfast and lunch at the office.
* 6 weeks of vacation + 3 extra days off, for a well-deserved rest.
* Pension and insurance as per ITP1 guidelines.
* 50,000 SEK education benefit.
* 5,000 SEK wellness allowance.
* Free massage once a month
* A high energy and very much alive office.



  





 We encourage exercise during working hours. We provide a large selection of snacks and drinks for recovery. A home to simply enjoy.
 



 This role is based in Stockholm where we have invested in creating our unique home at Katarinavägen 17, in the glass house by Slussen.
 



  





 \* or equivalent experience
 *(Higher Vocational Education (Yrkeshögskola) may be sufficient only if compensated trough extensive work experience).*

title: Software Engineer
description:
**About the Role:** 




**The team:** 




 The development team is based in Stockholm and consists of 22 highly skilled individuals with diverse backgrounds, each engineer playing their unique part in serving our global customer base. Everyone on the team shares the responsibility of meeting all functional and non-functional requirements, and you’ll find that the team decisions cover not only business-related improvements but also a wide variety of technical topics such as architectural styles, Kubernetes operators, deployment pipelines, data locality strategies, observability solutions, frontend frameworks and much much more. The team is responsible for a complex system requiring a lot of collaboration within the team and with other parts of the technology organisation and we value learning from each other in order to continuously improve ourselves and the user experience.
 



  





**Responsibilities and impact:** 




 OSTTRA is a FinTech company at the heart of the global financial system, dedicated to building the future of post-trade. OSTTRA Resolve is our post-trade service that offers an automated trade portfolio reconciliation workflow. Improvement of OSTTRA Resolve has far-reaching effects in this important segment of the financial industry, not only through expanded capabilities of other integrated OSTTRA services, but also directly through operational efficiency improvements and cost reductions for many of the largest banks in the world.
 



  




* Actively contribute to the development and architecture of the system to meet new and changing business needs
* Ensure that non-functional requirements are established and met
* Be part of the team taking care of the overall system health
* Engage in continuous learning to keep up with industry best practices



  





**What’s in it for you:** 



* Influence the future of a market-leading solution together with highly skilled people across the globe
* Work in an empowered engineering team with people that want you to succeed
* Learn about the financial industry and contribute to the stability of the global financial system
* Expand your technical skill set by working in a modern tech stack



  





**What we’re looking for:**




**Fundamental requirement:** 



* A master’s degree in computer science or a similar field
* Around 5 years of relevant experience
* Excellent communication skills (fluency in English is a must)
* A bold and humble team player
* A desire to work in a modern tech stack including, but not limited to Python, TypeScript, React, NoSQL/SQL databases, Docker and Kubernetes
* Business mindedness and a solution-oriented mindset
* An aptitude and willingness to improve yourself, others around you and our ways of working.



  





**Additional preferred requirements:** 



* An interest in financial markets
* A passion for technology



  





**The location:** 
 Stockholm, Sweden
 



  





**Right to work requirements:** 




 This role is limited to persons with right to work in the Sweden.
 



  





**Our Benefits: Global vision, local impact** 




 At OSTTRA, our benefits philosophy offers a market-competitive package that reflects our position as an industry leader. We want to ensure you feel valued, secure, and empowered wherever you are in the world.
 



 Our approach is built on three core pillars:
 


* **Global foundations** 
 : We provide a baseline of excellence across all our offices, focusing on comprehensive Health & Wellness, Financial Security, and Work-Life Balance. No matter your location, you are part of a culture that prioritizes your holistic well-being.
* **Locally tailored** 
 : We benchmark in each market to ensure our packages are genuinely competitive where you live and work.
* **Flexibility and growth:** 
 We empower you to work in a way that suits your life. This includes a hybrid working model, generous leave policies, and a commitment to your continuous professional development.



  





**The Trust employee ownership plan** 




 Every employee at OSTTRA is an owner, and a member of The Trust, our employee ownership programme. Our distinct culture encourages colleagues to think and act like owners and raise the bar constantly.
 



 This plan reflects our belief that when we work together to build a stronger, more valuable organisation, then all colleagues should benefit from the value we create.
 



  





**About OSTTRA** 




 We build and operate the infrastructure that the world’s post-trade financial system runs on. Launched in 2021, we have unified more than 20 years of heritage and expertise from four industry leaders into a single, integrated business.
 



 Today,we operate a trusted network that connects thousands of market participants to streamline end-to-end workflows, from trade capture through portfolio optimisation.We translate industry change into workable process, engineering an open, intelligent ecosystem that removes friction and reduces risk for the global markets.
 



  





 Our distinct ownership culture is underpinned by four behaviours: boldness, curiosity, accountability, and collaboration. In 2025 we were acquired by KKR, one of the world’s most successful private equity firms, and are on a journey of growth and impact.
 



 Joining our team now is a unique opportunity - you will help to shape the next generation of post-trade, transform shared infrastructure into shared benefit, and accelerate your own career. Learn more at
 
 www.osttra.com
 
 .
 



  





**Equal opportunity employer statement at OSTTRA:**




 We are committed to fostering a connected and engaged workplace where all colleagues have access to opportunities based on their skills, experience, and contributions. Our hiring practices emphasise fairness, transparency, and merit, ensuring that we attract and retain the best talent. By valuing different perspectives and promoting a culture of respect and collaboration, we drive and operate the infrastructure that the world’s post-trade financial system runs on.

title: Lead Builder Software Engineering - Space
description:
*Vill du påverka och göra skillnad på riktigt? Här bidrar du till att skapa trygghet för människor och samhällen. Det du gör spelar roll* 
*.*
 Din roll
   

  

 Vill du kombinera passionen för mjukvaruutveckling med ett genuint intresse för rymden och bli specialist inom ett område som är kritiskt för framtidens säkerhet?
   

  

 I takt med att antalet satelliter och objekt i omloppsbana ökar, växer behovet av att förstå och övervaka rymdmiljön. För att skapa en tydlig rymdlägesbild krävs avancerad mjukvara som kan samla in, bearbeta och analysera enorma mängder data. Vi söker nu dig som vill vara med och driva utvecklingen av vår produkt inom Space Situational Awareness (SSA) och Space Domain Awareness (SDA). Hos oss får du kombinera beprövade principer för robust systemutveckling med moderna, AI-stödda arbetssätt för att skapa lösningar som gör skillnad på riktigt.
   

  

 Som Lead Builder inom Software Engineering blir du en nyckelspelare i ett tvärfunktionellt team där mjukvaruteknik möter rymddata och operativa behov. Du kommer att arbeta nära domänexperter och slutanvändare för att omsätta komplexa krav till skalbar och högpresterande kod. Det centrala i att vara en Lead Builder ligger i kombinationen av djup teknisk kompetens och förståelse för slutanvändarens behov.
   

  

 Vi värdesätter hantverket bakom robust, testbar och långsiktigt förvaltbar mjukvara. I rollen integrerar du moderna AI-baserade utvecklingsverktyg (exempelvis Claude Code) för att effektivisera kodanalys, refaktorering och dokumentation. Vi ser AI som en kraftfull katalysator, men det är ditt tekniska omdöme och din expertis som säkerställer lösningens kvalitet, säkerhet och funktion.
   

  

 Du behöver inte vara expert på rymdområdet från start, men vi förväntar oss att du är nyfiken och motiverad att successivt bygga upp en djup domänkunskap för att på sikt bli en av våra främsta specialister inom SSA/SDA.
   

  

**Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden kommer vara att:**
* Utveckla och optimera funktionalitet i vår produkt för rymdlägesbild (SSA/SDA).
* Designa och implementera lösningar för bearbetning, analys och visualisering av orbitaldata och sensordata.
* Säkerställa hög mjukvarukvalitet genom robust arkitektur, automatiserade tester och noggrann kodgranskning.
* Implementera och utvärdera AI-stödda utvecklingsflöden för att öka teamets effektivitet.
* Samarbeta med produktägare och domänexperter för att bryta ner komplexa behov till tekniska specifikationer.
* Bidra till produktens tekniska roadmap och arkitektoniska vägval.


 Din profil
   

  

 Vi söker en skicklig mjukvaruingenjör med ett analytiskt tänkande och en vilja att förstå komplexa system på djupet. Du trivs i en miljö där teknisk excellens möter höga krav på tillförlitlighet.
   

  

**Vi ser gärna att du har:**
* Högskole- eller civilingenjörsexamen inom datateknik, mjukvaruteknik, teknisk fysik eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet.
* Dokumenterad erfarenhet av professionell mjukvaruutveckling och god förståelse för hela utvecklingslivscykeln (SDLC).
* God kunskap inom mjukvaruarkitektur, API-design och moderna databaslösningar.
* Erfarenhet av ett eller flera av följande språk: Python, C++, Java eller C#.
* Förmåga att kritiskt granska och kvalitetssäkra AI-genererad kod med ett starkt tekniskt omdöme.
* God kommunikativ förmåga och vana av att arbeta i team över olika kompetensområden.
* Ett stort intresse för rymdteknik och satellitsystem.
* Flytande i både svenska och engelska.


 Meriterande erfarenheter:
   

  

 Det är ett plus om du har erfarenhet av rymdlägesbild, banmekanik, GIS/geospatial data, sensorfusion, distribuerade system eller realtidssystem.
   

  

 Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap.
   

  

 Vad du blir en del a
 **v**
 Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas.
   

  

 Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med uppdrag att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidrar till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 28,000 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld.
   

  

 Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här.

title: Systemutvecklare inom kortutgivning
description:
* Ansök senast: 16 oktober 2026
* Hybrid


 Arbetsuppgifter
   

  

*Hela samhället ställer om mot en fossilfri framtid. Vi vill visa vägen i utvecklingen av vår bransch, så att fler kan ta sig fram, ta hand om sitt fordon och driva verksamheter med ett så lågt klimatavtryck som möjligt. Vill du vara med och bidra till hållbar utveckling, på riktigt? Välkommen att följa med på vår resa!*
 Vill du arbeta med affärskritiska system i en miljö där säkerhet, stabilitet och skalbarhet är avgörande?
   

  

**Vi söker**
 Vi söker en utvecklare som vill vara med och vidareutveckla OKQ8:s lösningar för kortutgivning och betalningar.
   

  

 Du blir en del av teamet som utvecklar och förvaltar vårt centrala system för kortutgivning. Systemet hanterar komplexa och verksamhetskritiska flöden med höga krav på tillgänglighet, säkerhet och datakvalitet.
   

  

 Rollen har ett tydligt fokus på backendutveckling i Python och Django samt databasnära utveckling i Oracle. Du kommer även att arbeta med frontend och bidra inom drift, automatisering och infrastruktur.
   

  

 Arbetet varierar mellan större utvecklingsinitiativ, löpande förbättringar och underhåll av befintliga lösningar. Du arbetar nära andra utvecklare och specialister och får möjlighet att påverka både teknik, arbetssätt och framtida lösningar.
   

  

**I rollen ingår även att:**
* Arbeta med affärskritiska betalnings- och kortutgivningslösningar
* Bidra till utvecklingen av framtidens kort- och betalningsplattform inom OKQ8
* Delta i tekniska vägval och bidra till modernisering, automatisering och kontinuerliga förbättringar av plattformen.
* Utveckla och underhålla backendlösningar i Python och Django
* Arbeta med Oracle Database, SQL och PL/SQL
* Utveckla och vidareutveckla gränssnitt i JavaScript och React
* Felsöka och arbeta i Linuxbaserade miljöer
* Bygga och underhålla containerbaserade lösningar med Docker
* Bidra till automatisering och infrastruktur som kod med Terraform och Ansible
* Arbeta med säkerhet, prestanda, stabilitet och skalbarhet
* Använda och utforska AI-baserade utvecklingsverktyg på ett säkert och ansvarsfullt sätt


 Kvalifikationer
   

  

**För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har:**
* Flerårig erfarenhet av systemutveckling
* Praktisk erfarenhet av Python
* Erfarenhet av relationsdatabaser och SQL
* Vana att arbeta i Linuxmiljö
* Relevant utbildning inom IT eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet
* God förmåga att samarbeta och kommunicera kring tekniska lösningar på svenska och engelska


**Det är starkt meriterande om du har erfarenhet av:**
* Django
* Oracle Database och PL/SQL
* Utveckling och optimering av procedurer, funktioner och paket
* Datamodellering och prestandaoptimering i Oracle eller andra databaser
* JavaScript och React
* Docker
* Terraform och Ansible
* Molnbaserad infrastruktur
* Betalningar, kortutgivning eller andra säkerhetskritiska system
* AI-stödd utveckling och säker användning av AI-verktyg. Vi tror även att du har en vilja att utvecklas inom säkerhet och skalbarhet i betalningslösningar


**Vem är du?**
 Du är nyfiken, ansvarstagande och lösningsorienterad. Du tycker om att förstå komplexa system och kan både bygga nytt och förbättra det som redan finns. Du arbetar gärna tillsammans med andra, delar med dig av din kunskap och är samtidigt bekväm med att själv driva uppgifter framåt.
   

  

 Vi värdesätter rätt person och ett bra ömsesidigt teamfit högt. Därför ser vi inte listan ovan som en kravlista där du måste kunna allt från början.
   

  

**Vi erbjuder**
 Hos oss på OKQ8 får du arbeta i en flexibel miljö med viktiga och varierande arbetsuppgifter. Vi uppmuntrar samarbete, innovation och utveckling – och vi tror på att vi tillsammans gör varandra bättre. Här blir du en del av en familjär kultur där vi stöttar varandra, har roligt tillsammans och där du ges möjlighet att växa och göra skillnad. Vi vill vara ett företag som speglar samhället, med en inkluderande kultur som minskar utanförskap och främjar mångfald.
   

  

**Övrig information**
 Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef Martin Huldin;
   

  

**Placeringsort:** 
 Stockholm, Sveavägen.
   

  

**Tillträde:** 
 Enligt överenskommelse.
   

  

**Anställningsform:** 
 Tillsvidareanställning med sex månaders provanställning
   

  

 För den här tjänsten behöver du vara medborgare i Sverige, ett annat nordiskt land eller ett EU/EES-land, ha permanent uppehållstillstånd i Sverige eller vara asylsökande med rätt att arbeta. Du ska kunna styrka ditt medborgarskap eller din rätt att arbeta i Sverige under rekryteringsprocessen.
   

  

*I rekryteringsprocessen ingår både psykometriska tester och kompetensbaserade intervjuer, med syfte att främja en rättvis utvärdering för alla kandidater.*
**Välkommen med din ansökan!**

title: Senior Cloud Data Engineer
description:
We are looking for a
 **Senior Cloud Data Engineer** 
 to join a team responsible for business-critical data flows and reporting solutions. The area is going through a major transformation from legacy platforms to a modern, cloud-based data ecosystem on
 **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)** 
 .
 



 The role combines hands-on engineering with technical design and architectural input. You will help modernise data pipelines, build scalable data products, and support the transition towards a more reliable, accessible, and easy-to-consume data platform.
 



  





**About the role** 




 As a Senior Cloud Data Engineer, you will work closely with architects, product owners, and business stakeholders to design and deliver data and integration solutions. You will contribute to the technical roadmap, support modernization initiatives, and ensure that new solutions follow agreed architecture patterns and engineering standards.
 



 The team’s goal is to make data more trusted, available, and useful for reporting, decision-making, and future digital applications.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 



* Contribute to the technical roadmap for data, reporting, and integration solutions.
* Design, develop, implement, and maintain data solutions in a cloud-based environment.
* Build and modernise data pipelines, APIs, and data products.
* Support the migration from legacy systems to a modern
 **GCP-based data architecture** 
 .
* Work with business-critical data flows used for client reporting.
* Collaborate with architects, product owners, and stakeholders to translate business needs into technical solutions.
* Ensure alignment with target architecture, technical standards, and reusable engineering patterns.
* Improve reliability, scalability, and maintainability of data solutions.
* Support DevOps practices, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code where relevant.



  





**Requirements** 



* Several years of experience in
 **software development** 
 and/or
 **data engineering** 
 .
* Strong hands-on experience with
 **GCP** 
 or similar cloud platforms.
* Very good knowledge of
 **Python** 
 ,
 **SQL** 
 , and
 **BigQuery** 
 .
* Experience building scalable data solutions using tools such as:
* **BigQuery**
* **Dataform**
* **Airflow**
* **Pub/Sub**
* **Docker**
* Understanding of modern data architectures, including
 **Data Warehouse** 
 and
 **event-driven** 
 patterns.
* Experience with
 **ETL/ELT processes** 
 and data modelling, e.g. dimensional modelling or Data Vault.
* Experience with DevOps practices,
 **CI/CD** 
 ,
 **GitLab** 
 , and Infrastructure as Code, e.g.
 **Terraform** 
 .
* Ability to combine hands-on development with technical design and solution ownership.
* Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset.
* Ability to translate business requirements into practical, scalable technical solutions.



  





**Nice to have** 



* Experience in reporting or client reporting environments.
* Experience modernising legacy data platforms.
* Knowledge of data governance, data quality, and platform observability.
* Experience working in large organisations or complex stakeholder environments.

title: AI Software Engineer
description:
**We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced AI Software Engineer to join our dynamic and collaborative development team in Stockholm, Karlskrona, Barcelona or Leuven!** 




 As an AI Software Engineer, you’ll play a key role in developing our core AI services within the
 **cyber security** 
 domain, refining and adapting models, and enabling teams across the company to integrate AI into their products and workflows. This role blends hands‑on engineering with applied AI problem‑solving.
 



  





 You will have the opportunity to work on exciting projects, leveraging the power of Python and Golang to build high-performance applications with
 **cutting-edge cloud technologies** 
 . You might not already be fluent in both Python and Golang, but if you have the right mindset and fit for us, we will support you in managing both languages!
 



  





**As an AI Software Engineer your responsibilities include, but are not limited to:** 



* Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Develop AI solutions in Python, with supporting services in Golang.
* Design, build, and maintain production-grade AI services and APIs.
* Provide AI expertise, guidance, and troubleshooting support across the organization.
* Fine-tune, evaluate, and optimize machine learning and LLM-based models.
* Integrate AI capabilities into products and systems.
* Research and evaluate emerging AI technologies and best practices.
* Contribute to coding standards, architecture, and engineering best practices.
* Ensure the reliability, scalability, and performance of AI-powered systems.
* Conduct code reviews and resolve software defects and performance issues.



  





**What type of experience do we expect from our ideal candidate?** 




**Must Have:**



* 5+ years of professional
 **software development** 
 experience.
* Strong proficiency in
 **Python** 
 (or a similar language) commonly used for AI and machine learning development.
* Good understanding of
 **machine learning fundamentals** 
 ; practical experience with modern AI frameworks is highly valued.
* Hands-on experience working with
 **LLMs** 
 , embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, or model fine-tuning.
* Solid understanding of
 **software engineering principles** 
 , including data structures, algorithms, design patterns, and system design.
* Experience building scalable, reliable, and maintainable
 **software** 
**solutions** 
 .
* Proficiency with
 **Git** 
 and modern version control practices.
* Familiarity with
 **Agile development methodologies** 
 and collaborative engineering environments.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with
 **fluency** 
**in** 
**English** 
 .
* As a person you have strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment and adapt to changing priorities.



**Nice to Have:**



* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience designing, deploying, or operating
 **cloud-native and highly available systems** 
 , ideally using technologies such as Kubernetes.
* Experience with
 **Amazon Bedrock** 
 or other AI platforms and providers such as Azure AI, OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS AI Services, or Google Vertex AI.
* Knowledge of or interest in
 **cybersecurity** 
 and secure software development practices.



  





**But what's in it for you?** 




***In return for your efforts, we will offer you:***



* A flat organizational structure and lots of autonomy; you are not just a number. You will join an organization that offers a steep learning curve, where your contributions will have a tangible impact.
* The opportunity to be part of a fast-growing and fun European cybersecurity company.
* Employees also benefit from regular performance conversations with their managers, focused on development, career progression, and self improvement.
* Join our team in one of our offices, and experience a workplace that’s as vibrant as the city, from fun socials, great perks, and a collaborative environment!
* A healthy work-life balance, so you can enjoy flexibility and a hybrid working environment (3 days in office).



**And so much more!** 




  





*At Outpost24, we're dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, where attitude, values and willingness to learn are valued above all. So, if you're excited about this role but your professional experiences don't completely align with what we're looking for, we encourage you to apply anyway!*

title: Software Engineer, Platform (Developer Experience)
description:
**TL;DR** 
 We are seeking a Platform Engineer to enhance and scale Lovable's developer experience. In this role, you will be responsible for critical components of our stack, ensuring our engineering workflows are faster, smoother, and more
 **Lovable** 
 .
   

  

**Why Lovable?**
 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
   

  

**What We’re Looking For**
* You have strong programming skills and a track record of improving developer velocity and system reliability.
* 7+ years of experience working in a platform team supporting developer experience (o11y, CI/CD, application frameworks, productivity tooling, etc).
* You’ve written code and tools to support growing engineering orgs in scale-ups.
* You have experience with Docker, Kubernetes and modern infrastructure practices.
* You’re a problem-solver who thrives on challenges and ships high-leverage systems fast.
* You’re comfortable navigating ambiguity and solving problems as they arise.
* You care about security, stability, and speed and know when to make trade-offs between them.
* You’re based in Stockholm/London or ready to relocate - this is an on-site, 5-days-a-week role.


**What You’ll Do**
**In one sentence:** 
 Own and scale the developer experience at Lovable, making our engineering teams the most productive in the world.
   

  

* Bring order and structure to our code base.
* Integrate or build application frameworks to support a growing engineering organization and code footprint
* Own and develop our observability stack, from code instrumentation through ingestion to presentation.
* Integrating tools for AI driven development.
* Identify and drive reliability improvement efforts across all engineering teams.


**Our tech stack**
 We're building with tools that both humans and AI love. Lovable platform engineers are capable of working across the whole stack. Examples of tech in our stack include:
   

  

* Frontend: React and Typescript.
* Backend: Golang and Rust.
* Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS.
* Data: Clickhouse, Firestore, Spanner, BigQuery.
* DevOps Tooling: CI/CD pipelines, OTEL, Grafana, kubernetes, terraform.
* Local Tooling: Nix, DevEnv.


 And always on the lookout for what's next!
   

  

**About Your Application**
* Please submit your application in English - it’s our company language so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join
* We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested please apply through our careers portal

title: Sr. Platform Engineer | Cloud Infrastructure
description:
At TV4, our engineers build and operate the technology behind TV4 Play and MTV Katsomo, used by millions of people every week.
   

  

 Within Engineering Platform, we build the shared cloud infrastructure and platform capabilities used by engineering teams across TV4. We are now looking for a
 **Sr. Platform Engineer** 
 to help develop our Internal Developer Platform.
   

  

***Before you apply***
*To be considered, you need to* 
***already have the right to work and reside in Sweden***
*and be able to work office-first from Stockholm. We are not able to offer relocation or visa sponsorship for this role.*
**What We Are Building**
 Our engineering teams own the software they build, from development through production. Engineering Platform provides the shared foundation that supports them.
   

  

 Our platform is built around AWS, Kubernetes and infrastructure as code. We are moving more shared infrastructure capabilities into the platform, with clearer abstractions and self-service for engineering teams.
   

  

 We want to provide clear interfaces and sensible defaults without taking ownership away from the teams running the software.
   

  

 Our users are engineers, and the platform needs to work well for them.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 You will work in a small team responsible for our cloud platform and Internal Developer Platform.
   

  

 You will:
   

  

* Build and evolve shared cloud infrastructure and platform capabilities
* Develop self-service capabilities for engineering teams
* Improve how services are provisioned, deployed and operated
* Turn recurring infrastructure needs into shared platform capabilities that teams can use themselves
* Work with teams across TV4 to understand where the platform creates friction or unnecessary work
* Improve reliability, observability, security and operational practices across the platform
* Take responsibility for the capabilities you build in production
* Contribute to technical direction and platform architecture


 This is a hands-on engineering role. You will work close to both the underlying infrastructure and the engineers using it.
   

  

**About You**
 You are an experienced platform or infrastructure engineer who has built and operated production environments at scale.
   

  

 You understand cloud infrastructure deeply enough to know where abstraction helps and where it gets in the way. You are comfortable working below the abstraction when needed, but also interested in creating platforms that make good engineering practices easier for other teams.
   

  

 We are looking for:
   

  

* Strong experience with modern cloud infrastructure
* Experience with Kubernetes and containerised production environments
* Infrastructure as code and automated provisioning
* Experience designing or building internal platforms, developer platforms or self-service infrastructure
* Strong understanding of reliability, observability, networking and security
* Experience operating systems in production and handling incidents
* Good software engineering fundamentals and the ability to build platform tooling and services
* The ability to make technical trade-offs across infrastructure, developer experience and operational complexity
* Clear communication and experience working across engineering teams


 You don’t have to have experience with all of these things to be a good fit for the role, but they are things you will encounter at TV4. Experience from a specific cloud provider or toolset is less important than understanding the underlying problems.
   

  

**Platform as a product**
 Our users are engineers across TV4. We work closely with them to understand recurring problems, decide what belongs in the platform and build capabilities that work across teams.
   

  

 This requires strong infrastructure knowledge as well as an interest in developer experience and product thinking.
   

  

**Engineering Platform**
 Engineering Platform consists of two closely related parts:
   

  

**Cloud Infrastructure / Internal Developer Platform** 
 builds the cloud platform and shared capabilities our teams use to build, deploy and operate software, with an increasing focus on self-service and platform abstractions.
   

  

**Agent Platform** 
 focuses on how we build software: agentic workflows, developer tooling and AI-assisted engineering.
   

  

 This role belongs to Cloud Infrastructure, but the two areas work closely together.
   

  

**Technical environment**
 Your day-to-day may include:
   

  

* AWS
* Kubernetes
* Terraform/OpenTofu
* kro and ACK
* GitHub Actions
* Go, TypeScript and other languages used across our engineering organisation
* PostgreSQL, DynamoDB and OpenSearch
* Grafana and OpenTelemetry


 You’ll build APIs, CLI tooling and internal developer tooling on top of this. The exact technologies will continue to evolve. We care more about strong platform engineering fundamentals than experience with every tool in our current stack.
   

  

**What TV4 Offers**
* A senior engineering role with significant influence over the platform used across our engineering organisation
* Short paths from idea to decision and high autonomy
* Experienced engineering colleagues and technically challenging problems
* Collective agreement, occupational pension, insurance and wellness allowance
* Benify, your choice of phone and MacBook Pro
* Office with gym, restaurant and garage


**Practical information**
 TV4 is office-first and we work from our Stockholm office four days a week.
   

  

 The position is permanent with a six-month probationary period.
   

  

 Union affiliation: Unionen.
   

  

 A background check is part of the recruitment process.
   

  

 We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Expert Agentic Business Engineer
description:
**Job ID: 4459**
 We are seeking an experienced and highly hands-on Expert Agentic Business Engineer to design, build, and operationalize agentic AI solutions that solve real business problems in Asset & Wealth Management (AWM). You will work at the intersection of business transformation and advanced AI engineering – translating business needs into robust, well-governed agentic applications that can be safely deployed in a regulated banking environment.
   

  

**About Our Team**
 The AWM Chief Operating Office (COO) drives operational excellence, supports business transformation, and fosters innovation across Asset & Wealth Management. We focus on improving processes, leveraging technology, and ensuring strong governance and compliance – enabling sustainable growth and superior client experiences. The COO team collaborates across business, technology, and control functions to identify opportunities and deliver measurable impact. The AWM AI team is being established in AWM COO to accelerate delivery and scale of AI capabilities across AWM, with a strong focus on Private Banking and selected cross-area dependencies. We build common AI architecture and reusable patterns, support a disciplined governance model, and partner closely with business units, engineering teams, and control functions to turn an active AI pipeline into measurable outcomes.
   

  

**Main responsibilities in this role include, but are not limited to:**
* Own delivery from idea to production: frame business problems, shape agentic AI solution designs, prototype quickly, and industrialize into production-ready services with measurable outcomes.
* Build agentic AI applications: design and implement agents that can reason, plan, use tools, and interact with enterprise systems (e.g., advisor tooling, analytics platforms, internal APIs).
* Partner with stakeholders end-to-end: collaborate with Private Banking/AWM business leaders, architects, engineers, and control functions to ensure solutions deliver real value and can be adopted at scale.
* Engineer for governance and safety: implement evaluation strategies, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop patterns suitable for regulated banking environments (privacy, auditability, model risk expectations).
* Enable reuse and scale: build reusable patterns, components, and reference implementations to accelerate delivery across a portfolio of use cases.
* Operate and improve: monitor agent behavior in production, iterate on prompts/tools/logic based on evals and feedback, and continuously improve quality, cost, latency, and safety.


**Who You Are**
 Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in being at our best – and that we imagine you share with us. This is the right role for you if you are a curious, outcome-driven and pragmatic senior data scientist who can take ownership, influence stakeholders, and raise modelling and engineering standards while delivering working solutions at pace.
   

  

**Your background and skills include:**
* Are a curious, innovative team player with a can-do attitude, always looking for ways on how we can unlock the next level for our customers.
* Hands-on agentic AI experience, including designing and building agent workflows (planner–executor, tool calling, multi-agent, human-in-the-loop).
* Strong LLM ops and evaluation mindset: quality/correctness, latency, cost, and safety; ability to define test sets and run disciplined experimentation.
* Guardrails and Responsible AI experience: input/output validation, prompt safety, data leakage prevention, and controls appropriate for regulated environments.
* Strong software engineering skills with Python (modular design, testing, version control) and comfort working in notebook-based experimentation.
* Cloud and integration experience: deploying AI services in AWS, integrating via REST APIs, and familiarity with containerisation/Kubernetes and CI/CD. Data/analytics platform experience (e.g., Snowflake) for grounding, retrieval, and context management. Business engineering strength: ability to translate stakeholder needs into solution requirements, KPIs, and adoption plans; strong communication and collaboration skills.


**Why join**
 You will join a team building practical, high-impact AI capabilities across AWM – working on real advisor and operational workflows, with strong visibility and a clear focus on measurable outcomes.
   

  

 You will help shape how we build, govern, and scale agentic AI in a Nordic, regulated banking context.
   

  

 If you are passionate about agentic AI and eager to make a tangible impact in AWM, we invite you to apply and join our innovative COO team.
   

  

**Next steps**
 Submit your application no later than 07/11/2026. For more information, you’re welcome to contact Naja Nalapurakkal at naja.nalapurakkal@nordea.com
   

  

 We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.
   

  

 We build relationships. We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.
   

  

 We learn and develop. We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.
   

  

 We lead change. We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.
   

  

 We are Nordea. We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. As one of the biggest employers in the Nordics, Poland and Estonia, you have excellent opportunities to evolve, develop and move forward with us.
   

  

 Studies show that members of underrepresented communities don’t apply for jobs unless they tick all the qualification boxes. If this is part of why you hesitate to apply, we would like you to reconsider and give it a chance. Maybe your profile fits our needs much better than you think.

title: Data Engineer
description:
**Join our data and AI transformation journey**
 We are looking for a curious and driven Data Engineer who loves data and wants to turn it into real business value. You will work closely with stakeholders, translate business needs into well-structured data solutions and help build the trusted data foundation for analytics, digital solutions and AI at Munters.
   

  

 You do not need to know everything from day one. We value curiosity, collaboration and a willingness to learn just as much as technical experience.
   

  

**The team**
 You will join a collaborative data engineering team that shares knowledge, supports one another and solves challenges together. As AI provides new support across the data lifecycle, we believe that understanding the full journey of data, from ingestion and transformation to modelling, presentation and business use, will create value for Munters and support your long-term development.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Work with business stakeholders to understand challenges and turn needs into valuable data solutions.
* Design clear, scalable and reusable data models.
* Make trusted data available for reporting, analysis and decision-making.
* Develop and maintain our next-generation data platform together with the team.
* Learn and contribute across ingestion, transformation, modelling and presentation.
* Share knowledge and actively contribute to the success of the team.


**What We're Looking For**
* Approximately 1-5 years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, business intelligence or a related field.
* A genuine passion for data, business value and stakeholder collaboration.
* A strong interest in data modelling and well-structured, reusable data.
* Curiosity, ownership and an eagerness to learn new skills.
* Experience with SQL and an understanding of how data is structured and transformed.
* Some experience with, or an interest in learning, cloud data platforms such as Azure, AWS or Snowflake.


 Experience with dbt, Airflow, Python, Java, Power BI or enterprise resource planning systems is valuable, but we do not expect you to be an expert in everything.
   

  

**Why join us?**
 You will help shape how Munters works with data and AI while developing broad, end-to-end data capabilities. If you enjoy working with people, love data and want to make manufacturing smarter and more sustainable, we would love to hear from you.

title: Exploitutvecklare
description:
*Vill du göra samhällsnytta och bidra till Sveriges oberoende i världen? På FRA är varje arbetsuppgift en del av något större. Vi söker dig som vill arbeta med reversering av mjukvara och sårbarhetsanalyser till vår underrättelseverksamhet. Är du den vi söker kan vi erbjuda ett varierande arbete i en kunskapsintensiv miljö där du får vara med och göra skillnad varje dag.*
 Ditt uppdrag
   

  

 Som exploitutvecklare kommer du att arbeta på accessutvecklingskontoret som är en del av avdelningen för cyberverksamhet. Avdelningen har två huvuduppgifter: att bidra till att stärka skyddet mot kvalificerade IT-angrepp mot samhällsviktig verksamhet i Sverige samt att utveckla och leverera access- och exploateringsförmåga till signalunderrättelseverksamheten. Resultatet av ditt arbete kommer att leverera direkt nytta till stora delar av verksamheten.
   

  

 Dina Huvudsakliga Arbetsuppgifter Är Att Hitta Sårbarheter i Programvara För Att Sedan Utveckla Metoder Att Utnyttja Dem. Arbetsuppgifterna Består Framförallt Av Att
   

  

* Reversera mjukvara
* Granska programvara ur ett säkerhets- och systemperspektiv med syfte att hitta sårbarheter
* Utveckla program för att utnyttja sårbarheter
* Utveckla verktyg


 Hos oss blir du en del av ett starkt community av exploitutvecklare som stöttar och utmanar varandra för att nå nästa nivå. Vi växlar mellan fokuserat grupparbete och individuella utmaningar. Vi letar efter dig med ett brinnande intresse för ditt område och en passion för att leverera högsta möjliga kvalitet i varje detalj.
   

  

 Du kan
   

  

**Vi Söker Dig Som Har**
* Akademisk examen inom relevant område, exempelvis civilingenjör med inriktning mot datateknik, datavetenskap eller liknande. Alternativt motsvarande kunskaper som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdiga, men som är förvärvade på annat sätt
* Kunskap om en eller flera av reversering, sårbarhetsanalys och/eller exploitutveckling
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i både tal och skrift


**Vi Ser Det Som Meriterande Om Du Har**
* Arbetslivserfarenhet av reversering, sårbarhetsanalys och/eller exploitutveckling
* Erfarenhet av och kunskap om systemnära programmering och utveckling av inbyggda system (embedded systems)
* Erfarenhet av systemnära programmering
* Erfarenhet av analys av sårbarheter i webbapplikationer
* Kunskap om och/eller erfarenhet av fuzzing
* Kunskap om hur operativsystem (t.ex. Linux eller Windows) är uppbyggda
* Kunskap om sårbarhetsmitigeringar (t.ex. ASLR, DEP, CFG)
* Kunskap om kompilatorer
* Goda kunskaper i ryska och/eller kinesiska, i både tal och skrift


 Du är
   

  

**Vi Söker Dig Med Följande Egenskaper**
* Serviceinriktad – Du är uppmärksam på behov och har en vilja att hjälpa andra. Du är tillmötesgående och anstränger dig för att tillgodose andras behov.

* Uthållig – Du arbetar tills projekt är avslutade och resultat uppnådda. Vid motgång behåller du din effektivitet och motivation.
* Problemlösande analysförmåga – Du arbetar bra med komplexa frågor genom att analysera och bryta ner problem i mindre delar. Du ser mönster och lösningar som andra kan missa.


 Om FRA
   

  

 FRA har omvärlden som sin arena där varje arbetsuppgift är en del av något större. På ett eller annat sätt får du som medarbetare vara med och bidra till att skydda Sveriges integritet och oberoende i världen. Du är med och gör skillnad på riktigt, varje dag.

Vi skyddar det viktigaste vi har – vår trygghet, vår demokrati och vårt sätt att leva. Vi är experter på cyberområdet och signalspaning samt en larmklocka för militära hot.
   

  

 FRA leder sedan 2024 Nationellt cybersäkerhetscenter, NCSC vars uppdrag är att utveckla och stärka Sveriges förmåga att förebygga, upptäcka och hantera cyberhot.
   

  

 Som nyanställd på FRA får du en omfattande introduktionsutbildning och kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling, vilket ger dig möjlighet att utveckla dina färdigheter och bli ännu bättre på det du brinner för. Vår organisation är mångfacetterad och består av olika kompetenser och personligheter, där varje individ har unika egenskaper och förutsättningar. Vi strävar efter att skapa en miljö där alla känner sig välkomna och trygga. Utöver en stimulerande arbetsmiljö erbjuder vi också ett attraktivt förmånspaket, som du kan läsa mer om på www.fra.se . För mer information om Nationellt cybersäkerhetscenter besök www.ncsc.se
   

  

 För din trygghet. För vår demokrati. Varje dag. Året om.

För mer information är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef på rekrytering@fra.se Fackliga företrädare nås på 010-557 46 00.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**Oneflow is the all-in-one contract platform that helps businesses create, negotiate, sign, and manage contracts throughout their entire lifecycle. We replace clunky PDFs and manual processes with interactive digital contracts designed to deliver a smoother customer experience. Publicly listed and continuously innovating with AI, we're shaping the future of contract automation.** 




  





 As a
 **Senior Data Engineer,** 
 you won’t just maintain the pipelines and the data platform, you will also influence data governance decisions, drive data quality initiatives and be a technical partner to the infrastructure team making sure our data platform is secure and up to date regularly. You are someone who is proactive and takes ownership and communicates technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
 



 If you thrive on solving data problems and want your work to drive measurable business impact this is your stage!
 



  





**What you’ll do** 



* Design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines
* Maintain the data platform and keep all its packages up to date
* Model clean, testable data models in dbt for analytics and business stakeholders
* Partner with business teams to translate business needs into data solutions
* Ensure data quality, governance and security of our data platform



  





**Skills and requirements** 



* 5 years of experience in data engineering
* Strong SQL skills and deep understanding of data modeling (dbt is a great plus)
* Proficiency in Python
* Experience with ETL/ELT tools and orchestration tools (Dagster is a great plus)
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS is a great plus)
* Understanding and familiarity of CI/CD pipelines, version control, and DevOps practices
* Familiarity with docker and Kubernetes
* Strong data engineering design and architecture knowledge



  





**Why you’ll love working at Oneflow** 



* Be part of a growing company with an exceptional culture: our employee Net Promoter Score (eNPS) consistently exceeds the industry average.
* Work alongside a team with a clear vision, ambitious goals, and well-defined objectives and key results.
* Annual wellness allowance of 5,000 SEK.
* Daily breakfast, weekly fika, and a modern, fully equipped office stocked with snacks and beverages.
* Regular team activities and social events that reflect and strengthen our company culture.
* Parental leave top-up to support you during family leave.
* Comprehensive benefits package including pension, insurance, and access to OpenUp for mental health support and coaching.
* Collaborate with highly skilled and inspiring colleagues from around the world.



  





**Come work with us** 




 We value gender equality and diversity in organisation, so we strive for a team that reflects the diversity in today’s society. At Oneflow we currently have 34 nationalities and are proud of an extremely diverse workplace.
 



  





**Our recruitment is based on competence** 




 The recruitment process begins with an interview with Talent Acquisition. Next, you will complete a personality and logic test, followed by a case, case interview and interview with the Hiring Manager. As the last step, we conduct reference and a background checks.
 



  





**We can’t wait to meet you! 🎉** 




 Visit our website for more information about our product and Oneflow. Visit our career page for more information about our culture and future colleagues. 💜
 



  





**Visa & relocation note** 




 Please note that Oneflow is currently not providing visa sponsorship or relocation support for this role. Candidates must have the right to work in the location they are applying for.
 



  





**One more thing before you hit “Apply”** 




 We really want to get to know you and not the AI version of you. No need to overthink it or try to sound a certain way. We care more about your thoughts and who you are. Speak from the heart and we’re listening! 💫

title: Data Engineer
description:
We are Sweden's leading app and marketplace for booking beauty and wellness services. As a SaaS company with industry-leading software, we empower more than 16,000 professionals across the country. Our platform brings together nearly every salon and clinic in Sweden, making it easy for consumers to book appointments with hairdressers, massage therapists, podiatrists, beauty salons, chiropractors, and many other specialists—all in one place.
   

  

 On Bokadirekt.se, consumers can discover, book, and pay for treatments and services in just a few clicks. Every month, our platform is visited by 3 million consumers, and more than 2 million bookings are made through our website and app. We’re growing rapidly and are currently a team of more than 100 employees, with offices in Stockholm and Luleå.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a Data Engineer to join our Data & Analytics team and help shape the future of data and AI at Bokadirekt.
   

  

 As a Data Engineer, you will be responsible for building, maintaining, and evolving the data platform that powers analytics, business intelligence, and AI across the company. You'll work at the intersection of data engineering and AI, ensuring our data infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and ready to support everything from reporting and experimentation to LLM-powered features and machine learning pipelines.
   

  

 You will collaborate closely with product managers, software engineers, analysts, and other stakeholders to create high-quality data products and enable data-driven decision-making throughout the organization. This is an opportunity to have a significant impact on both our technical platform and how data and AI are used to create value for millions of users every month.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Design, build, and optimise scalable ELT pipelines that power analytics, reporting, and AI initiatives across the company
* Build a reliable, trusted and well-documented source of truth for company KPIs
* Work on the integration of AI capabilities into our data infrastructure
* Collaborate on the development and deployment of machine learning solutions and AI-powered features
* Identify and carry out data platform cost optimization initiatives


**Who You Are**
* Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Physics or related field
* Proven experience (4-6 years) as a Data Engineer, Data Scientist, ML Engineer or AI Engineer, ideally in a technology-driven environment
* Strong proficiency in SQL and Python
* Solid data engineering fundamentals with hands-on AI experience
* Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Experience with GCP (BigQuery, GCS, Gemini Agent Platform, Looker), Airflow, dbt and Cube is a plus. Bonus points for prompt engineering, LLM APIs, NL querying and RAG
* Professional fluency in English


**What We Offer**
* The opportunity to build and scale the data platform behind one of Sweden's most widely used consumer apps
* The chance to work with modern data and AI technologies, helping shape the foundations for analytics, machine learning, and LLM-powered solutions
* A collaborative culture built on ownership, innovation, and knowledge sharing
* A flexible hybrid work model with four days in the office each week, including Wednesdays as our "Inspiration Day," when the whole company comes together for breakfast and shared activities
* A modern office in the heart of Stockholm
* A competitive salary and benefits package


**About The Position**
**Start date:** 
 As soon as possible / By agreement
   

  

**Location:** 
 Our office at Kungsgatan 38 in central Stockholm (hybrid)
   

  

**Employment type:** 
 Full-time, permanent position
   

  

**Application**
 We review applications continuously, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. We therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

title: System Designer Technology Testbeds
description:

 At Ericsson, we turn bold technology ideas into the communication solutions that connect the world. We are looking for dedicated and skilled System Designers who are passionate about inventing, realizing and evaluating the technologies shaping the future of mobile communication.
   

  

 You will join Technology Testbeds within AI & Technology Foresight, part of Business Area Networks. We explore state-of-the-art technologies and concepts in practice before they become products.
   

  

 Our work sits at the intersection of research and product development. We build prototypes using advanced hardware and software design tools, create opportunities for patents, influence technology roadmap decisions and bridge the gap between research and product realization. Our focus areas include radio design, signal processing, AI/ML, software, emerging technologies and compute platforms.
