title: Principal Engineer
description:
We're at a pivotal moment for both Tibber and the planet. When joining Tibber, you won’t just help scale a forward-thinking tech company – you’ll contribute to a real shift in how people consume electricity. With millions of smart devices connected to the Tibber platform (like electric vehicles and smart thermostats), we have one of the most unique portfolios trading energy on the market.
 



  





 We’re looking for a
 **Principal Engineer** 
 to join us in making the energy transition happen – maybe that’s you?
 



  





**Job Mission 🚀** 




 As our
 **Principal Engineer** 
 , you'll report to our VP of Engineering and join our engineering org of ~80 people. You will serve as the technical authority driving the overarching architecture and engineering strategy across all of Tibber. You will bridge complex domain problems, from distributed real-time IoT pipelines to energy market integration, with resilient, high-scale software systems. Your work directly enables millions of smart devices to balance power grids across Europe, unlocking new horizons in sustainable energy consumption.
 



  





**What You'll Do ✅** 



* You will own the overall architecture and technical strategy for low-latency, highly resilient distributed systems capable of coordinating millions of connected smart devices in real time, working in close collaboration with senior staff and staff engineers to design and evolve these systems.



  




* You will set technical vision, standards, and best practices across domain teams, partnering with senior staff and staff engineers to drive engineering excellence and operational resilience.



  




* You will partner closely with product leaders and executive stakeholders to align long-term technical roadmaps with business objectives.



  




* You will evaluate emerging technologies, prototype novel concepts, and guide strategic tech-stack decisions to keep Tibber ahead of market shifts.



  




* You will mentor and empower senior engineering talent, elevating technical craft, architecture design capabilities, and problem-solving skills throughout the company.



  




* You will diagnose and solve systemic, high-impact architectural bottlenecks, ensuring seamless integration across energy trading, IoT, and user-facing platforms.



  




* You will champion platform reliability, security, and developer efficiency, removing technical friction for autonomous engineering teams.



  





**What We're Looking For⚡** 




 You are motivated by impact and know how to turn strategy into execution. You're used to fast-paced environments and thrive when given clear goals and high accountability. We believe you'll thrive here if you:
 


* Have demonstrable experience as a Principal, Staff, or Chief Engineer designing and operating mission-critical distributed systems at scale.



  




* Possess deep expertise in modern cloud architectures, event-driven microservices, high-throughput IoT streaming pipelines, or energy tech infrastructures.



  




* Demonstrate strong technical leadership and communication skills, with a track record of driving cross-functional alignment on high-stakes architecture decisions.



  




* Combine long-term strategic vision with a hands-on pragmatic approach, willing to dive into code or debug complex incidents when required.



  




* Are passionate about green technology, sustainable energy transition, and creating products that make a tangible environmental impact.



  




* You will set the bar for how we build with AI agents, and shape how the rest of engineering adopts new AI-driven ways of working



  





**The Tibber Mindset 💆🏻 ♀️💆🏽 ♂️** 




 Tibber exists to drive energy independence - away from fossil dependency. Our tech helps hundreds of thousands of households shift their electricity consumption to more sustainable and affordable hours - from electric vehicles to smart thermostats, all connected to the Tibber platform. We strengthen the resilience of the grid. Not in theory. In everyday life.
 



 We win, fail, and grow together, staying curious and pushing for better every day. AI is shaping how we work - and we're on a journey to make it central to everything we do. The further we go, the more our Tibberinos matter - and yes, that's what we call ourselves!
 



  





 Started by two founders in 2016. Now 300+ Tibberinos across Stockholm, Oslo, Berlin, Amsterdam, and Førde. And we're still just getting started.
 



  





 You're welcome at Tibber for who you are. We hire for what you can do and how you think - not your background or where you've been. Diverse teams build better products, and we mean that.

title: Cloud Security Engineer – Cloud Foundations | SEB, Solna
description:
Join Cloud Foundations and help shape the secure cloud platforms that enable development across SEB. You will build guardrails, landing zones and best practices that allow our developers to move quickly while meeting the bank’s security and compliance requirements.
   

  

 In this hands-on and analytical role, you will write code, build controls and solve the security challenges that come with them, working closely with the teams that use the platform. Most of the hands-on work sits in GCP, while your analysis, decisions and advice reach across all three of our clouds: AWS, Azure and GCP.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Develop and maintain our landing zones and underlying capabilities in SEB's public cloud platforms together with the team, with GCP as your primary platform and security, compliance and control as your focus.
* Take the lead on security questions, investigations and decisions.
* Act as the main point of contact for IT security: towards the group security organization, our stakeholders and our sister departments within infrastructure.
* Build preventive and detective controls: policies, guardrails and automated compliance checks used across the bank.
* Build log pipelines and detections together with our SOC, for large data volumes and high throughput.
* Review architecture, solve complex security problems and threat model new platform services before they reach production.
* Advise architects and development teams on the platform, and make it easy for them to do the right thing.
* Take part in incident response and investigations in our cloud environments.


**Who You Are**
 You are a driven, proactive and collaborative engineer who takes ownership and enjoys solving complex problems. You continuously look for better ways of working, value knowledge sharing, and contribute to an open and transparent team environment where learning and improvement are part of everyday work.
   

  

**Skills And Experience**
* Several years of cloud security work in GCP, AWS or Azure. The role's center of gravity is GCP, so if your background is mainly in another cloud, we expect you to want to grow into it.
* Hands-on with Infrastructure as Code, automation and CI/CD in tools such as Terraform and GitHub Actions.
* Scripting and development in PowerShell and Python.
* Identity and access management, network security, encryption and key management in the cloud.
* Log management, SIEM, detection or incident response.
* Observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana or the cloud providers' native tooling.
* Fluent English, spoken and written.


**Nice to have**
* Offensive security, penetration testing or security assessments.
* Experience in Financial services or another regulated industry.
* Certifications in cloud or application security, such as SANS/GIAC or CCSP.


**What We Offer**
* A technical team of around twenty people where you have real influence over the platform.
* Hands-on work across three cloud platforms, not just one.
* A hybrid workplace with a balance between office and home.
* SEB staff banking and our wider benefits package.
* An office next door to Mall of Scandinavia in Solna.


**Do you want to be part of SEB?**
 It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.
   

  

 We encourage you to submit your application no later than 28th of October via the link in this advertisement. If you have any questions about the position, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Mikaela Ahlstrand at mikaela.ahlstrand@seb.se. Kindly note that we do not accept applications via email.
   

  

 Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, a process that includes for example identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements and history of crime. In some cases, we also apply random drug checks. During employment, employees within SEB can also expect to undergo recurring background checks.
   

  

 SEB Sweden has a redeployment responsibility, which means that this position might be covered by internal redeployment.
   

  

 Learn more about working at SEB on our Career website or through our Career podcasts.
   

  

 sebgroup.com/career
   

  

 bit.ly/SEBcareer

title: Senior Application Consultant Dynamics 365 CE/CRM
description:
Accigos team inom Customer Engagement & Power Platform söker nu en person med djup kompetens inom Microsoft 365 CE/CRM som vill vara med och driva digital transformation hos våra kunder. Är du en prestigelös person med ett stort intresse för tekniska lösningar? Då kan den här möjligheten vara helt rätt för dig.
   

  

 Vad gör en senior applikationskonsult i vårt team?
   

  

 Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer i första hand vara att stötta teamet i tekniska problemlösningar i form av design och utveckling av lösningsarkitektur för Dynamics Customer Engagement (CRM). Du kommer att genomföra workshops för att analysera kundens affärsbehov och översätta dessa till tekniska krav och se till att utvecklingsteamet kan realisera dem. Du kommer även att arbeta med utveckling av nya system, vidareutveckla befintliga system, arbeta med systemdesign och applikationsutveckling, där ditt ansvar blir att driva tekniskt arbete och forma den framtida arkitekturen.
   

  

 Du kommer att tillhöra ett härligt team med sociala och drivna medarbetare som gillar att ha kul tillsammans både under och efter arbetstid.
   

  

 Kvalifikationer
   

  

* Minst 5 års erfarenhet av Dynamics 365 (Customer Engagement).
* Stark förståelse för CRM-processer, inklusive försäljning, kundservice och marknadsföring.
* Erfarenhet av att leda workshops och skapa tekniska dokumentationer.
* Förmåga att arbeta tvärfunktionellt med utvecklare, projektledare och andra intressenter.
* Certifieringar inom Dynamics 365 eller Azure är meriterande.
* Flytande i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.


 Du kommer att trivas hos oss
   

  

 Det här jobbet passar dig som är lösningsfokuserad, kundfokuserad och kvalitetsmedveten i din yrkesroll. För att passa i rollen behöver du också vara genuin i ditt bemötande med andra människor och har alltid inställningen att ge kunden bästa möjliga upplevelse. Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av agilt arbete och Dynamics 365 CE/CRM och ser det som meriterande om du har arbetat med Microsofts olika molntjänster tidigare.
   

  

**Vårt team**
 Accigos CRM-team består av en härlig mix av människor i olika åldrar, med olika erfarenheter och roller. Det vi alla har gemensamt är ett stort tekniskt intresse i allmänhet och för CRM i synnerhet. Vi brinner för det vi gör och för våra kunder.
   

  

 Vi är ett prestigelöst gäng som värdesätter humor och glädje och har en stöttande kultur där vi alltid hjälper varandra och där alla kan vara sig själva. Vi tycker om att umgås både på och utanför jobbet och olika teamaktiviteter är ett stående inslag.
   

  

 Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta med ny teknik från Microsoft och oftast i team-leveranser, främst med andra från CRM-teamet men även med konsulter från andra affärsområden på Accigo. För oss stärker det vi-känslan och säkrar både en bra leverans gentemot kunden samt glädje och balans i vardagen för oss konsulter.
   

  

 Kompensation och förmåner
   

  

 Vår förmånspolicy är utvecklad för att möta både dina professionella och personliga behov. I vårt omfattande förmånspaket ingår friskvårdsbidrag, tjänstepension och frivillig sjukvårdsförsäkring. Vår ersättningsmodell består av en konkurrenskraftig fast del och en rörlig del som ger dig möjlighet att påverka din lön baserat på din prestation och ambition. Vi erbjuder både professionell och personlig utveckling.
   

  

**Nyfiken?** 
 Vi svarar gärna på frågor, eller berättar mer om oss över en kaffe - du kan enkelt komma i kontakt med oss genom att maila: amir.hosseini@accigo.se
   

  

 Läs gärna mer om oss och träffa våra medarbetare på vår karriärsida: https://karriar.accigo.se/
   

  

 Accigo är ett konsultbolag som hjälper företag och organisationer med digital affärs- och verksamhetsutveckling med tekniken som möjliggörare. För oss handlar digitalisering till 90% om människor och 10% om teknik. Det är när samspelet mellan människa och teknik fungerar som digitaliseringens fulla styrka visar sig.
   

  

 För många handlar digitalisering mest om teknik. För oss är det så otroligt mycket större. Digitalisering kan få både människor och organisationer att våga sikta högre, följa sina drömmar och öppna dörrar som de inte ens visste fanns. Och när man ser igenom tekniken och börjar skönja vilka möjligheter som gömmer sig där bakom. Då ser man att framtiden kan vara en fantastisk plats – fylld av mänsklig energi och värme – och digitalisering är inget annat än vår superkraft för att komma dit.

title: Senior Design Verification Engineer
description:
**Senior Design Verification Engineer – 7+ Years** 




**Employment Type: FTC (1 year duration- Possibility renewable)** 




**Location: Sweden (Anywhere in Sweden is fine )** 




**Work Mode: Onsite 5 days Mandatory** 




**Interview Process: Virtual** 




  





**Please find the bellow job spec** 




 - 7+ years of hands-on experience in ASIC/SoC Design Verification using System Verilog and UVM.
 



 - Strong experience developing UVM testbenches from scratch at IP, subsystem, and full-chip levels.
 



 - Hands-on expertise in developing agents, drivers, monitors, scoreboards, reference models, sequences, and functional coverage.

title: Data Architect
description:
*Norrin is an AI integrator, enabling end-to-end Enterprise AI and data solutions that turn ambition into production and drive real productivity gains. We co-create the solutions, infrastructure, and adoption that make it stick. What brings us together is deep technical expertise, a creative engineering mindset, and a people-first culture. Norrin has strong roots in Finland while operating internationally across the Nordics, the United States, and APAC. Our presence across the Nordics has continued strengthening with BizOne recently joining the Norrin Group.*
 We’re now looking for a
 **Data Architect** 
 to join our team in Stockholm. In this role, you will build the bridge between business context and technical delivery, helping customers move from challenges to solid, practical solutions. You’ll collaborate closely with colleagues across Finland, Thailand, and Vietnam as part of our global delivery model. If you enjoy leading customer discussions, designing robust architectures, and turning complexity into clarity, you’ll fit right in.
   

  

**In this role, you will**
* Act as a trusted advisor and often the first point of contact for customers
* Lead discussions to understand customer processes, challenges, and objectives
* Translate business requirements into scalable, maintainable data architectures
* Design end-to-end solutions using Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Azure data services, or hybrid setups
* Guide customers through modernization and migration scenarios (e.g., SQL Server, Teradata)
* Take ownership of solution direction and provide architectural guidance to delivery teams, ensuring consistency and best practices throughout the project
* Provide architectural leadership through the full lifecycle, from pre-sales to delivery
* Communicate complex technical topics in a clear, business-oriented way
* Collaborate with Norrin’s engineering and BI teams to ensure smooth handovers and delivery success
* Stay current on new capabilities in Azure, Fabric, and Databricks to guide customers toward solutions that stand the test of time


**What We’re Looking For**

title: MCX & MSS Integration & Implementation Specialist (Mission Critical Communications Hub)
description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world's most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Through our Mission Critical Communication hub, you will help shape the future of secure communications in Sweden. Working at the intersection of technology, resilience, and public safety, you will contribute to solutions that strengthen society's preparedness for the future. Join us for a career full of opportunities, where you can make a difference and where no two days are the same.
   

  

**Your role**
 In this role you will support the architecture, device specification, integration, verification and implementation of Mission Critical Services (MCX) and MSS solutions, including MCX, TETRA/3GPP interworking, Agent solutions and Telematics.
   

  

 Depending on seniority and assignment, the role may operate as Solution Architect, Device Specification Lead, Integration Engineer, or Implementation/Technical Project Manager, taking responsibility from requirements and architecture through integration, testing and deployment.
   

  

 MCPTT is formally standardized by 3GPP with functional architecture and information flows defined in 3GPP TS 23.379. Current MCX interoperability work also covers MCPTT, MCData and MCVideo,
   

  

*In this role you will play a key role in:*
* Translate business and operational requirements into technical solution architecture
* Define end-to-end MCX, TETRA/3GPP interworking, Agent or Telematics solutions
* Define HLD/LLD, Interface specification, and technical requirements
* Conduct architecture and design reviews and identify technical and integration dependencies.
* Coordinate technical decisions across network, application, device and external supplier teams
* Integrate MCX/Agent/Telematics applications with telecom network and backend components
* Perform configuration, integration and end to end troubleshooting and verification
* Coordinate architecture, integration, test and deployment activities, defect resolution with vendors and internal engineering teams


**Your profile**
* Telecom architect with 10 years of strong experience across 4G/LTE and 5G NR, specially in Mission critical Network for MCX/MCPTT solution
* Hands-on experience in at least one of MCX, TETRA, 3GPP telecom architecture, telematics or mission-critical communications.
* Experience with solution architecture, integration, device specification or technical implementation.
* Good understanding of IP-based telecommunications and end-to-end system architecture.
* Experience working with multiple technical teams/vendors.
* Ability to troubleshoot across devices, applications and network components.


**What We Believe You Will Enjoy About Working Here**
* Working alongside leading experts in Mission Critical Communications.
* Being part of a collaborative community supporting the organizations that society depends on most.
* Operating at the intersection of strategy, technology, and execution in complex mission-critical environments.
* An inclusive culture that encourages learning and knowledge sharing, with opportunities for certifications, mentoring and professional growth. Application


 This role requires EU citizenship and is subject to security classification, meaning that a security screening will be carried out in accordance with Swedish legislation. As part of our recruitment process, identity verification will be conducted through inspection of your ID card, and background checks may be carried out as required.
   

  

**About Capgemini**
 Capgemini is the business transformation partner for enterprises in the age of AI. We help organizations imagine and build an intelligent, sustainable future, combining AI, technology and human ingenuity to transform how they operate, innovate, and grow. With unique end-to-end capabilities spanning strategy, technology, engineering and intelligent operations, we bring together deep industry expertise and market-leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data to turn ambition into measurable business outcomes at scale. Supported by a robust ecosystem of partners and nearly 60 years of expertise, Capgemini is a responsible and diverse global organization of over 410,000 team members in more than 50 countries. The Group reported 2025 revenues of €22.5 billion.
   

  

 Make it real | www.capgemini.com

description:

title: Code Validation Engineer - Thermal Hydraulics
description:
****What we do at Blykalla****
 Blykalla is a global leader in advanced nuclear technology, commercialising the next generation of clean, reliable energy through its lead-cooled reactor, the SEALER. By combining decades of specialised research with world-class partners, Blykalla is building the backbone of the global AI and industrial economy. For more information, visit https://www.blykalla.com.
   

  

****What you’ll get to do****
 We're seeking a Senior Thermal-Hydraulics Code Validation Engineer to join our Nuclear Engineering & Safety team, working from Stockholm or Oskarshamn. In this role, you will work on experiments with the aim of validating thermal-hydraulics system codes for use in the design and safety analysis of our lead-cooled fast reactors.
   

  

 More specifically, you will
   

  

* Coordinate, specify and analyze experiments to be run in our ARTS (Advanced Reactor Testing Site) facility in Oskarshamn.
* Act as a technical lead for engineers and technicians working on both the experiments and the simulation codes.
* Contribute to our validation program for thermal hydraulics system codes and associated methodologies.
* Stay current with advances in thermal hydraulics, computational methods, and regulatory requirements.


****Who you’ll get to work with****
 The thermal-hydraulics validation engineer sits in the Nuclear Engineering & Safety team within Blykalla, and reports to the manager of Nuclear Engineering & Safety. We are a diverse team that is passionate about our work and our company. You can choose to work from any of our offices in Stockholm, Oskarshamn or ARTS (at Simpevarp). In case of work from the Stockholm office, frequent (monthly) travel to the ARTS site is expected.
   

  

****Who you are****
 You will be part of a highly skilled team with a can-do attitude. We value personal chemistry and strive to create a workplace where you enjoy coming to. There are however a few things that we think will help for you to succeed in this role, these are:
   

  

* Master's degree in physics, engineering or a related field
* Hands-on experience in designing, commissioning, and performing thermal-hydraulic experiments, including instrumentation and data analysis
* Familiarity with building validation envelopes for system codes used in nuclear safety analysis such as BISON (BWR), TRACE, RELAP, APROS or similar as well as for CFD tools
* Solid understanding of the physics and phenomena involved in thermal hydraulics simulations
* A structured way of working, together with excellent problem-solving and technical writing skills
* Fluency in English, spoken and written


 Meritorious skills:
   

  

* Working experience in safety analysis of PWR, BWR or advanced reactors
* Working experience from liquid metal applications
* Experience in supporting nuclear licensing activities or in regulatory interaction
* Fluency in Swedish, spoken and written


 If you are not sure that you are 100% qualified, but are up to the challenge, we encourage you to apply.
   

  

**Location**
 This position is for our office in Stockholm, Oskarshamn or ARTS (Simpevarp)
   

  

**So, what do you think?**
 Don't miss the chance to be at the forefront of revolutionizing nuclear power. Join our team as Senior Thermal-Hydraulics Code Validation Engineer and help shape the energy landscape of tomorrow. Apply today with your resume and a cover letter highlighting your relevant experience and achievements.
   

  

 We are proud to foster an inclusive workplace free from discrimination. We strongly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and background will lead to a better environment for our employees and a better product. This is something we value deeply, and we encourage everyone to be a part of changing the way the world thinks about power supply!
   

  

**Reference & Background Checks**
 As part of our recruitment process, we conduct background checks on all candidates. We may also conduct reference checks to gain a well-rounded understanding of your professional experience, performance, and ways of working. This includes both references provided by you and, where relevant, conversations with other professional contacts who have worked closely with you. We strive to be transparent about our reference-checking process and handle all personal data in accordance with applicable data protection regulations. Any additional references will be sought with professional judgment and only when considered relevant to the role.
   

  

 Salary Range: SEK 57 000 - 95 000 / month, depending on experience and qualifications.
   

  

 We offer competitive compensation aligned with our internal salary framework and growth potential in the role.
   

  

**We do not accept applications via email.**
 We are not open to external help from recruitment agencies.
   

  

**Note on AI Use:** 
 Blykalla may use AI technology to assist with certain administrative aspects of the hiring process, such as note-taking, interview documentation, and reporting. However, every resume and application is reviewed directly by our recruiting team. AI tools are used solely for operational support and do not influence candidate evaluation or hiring decisions.

title: Lead Data Analyst
description:
**Job Description**

 As a Lead Data Analyst focused on Analytics engineering, you will play a key role in raising the analytical and technical maturity of our Data Analysts by establishing standards, providing hands-on guidance and enabling analysts to build robust and scalable data products.
   

  





 You will lead the development and adoption of Analytics Engineering practices across the organization, helping teams improve how data is modeled, governed, and consumed. Through upskilling, knowledge sharing, and creation of reusable frameworks and assets, you will strengthen our analytics capabilities and help establish a more consistent way of working with data.
   

  





 The role requires a high degree of autonomy, initiative taking, and collaboration. You will proactively identify opportunities to improve data practices, drive cross-functional initiatives, and build alignment across diverse stakeholder groups. Success in this role depends on your ability to balance strategic priorities with execution, navigate a complex organization and data landscape, and help teams deliver analytical solutions that are scalable, maintainable and aligned with business needs.
   

  





**WHAT YOU'LL DO**



* Lead complex analytical initiatives end-to-end, from problem framing and data exploration to data modeling, analysis and actionable recommendations.
* Partner with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to translate strategic questions and business needs into analytical approaches, scalable data models, and actionable insights.
* Lead the development of reusable data assets, templates, and frameworks that streamline work and promote scalability.
* Champion best practices in Analytics Engineering through the data analytics community, including data modeling, testing, documentation and maintainability of analytical data products, ensuring the support both traditional analytics and emerging AI driven use cases.
* Own and drive the Analytics Engineering community for Data Analysts, establishing standards and fostering collaboration across the organization.
* Design and deliver training sessions, workshops, and documentation to upskill colleagues in tools, methodologies, and data interpretation.
* Proactively identify and act on opportunities to improve data literacy and analytical capabilities across the organization.
* Mentor colleagues and contribute to a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.



**WHO YOU ARE** 
  

  





*We are looking for people with...*



* Proven experience leading complex analytical initiatives and influencing analytical direction across teams or domains.
* Strong business understanding and ability to translate complex or ambiguous business needs into clear analytical questions, approaches, and recommendations.
* Experience driving standards, best practices, and ways of working across teams through influence, coaching, and collaboration.
* Proven experience mentoring and developing colleagues through coaching, training, and knowledge sharing.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain complex analytical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* High proficiency in SQL and strong understanding of data modeling principles.
* Experience developing and maintaining analytical data products using tools such as dbt, Power Query, or similar.
* Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts and modern analytics architectures.
* Experience with version control (Git) and CI/CD practices within analytics workflows.

* Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

 Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.
