title: Founding CTO
description:
**The Opportunity** 




  





 We’re working with an early-stage technology company building an AI-powered revenue management and enterprise automation platform for large international organisations.
 



  





 The business already has paying enterprise customers, further major enterprise discussions underway and a seven-person distributed engineering/product team.
 



  





 They are now looking for a Founding CTO to join the founding team, take ownership of the technology strategy and build the engineering organisation as the company scales.
 



  





 This isn't a blank-sheet build. A substantial platform already exists, and the Founding CTO will inherit a strong technical foundation while having the freedom to shape its future architecture and technology.
 



  





**The Role** 




**You’ll take ownership of:** 



* Technology strategy, architecture and technical roadmap
* Enterprise automation and agentic AI systems
* Scalability, security and engineering quality
* Building and leading a Swedish/European engineering team
* Technical and security discussions with enterprise customers
* Technology and architecture decisions as the platform scales



  





 The role will initially be hands-on, moving towards predominantly technical and organisational leadership as the team grows.
 



  





**About You** 




**We’re looking for someone with:** 



* Strong software engineering and systems architecture experience
* Experience with enterprise automation, agentic AI or workflow systems
* A background building scalable enterprise applications
* Strong security understanding
* The credibility to work directly with large enterprise customers
* Hands-on development capability
* A technology-agnostic approach to architecture
* The ambition to build and lead an engineering organisation



  





**The Setup** 




  





 The team currently works together in Sweden around 3–4 days per week, alongside distributed engineers internationally.
 



  





 Initially, the Founding CTO will contribute approximately 20–30 hours per week, with flexibility around when those hours are worked. Following the planned fundraising round, the position will transition to full-time.
 



  





 The initial arrangement is primarily equity-based, transitioning to a market-rate salary + meaningful founder-level equity following fundraising.
 



  





 A rare opportunity to join an already functioning and commercially validated platform as Founding CTO, with genuine ownership over the technology, team and future direction of the business.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
Do you see the potential in every team member and step up when leadership is needed? We’re looking for passionate, empathetic leaders who want to bring out the best in people while building value-driven software development teams. We believe in simplicity and a just-do-it attitude, where everyone is empowered to contribute and make a difference.
   

  

 Do you combine a strong technical foundation built on hands-on coding experience with curiosity, passion, and a genuine interest in leadership? If so, come join us and make an impact.
   

  

**As an Engineering Manager, you will**
* Build and lead collaborative and empowered teams
* Support the growth and development of Engineers
* Create a learning environment
* Champion Nordnet's tech strategy and ensure we maintain technical excellence in all aspects of our team.
* Lead by example, guiding your team through technical challenges and problem-solving.
* Practice servant leadership by enabling and empowering others
* Learn, share and collaborate closely with other Engineering Managers


**You And Your Skills**
* You have a strong technical background and when needed can dive into technical discussions
* You have worked with leadership, developing and growing product development teams.
* You are curious and open-minded, have an always learning mindset and see mistakes as opportunities for growth.
* You are supportive and caring, lead with empathy, transparency, and trust
* You are a change leader, brave in pushing through friction
* You have a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
* You prefer working in the office


**Culture at Nordnet Engineering**
* A just-do-it attitude, where everyone feels enabled and valued
* We live and breathe technology taking pride in our work
* We take a scientific approach by experimenting and learning
* We welcome new ideas and encourage everyone to speak up
* We are curious and forward leaning


**This is us**
 At Nordnet, technology is at the core of everything we do, driving innovation and maintaining our competitive edge. As an Engineering Manager, you'll be at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge technology like Google Cloud Platform, React/React Native, and Java to shape our web and mobile experiences. We’ve made over 50 000 production releases last year, releasing our web every other hour and our app every two days.
   

  

 We offer you the opportunity to work in a Nordic environment with a strong focus on delivery, product development and technology. Our ambitions are high and you will embark on a fast and challenging journey together with a skillful team of sharp and committed colleagues.
   

  

 Culture is built and cared for, each day by everyone. We’re proud of ours. Having a flat organization where anyone can talk to anyone creates a warm and friendly atmosphere worth protecting. We believe in a culture where every effort counts and where everyone is being recognized. A culture embracing our core values – passion, simplicity and transparency on all levels, no matter who you are or what you do.
   

  

 In 1996, Nordnet redefined the financial world as the first digital bank in Europe. Now we are about to do it again with the aim of creating the next generation of bank, in the cloud. We know that this requires great people, great teams, and great technology.
   

  

**Do you want to join us and build the new Nordnet?**
 Apply today! – Please note that we only accept applications through our recruitment system. We do not consider email applications.
   

  

 If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to our Talent Acquisition Partner, Linnea Liljedahl linnea.liljedahl@nordnet.se
   

  

 At Nordnet, we value diversity and inclusion, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can succeed.
   

  

 As part of our recruitment process, we conduct mandatory credit and background checks, as well as drug testing.
   

  

 We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Engineering Manager
description:
SAVR is a fast-growing Swedish fintech company on a mission to reinvent investing. We empower investors with a platform that offers
 **lower fees** 
 ,
 **greater transparency** 
 , and a
 **radically improved experience** 
 .
 



  





 We’re not just building another investment service - we’re reimagining how financial products should work for people, not just institutions. As part of our ambitious, innovative and curious team, you’ll help shape the future of investing in Sweden and beyond.
 



  





**The Role** 




 As an Engineering Manager, you will lead and coach a cross-functional team of 6–8 engineers across frontend, backend, and AI/ML. Your focus will be on building a high-trust, accountable environment where engineers take ownership of their work and grow their skills, while also contributing to technical initiatives and ensuring reliable delivery. You’ll balance people leadership with hands-on engagement, guiding outcomes and helping individuals grow.
 



  





**Your Mission** 



* Partner with your Product Manager to plan, scope, and deliver roadmap goals that drive customer and business impact.
* Own selected technical projects, often with suppliers or partners, ensuring smooth execution from requirements to rollout.
* Build a healthy, high-trust team by setting clear expectations, coaching individuals, and empowering engineers to take ownership of their growth and delivery.
* Raise the team’s competence and practices by championing effective rituals, continuous learning, and strong communication.
* Ensure system health and reliability through meaningful monitoring, observability, and post-mortem learning.
* Promote engineering excellence by driving quality, CI/CD, and operational readiness before launch.
* Act as a facilitator-leader - guiding trade-offs, unblocking decisions, and creating space for experts to excel.
* Continuously improve how the team works by introducing better ways of working and helping the org adopt them.



  





**Day-to-Day Responsibilities** 



* Co-own backlog, scope, and planning with the Product Manager.
* Run effective execution rituals (standups, planning, reviews) with transparent risk management.
* Lead feedback conversations, performance reviews, and growth plans.
* Partner with the Tech Lead on architecture decisions and technical strategy; contribute code when it’s high leverage.
* Coordinate work with suppliers/partners and manage integrations.
* Oversee access management, compliance, and KPI/observability work.
* Lead by example and contribute to the codebase, such as solving bugs or deliver on features.



  





**Additionally, You Will** 



* Promote good engineering practices and constructive code reviews.
* Foster a learning culture that values feedback and continuous skill development.
* Influence platform roadmap and tech stack evolution.
* Balance short-term delivery with long-term sustainability and simplicity.



  





**You’ll Thrive in This Role If You…** 



* Multiple years of experience from software engineering.
* Have experience leading cross-functional engineering teams in a product environment.
* Can balance hands-on technical contribution with people leadership.
* Are motivated by coaching, developing others, and raising the competence of your team.
* Care deeply about reliable systems, observability, and safe, compliant delivery.
* Demonstrate accountability, empathy, and a growth mindset.
* Communicate clearly in English and/or Swedish.
* Are eligible to work in Sweden (Swedish citizen or EU work permit) - we’re unable to offer visa sponsorship.



  





**Our Cultural DNA** 




 At SAVR, we’re:
 



 🧠
 **Open-minded** 
 – we embrace new ideas, diverse perspectives, and continuous learning
 



 🚀
 **Bold** 
 – we take smart risks, move fast, and aren’t afraid to fail forward
 



 🤝
 **Honest** 
 – we value transparency, feedback, and doing the right thing
 



  





 We’re a startup, so things can be a little messy — and that’s part of the thrill. If you thrive in building as a team and handling uncertainty, you will fit right in.
 



  





**What’s In It for You** 




 You’ll join a product- and design-driven company where your work has real impact. We keep things lean, move fast, and genuinely care about the experience we deliver — for customers and for each other.
 



 Here’s what we offer:
 



  





 💻 Top-tier work gear
 



 💰 Competitive salary
 



 🏃 ♀️ Generous wellness allowance
 



 🤒 Insurance package
 



 🌱 Occupational pension and long-term savings support
 



 🏢
 *Office-first approach* 
 to foster collaboration and quick decision-making — with flexibility when you need it (4+1)
 



 🥗
 *Stocked pantry* 
 , plus regular social gatherings and wellness activities to keep energy and culture high
 



  





**Our Commitment to Diversity** 




 SAVR is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome people from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. We believe diverse teams build better products and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.
 



  





**Ready to Join Us?** 




 We’d love to hear from you. Apply now or reach out with any questions — and let’s build something meaningful together.

title: IT & Finance Coordinator till Axfood IT
description:
*Vi söker dig som trivs med ansvar inom ekonomi, IT och struktur. I rollen som IT & Finance Coordinator på Axfood IT arbetar du med debitering, prissättning och uppföljning av IT‑tillgångar, med fokus på datakvalitet, samarbete och förbättringsarbete.* 




  





**Om tjänsten** 




 Det här är ett konsultuppdrag med goda möjligheter till överrekrytering. I den här rollen får du första 12 månaderna en anställning hos Bravura, och det är uttalat att Axfood IT har för avsikt att erbjuda dig anställning hos dem på sikt. Detta ger både dig och Axfood IT en bra möjlighet att lära känna varandra samt utvärdera hur ni trivs med ert samarbete.
 



  





**Om företaget** 




 Axfood är en av de största aktörerna inom dagligvaruhandeln med butiker som Hemköp och Willys. Axfood IT ansvarar för IT-lösningar som stöttar hela Axfoodkoncernen – från butik till centrala funktioner. IT-organisationen består i dagsläget av 400 anställda fördelade på utveckling och leverans. De utmanar ständigt för att ligga i framkant gällande digitalisering och för att ha marknadens nöjdaste kunder. Du tillhör Asset Management-teamet och samarbetar tätt med både interna team och externa leverantörer. Kulturen präglas av ansvarstagande, samarbete och en vilja att förbättra arbetssätt och system över tid.
 



  





 Hos Axfood IT blir du del av ett sammanhang som utmanar och levererar lösningar som gör skillnad, både för kollegor och kunder. Inom organisationen finns det alltid möjlighet att lära sig om ny teknik och växa, både som individ och tillsammans med kollegorna.
 



  





**Arbetsuppgifter** 




 Rollen som IT & Finance Coordinator till Axfood IT är både analytisk och operativ, med många kontaktytor. Du ansvarar för att debitering och prissättning av IT-utrustning fungerar korrekt, är uppdaterad och baserad på rätt data. En viktig del av arbetet handlar om att förvalta och utveckla interna verktyg och Power Apps, säkerställa god datakvalitet i produktkataloger samt följa upp kostnader kopplade till IT Store Operations.
 



  





 Du arbetar nära interna team, leverantörer, partners och bidrar aktivt i automatisering samt till förbättring av processer. Rollen innebär även att ta fram analyser, rapporter och beslutsunderlag samt att stötta teamet med administration och dokumentation. Du deltar i budgetarbete och prognoser samt är en viktig del i att utveckla rutiner och systemstöd framåt.
 



  





 Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:
 


* Ansvar för butiksdebitering, inklusive debiteringsmodeller, prissättning, löpande uppdateringar samt intäktsbudget och kostnadsunderlag kopplat till butik
* Samverka med interna team, leverantörer och partners som t.ex. Infocare, Zebra och Toshiba
* Arbeta med priskalkyler baserat på rörliga faktorer, kostnadsförändringar och täckningsbidrag
* Förvalta och vidareutveckla Power Apps och verktyg för prissättning, budget och överlämningar
* Säkerställa struktur och datakvalitet i produktkataloger
* Ta fram rapporter, analyser och beslutsunderlag samt följa upp kostnader inom IT Store Operations



  





**Utbildning, erfarenhet och personliga egenskaper** 



* Erfarenhet av liknande arbetsuppgifter inom debitering, prissättning, controlling eller IT-nära administration
* Mycket god vana av att arbeta med stora datamängder i Excel
* God förståelse för ekonomiska samband och kostnadsdrivare
* Förmåga att arbeta strukturerat, noggrant och självständigt
* God kommunikativ förmåga och vana att samarbeta med många kontaktytor



  





 Det är även meriterande med:
 


* Erfarenhet av Asset Management, IT-utrustning eller produktkataloger
* Erfarenhet av systemförvaltning eller arbete med interna appar
* Erfarenhet av automatisering eller processutveckling



  





 I den här rollen trivs du som tar ett tydligt ansvar för ditt arbete och driver dina uppgifter självständigt från start till mål. Samtidigt är du en lagspelare som värdesätter samarbete och har lätt för att bygga fungerande relationer med olika kontaktytor. Du har ett analytiskt förhållningssätt, är lösningsorienterad och noggrann, särskilt när det gäller data, prissättning och ekonomiska underlag.
 



  





 Du arbetar metodiskt, har god ordning i ditt arbete och kommunicerar tydligt i både dialog och dokumentation. Rollen passar dig som uppskattar en vardag där struktur, datakvalitet och operativt ansvar är centrala och där du bidrar till att förbättra arbetssätt och processer över tid.
 



  





**Övrig information** 




 Start: Omgående
 



 Plats: Torsplan, Stockholm
 



 Lön: Enligt överenskommelse
 



  





 Vi använder en kompetensbaserad metodik i alla rekryteringsprocesser för att säkerställa fördomsfria urval. Vi jobbar också med löpande urval, vilket innebär att vi tar ner annonsen när tillräckligt många kandidater har ansökt. Om du blir aktuell för tjänsten kommer vi att kontakta dig för en första telefonintervju. Oavsett om du går vidare i processen eller inte så kommer du att få återkoppling på din ansökan.
 



  





 Har du frågor? Hör gärna av dig!
 



 📧
 
 info@bravura.se
 




 📞 010-171 47 10
 



 Vi rekommenderar att du skickar in din ansökan omgående då vi gör ett löpande urval.
 



  





 Välkommen med din ansökan!
 



 #Brillante

title: Junior Associate - Tech & AI
description:
**Who You'll Work With**
 Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.
   

  

 In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.
   

  

 When you join us, you will have:
   

  

* Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
* A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
* Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
* World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.


**Your Impact**
 As a junior associate, you will join a client service team and take ownership of a workstream to solve some of the toughest challenges our clients face.
   

  

 Your clients aren’t just any clients, they're some of the most influential organizations around, from Fortune 500 giants to innovative startups. We will expect you to go the extra mile, delivering solutions that solve immediate problems and drive long-term change, and we’ll rely on your judgment and integrity to ensure our recommendations are effective and long-lasting.
   

  

 You will take on a role that goes beyond advising. You’ll be at the heart of the action—helping to uncover the true challenges behind a client’s strategy and creating actionable plans that drive real change. Working alongside clients and other McKinsey colleagues, you’ll combine research, analyzing data, interviews, and brainstorming to generate fresh insights and breakthrough solutions. Your commitment to our values will be crucial in earning our clients' trust and delivering results that matter.
   

  

 As you collaborate directly with clients, you’ll help them solve problems, refine strategies, and implement transformations. By equipping them with the tools and knowledge to continue innovating and improving after we’ve left, you’ll ensure the impact of our work endures. In doing so, you’ll uphold McKinsey’s commitment to making a meaningful difference in the industries and communities we serve.
   

  

 Our consultants within our Tech & AI practice help clients unlock the power of AI at scale, modernize technology delivery, and build new businesses to fuel growth.
   

  

**Your Qualifications and Skills**
**Read more about our work here.**
* Degree in technical subjects such as computer science, engineering, IT, hard sciences, physics or mathematics; advanced degree is a plus
* Excellent organizational capabilities, including the ability to initiate tasks independently and see them through to completion
* Proficient in rational decision making based on data, facts, and logical reasoning
* Ability to create work product-focused materials / outputs, which may include PowerPoint decks, Excel models, articles, or other written deliverables
* Exceptional time management to meet your responsibilities in a complex and largely autonomous work environment
* Ability to work or attend meetings outside of traditional business hours or take on projects with limited or no notice at times
* Ability to travel to and work in varying environments that may be challenging and/or not accessible (e.g., factories, hospitals, mines)
* Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, in English, with the ability to adjust your style to suit different perspectives and seniority levels

title: Senior Consultant Dynamics 365 Business Central Supply Chain
description:

Ser du precis som vi enorma möjligheter för D365 Business Central och vill vara med och arbeta med marknadens bästa erbjudande för våra kunder? Är du dessutom en kommunikativ och relationsskapande person som vill arbeta med verksamhetsutveckling? Då är det här jobbet helt rätt för dig.*
**Väx inom Business Central på Accigo**
 Vi söker dig med erfarenhet av Supply Chain-processer samt har arbetat med verksamhetsutveckling och digitalisering. I rollen kommer du att utveckla våra kunders affär genom att arbeta nära dem i deras affärsprocesser och bygga förtroende som konsult tillsammans med dina kollegor i teamet.  Vi söker inte bara fler konsulter. Vi söker personer som vill vara med och forma nästa kapitel för Business Central på Accigo. Samtidigt får du tillgång till specialistkompetens från hela Microsoft-ekosystemet och möjlighet att arbeta tillsammans med några av branschens främsta experter.

**Vi vill att du har**

* Erfarenhet av implementationer, uppgraderingar eller större förändringsprojekt
* Erfarenhet inom Supply chain- och/eller Retail processer
* God kommunikativ förmåga och vana att arbeta nära verksamhet och kund

* Förmåga att driva dialoger, workshops eller kravdiskussioner tillsammans med kunder
* Nyfikenhet på hur ny teknik, data och AI kan bidra till verksamhetsutveckling och affärsvärde
* Ett prestigelöst mindset, och trivs med att arbeta i team

title: CMDB-Analyst till Lantmännen!
description:
*Vill du använda din kompetens inom CMDB, datamodellering och ITSM i en verksamhet där tillförlitlig information är avgörande för både säkerhet och utveckling? Hos Lantmännen får du en central specialistroll där du skapar struktur och kontroll över en komplex IT- och OT-miljö och bidrar till ökad spårbarhet och regelefterlevnad.*
**Din vardag**
 Som CMDB Analyst ansvarar du för att informationen i Lantmännens CMDB är korrekt, strukturerad, tillgänglig och användbar. Du arbetar operativt med att samla in, verifiera och uppdatera information, samtidigt som du utvecklar arbetssätt som stärker datakvaliteten över tid.
   

  

 Som CMDB Analyst är en viktig del av rollen är att skapa struktur och tydliga samband i CMDB:n, så att informationen ger en tillförlitlig bild av organisationens IT-miljö. Du följer löpande upp kvaliteten, identifierar avvikelser och driver förbättringar. På så sätt bidrar du till att CMDB:n blir ett relevant stöd för såväl ITSM-processer som tekniska team och verksamheten.
   

  

 Rollen har även en tydlig koppling till OT, Operational Technology. Här bidrar du till kontroll, spårbarhet, säkerhet och regelefterlevnad i industriella miljöer, bland annat genom att stödja OT Security med uppdaterade inventeringar och tillförlitlig information.
   

  

 Organisatoriskt tillhör du Lantmännens centrala IT-organisation och teamet IT Operations & Security Center, där specialistkompetens inom bland annat CMDB, ITSM och säkerhet samlas. Du får många kontaktytor och samarbetar med såväl kollegor inom Group IT som verksamhetsnära IT-funktioner och externa partners. Tjänsten kan vara placerad i Malmö eller Stockholm
   

  

**Vem är du?**

* Gedigen erfarenhet av CMDB, datastrukturer och datamodellering, inklusive datakvalitet och data dictionaries.
* Erfarenhet av både OT-miljöer och IT-tjänster.
* God kunskap om ITIL och ITSM.
* Erfarenhet från större organisationer med flera IT-tjänster och många kontaktytor.

 Det är meriterande om du har en ITIL 4-certifiering och erfarenhet från internationella organisationer eller av att arbeta över olika länder och kulturer.

title: Supplier Data Analyst
description:
**The Role And Key Responsibilities**
 The position of Supplier Data Analyst involves utilizing data to transform supplier information into useful insights. This supports NCC's aim to improve competitiveness, manage risks proactively, and achieve long-term profitability and customer value.
   

  

 This position involves cross-functional collaboration with stakeholders across the organization.
   

  

**Your main responsibilities include:**
* Reporting, Visualization and Empowering of teams: The role entails being the main contact for projects related to reporting supplier deviations identified at the company level. It involves visualizing accurate information regarding supplier relations and performance to empower teams. Thereby the role enables decision-making within business areas, creating reports on assigned supplier deviations according to each business area’s process, and working proactively with risk management throughout the purchasing process.
* Advanced Data Analysis: Key responsibilities include screening, monitoring and quality-checking supplier performance through data analysis, managing the supplier base in designated tools, and serving as the operative point of contact for the projects related to deviations identified in the tools.
* Establish Processes and Structures: Additional duties include internal support within Supplier Quality & Risk Management concerning data analysis of supplier performance, supporting the development of capabilities, systems, tools, and guidelines related to supplier management within NCC, and collaborating with other purchasing units and stakeholders. The role also requires staying informed about relevant rules and regulations, participating in early stages of projects with departments such as sales, purchasing, legal, and tender organizations focused on risk mitigation related to supplier control, and coordinating with both internal and external auditors.


**About Purchasing At NCC**
 NCC Purchasing is a network of professionals across countries and functions in the company. We handle everything from project purchasing and supplier base development to strategic sourcing and category management. Collaboration between our teams is key to win and deliver profitable customer projects.
   

  

**Your Experience And Background**
 We are looking for a person who is proactive, result-oriented and who has a structured approach to work. You have a strong collaborative mindset with focus on building relationships across functions. We also see that you are analytical and able to handle complexity in strategic and operational tasks.
   

  

 It is furthermore important that you embrace self-leadership and have an exceptional drive and ‘get it done’ mentality and don’t hesitate to try different approaches to find your way forward. Communicating complexity in a crisp and clear way comes natural to you, and we believe you have a great ability to quickly “connect the dots” and connect independent issues to the bigger picture.
   

  

**Requirements specification:**
* Academic degree or equivalent work life experience
* High learnability: Willingness and capacity to constantly develop your skills and seek new ways to improve your work
* Analytical & Problem-Solving Mindset: Strong analytical skills and able to make data driven decisions. We also believe that you have a proactive approach to identifying and solving your challenges.
* Empowerment Focus: A passion for teaching and empowering others in data literacy and analytics skills.
* Proactive communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across diverse teams.
* Communicates fluently in both writing and speaking in Swedish and English
* Self-leadership and able to prioritize as well as able to take responsibility, lead and drive assignments
* Business acumen and economic understanding.
* Understands the importance of legislation compliance and have knowledge of administrative legislation such as tax and labor laws as well as local/country construction legislation and understanding of contracts and legal documents
* Understands how sustainability is an integrated part of the purchasing process
* Has ability to navigate in complex IT environment and flexibility to learn and adapt to new platforms supporting efficient working methods and data-informed decision-making
* Experience from working with Power BI and data visualization tools


 If you meet these criteria and are ready to contribute to our Purchasing Transformation journey, we invite you to apply. Your passion, drive, and commitment will help us achieve new heights through digitalization and innovation in the construction industry.
   

  

**NCC Offers**
 NCC strives to be an appealing employer, providing a work environment where employees can grow and experience well-being. We offer a wide range of employee benefits. NCC has collective agreements for all employees, providing a solid foundation of security and clear guidelines so that you know what applies to your employment. We also offer excellent opportunities for continued development and a broad range of further education options, allowing for a long career within the company.
   

  

**Additional Information**
 This position can be based in one of NCC’s main offices in Sweden, in the Oslo office in Norway or Helsinki office in Finland. The job requires regular travel, however, we encourage flexible working and digital collaboration whenever possible.
   

  

 In accordance with NCCs safety culture we conduct background checks on final candidates.
   

  

**Contact and information**
 For more information, please contact recruiting manager Ida Vestin, Manager of Supplier Intelligence, +46790727590 or Gunilla Glännå, Recruitment Consultant, gunilla.glanna@ncc.se, +46790788170.
   

  

 Register your application and CV below. Applications are reviewed continuously, so apply as soon as possible, and no later than
 **5th of November 2026.**
**Are you ready to turn data into powerful decisions that shape the future of purchasing?**
 We’re looking for a driven and curious Supplier Data Analyst to join our Supplier Intelligence team at NCC! Purchasing is a top priority at NCC, playing a key role in securing long-term success in winning and delivering profitable customer projects. As Supplier Data Analyst you’ll support the transformation of data into actionable insights, empowering informed, strategic and risk-aware actions that drive success.

title: Thesis Work - Seeing Beneath the Surface: A Data Fusion Approach to Bathymetric Mapping
description:
*Are you a student looking to apply your knowledge to real-world solutions that support the energy transition? With us, you will have the opportunity to complete your thesis project close to the business, working alongside experienced specialists and tackling challenges where your ideas and perspectives can make a real difference* 
 .
   

  

**About The Thesis Work**
 The goal of this thesis is to develop a data fusion approach that combines satellite imagery, drone imagery/photogrammetry and ROV sonar measurements to produce accurate, high-resolution bathymetric maps for a shallow water area that is subjected to water regulation for hydropower generation by Vattenfall.
   

  

 The project will investigate how machine learning / deep learning methods can be used to align, calibrate and merge these heterogeneous, multi-resolution data sources into a single consistent depth model, using the sparse but accurate ROV measurements to correct and validate the wide-area satellite- and drone-derived depth estimates. A further purpose of the thesis is to combine the fused bathymetry with above-water elevation and terrain data to build a full 3D reconstruction of the basin, which will be used to estimate the water volume of the area.
   

  

**The Following Steps Are Foreseen To Execute The Project**
* Literature review of satellite-derived bathymetry, drone-based photogrammetry/LiDAR and ROV sonar surveying methods, and existing data fusion techniques.
* Data acquisition and collection of satellite, drone and ROV data for the area of interest.
* Pre-process and co-register the multi-source data (satellite, drone, ROV) to a common spatial and depth reference.
* Develop and apply a data fusion model (e.g. machine learning / deep learning based) to combine the multi-source bathymetric data into a unified depth map.
* Perform elevation and terrain analysis and build a 3D reconstruction of the basin (bathymetry + surrounding terrain) to estimate the water volume.
* Evaluate and validate the fused bathymetry model performance against reference/ground-truth measurements. Several field campaigns will be carried out during the thesis period to collect validation data.


 The thesis assignment is suitable for 1 student
   

  

**Qualifications**
 We are looking for a student who are about to complete their academic studies and are eager to apply their knowledge in a real-world setting through a thesis project at Vattenfall. You are someone who shares our values and identifies with our principles: Active, Open, Positive and Safety.
   

  

* Enrolled in an MSc programme in Geomatics, Remote Sensing, Computer Science, Applied Physics, Environmental or Civil Engineering, or a related field.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Swedish language skills are considered an advantage.
* Strong programming skills in Python.
* Experience with data analysis and relevant tools such as NumPy, PyTorch, TensorFlow, GDAL, Rasterio, or GIS software.
* Knowledge of, or a strong interest in, remote sensing, image processing, machine learning, and deep learning.
* Basic understanding of GIS principles and geospatial data formats, including raster data, point clouds, and coordinate systems.
* Interest in applying satellite-based data to environmental analysis and biodiversity-related challenges.
* Experience working with satellite imagery, drone data, or sonar/acoustic survey data is considered an advantage.
* Ability to work independently, structure and document work systematically, and communicate results effectively.


 Additional Information
   

  

* Start date: 2027-04-01 or by agreement.

title: System Engineer -Tactical Data Links
description:
*Passionate about making ideas a reality? Join our welcoming world of tech and let your ideas soar.*
 Your Role
   

  

 Do you want to help ensure that naval platforms can share real-time situational awareness and tactical information with NATO allies around the world? Do you have experience working with Link 16, Link 22, MIDS, JREAP, Combat Management Systems, or other tactical communication solutions? If so, this could be an opportunity for you.
   

  

 As a
 **Systems Engineer specializing in NATO Tactical Data Links**

 **Naval Combat Systems** 
 , where we develop the next generation of advanced naval defense solutions. You will work in a multidisciplinary environment, designing, developing, maintaining, and supporting mission-critical communication capabilities for both domestic and international military platforms.
   

  

 Your responsibilities will include:
   

  

* Design and Development: Collaborate with customers, engineers, suppliers, and military stakeholders to design and develop state-of-the-art Tactical Data Link solutions, ensuring interoperability and compliance with NATO standards and doctrines.
* Systems Integration: Play a key role in integrating Tactical Data Link capabilities into advanced Naval Combat Systems, enabling seamless communication and information exchange across multiple platforms and units.
* Testing and Verification: Participate in testing and verification activities to ensure system reliability, security, performance, and operational effectiveness.
* Maintenance and Support: Provide ongoing support for deployed systems, troubleshoot technical issues, and implement enhancements to improve system functionality and availability.
* Training and Documentation: Contribute to the development of technical documentation and user training materials to ensure effective operation and understanding of system capabilities.
* Collaboration and Stakeholder Management: Work closely with cross-functional teams and external partners in an international environment, communicating technical solutions and driving successful project outcomes.
* Continuous Improvement: Stay current with developments in Tactical Data Links and related defense technologies, identifying opportunities to improve system performance and operational capability.


 In this role, you will contribute to the continued development of some of the world's most advanced naval combat systems. Our solutions are deployed on naval platforms such as surface vessels and submarines, where they integrate information from sensors, tactical data links, and weapon systems to provide operators with the best possible decision support in demanding operational environments.
   

  

 Your Profile
   

  

 This position requires experience from similar roles and technical domains within the defense industry or other highly complex system environments. We believe you bring experience in one or more of the following areas:
   

  

* Tactical Data Links, such as Link 16, Link 22, JREAP, MIDS, or equivalent solutions.
* Combat Management Systems.
* C4ISR systems.
* Military communication systems.
* Complex system integration and systems-of-systems environments.


 We are looking for someone who combines technical expertise with a proactive and structured approach to problem-solving. You are an effective communicator who enjoys collaborating with stakeholders from diverse technical and operational backgrounds and can build strong professional relationships across the organization.
   

  

 To be successful in this role, you should also have:
   

  

* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Strong systems engineering knowledge and experience working with complex technical systems.
* In-depth understanding of NATO Tactical Data Links, including Link 16, Link 22, JREAP-C, associated standards, architectures, and interoperability requirements.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to think critically, solve complex problems, and adapt to evolving operational requirements.
* Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken.
* Experience working in multinational environments and collaborating with a wide range of stakeholders.


 We offer specialized training programs tailored to your experience and development goals, along with the opportunity to work alongside highly skilled and engaged colleagues in a collaborative environment. This role provides a unique opportunity to build deep expertise in naval combat systems and tactical data links, creating a strong foundation for continued professional growth and future career opportunities within the organization.
   

  

 This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around/of security protection. For positions requiring security clearance additional obligations on citizenship may apply.
   

  

 What you will be part of
   

  

 Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.
   

  

 Saab is a leading defence and security company with an enduring mission, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by its 28,000 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.
   

  

 Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defence capability of several nations. Read more about us here

title: Thesis Work - Identifying distributed energy resources from consumption patterns
description:
*Are you a student looking to apply your knowledge to real-world solutions that support the energy transition? With us, you will have the opportunity to complete your thesis project close to the business, working alongside experienced specialists and tackling challenges where your ideas and perspectives can make a real difference.*
**About The Thesis Work**
 Vattenfall Research & Development (R&D) drives innovation to accelerate fossil freedom and create value across Vattenfall. The Customer Products & Solutions (CPS) Analytics Programme develops data-driven methods and AI-powered solutions to address challenges and opportunities within customer and energy-system domains. This thesis will be conducted within the Analytics Programme at Vattenfall R&D in close collaboration with the Data & Analytics group in Business Area Customers & Solutions in the Netherlands.
   

  

 The growing adoption of distributed energy resources is transforming electricity production and consumption. Technologies such as electric vehicles, heat pumps, battery storage systems, and solar PV create new forecasting challenges while also enabling more flexible and efficient energy services. Better insight into these resources could help customers optimize energy use and flexibility while supporting a more reliable energy system.
   

  

 The thesis will investigate how distributed energy resources can be identified from electricity consumption data using data-driven and machine learning approaches. The project will explore load disaggregation and classification techniques to detect characteristic consumption patterns associated with specific energy resources. Improved visibility of customer assets can support applications such as load forecasting, grid planning, flexibility markets, and customer-centric energy services.
   

  

 The Purpose Of This Thesis Is To Evaluate The Feasibility And Accuracy Of Identifying Distributed Energy Resources From Electricity Consumption Data. The Student Will
   

  

* Review relevant literature on load disaggregation and energy asset identification.
* Develop and evaluate machine learning and statistical models for detecting distributed energy resources from consumption patterns.
* Assess model performance, limitations, and uncertainty.
* Provide recommendations for future implementation and research.


**Qualifications**
 We are looking for 1 student who are about to complete their academic studies and are eager to apply their knowledge in a real-world setting through a thesis project at Vattenfall. You are someone who shares our values and identifies with our principles: Active, Open, Positive and Safety.

* Proficiency in English
* Knowledge of statistical modelling and machine learning.
* Experience with Python and commonly used data science libraries.
* Experience with time-series analysis and predictive modelling.
* Interest in energy systems, electrification, and the energy transition.

title: Elektronikingenjör
description:
*Drivs du av att se dina idéer bli verklighet? Välkommen till vår spännande och teknikintensiva värld.*
**Din roll**
 Du blir en del av Saab Dynamics och affärsenheten Missile Systems, där vi utvecklar avancerade produkter med höga krav på funktion, tillförlitlighet och prestanda. Din arbetsplats är i Solna, där du blir en del av ett team med kompetens inom elektronikkonstruktion, samtidigt som du arbetar nära kollegor i Karlskoga.
   

  

 Området som du kommer att tillhöra ansvarar för elektronikkonstruktionen till alla produkter med elektronikinnehåll. Ditt arbete blir inriktat mot elektronikkonstruktion såväl digital konstruktion för signal och bildbehandling som analog konstruktion. Då våra avancerade produkter bygger på höga överföringshastigheter krävs förståelse för signalintegritet, EMC och val av konstruktionslösningar som uppfyller kraven. Dina uppgifter kommer att omfatta allt från kravhantering och utveckling fram till färdig produkt. Våra produkter ska ha hög tillförlitlighet och framför allt fungera i krävande miljöer med stora mekaniska påfrestningar och varierande temperaturer.
   

  

 Hos oss kommer du att arbeta i projektform och ha omfattande kontakter med andra teknikområden, såsom system, mekanik och programvara.
   

  

 Eftersom vi arbetar i teknikens absoluta framkant behöver vi dig som har gedigna kunskaper inom elektronikområdet. Samtidigt är kontinuerlig utveckling en självklar del av vår verksamhet. Vi erbjuder därför våra medarbetare en mängd olika utbildningar och möjligheter att utvecklas till framtida specialister och ledare.
   

  

 Arbetet inkluderar bland annat:
   

  

* Elektronikkonstruktion - analog och digital
* FPGA konstruktion
* Delsystemansvarig
* Analys och problemlösning
* Tolkning och nedbrytning av krav
* Stöttning vid test och verifiering
* Specifikationer, designbeskrivningar och rapporter


**Din profil**
 Vi söker dig som är civilingenjör eller högskoleingenjör inom elektroteknik, elektronik eller motsvarande och som har flera års erfarenhet av hårdvarukonstruktion inom både analog och digital elektronik. Rollen innebär ett stort tekniskt ansvar, vilket gör att du behöver ha gedigen kompetens inom elektronik och vara trygg i att självständigt driva konstruktionsarbete framåt.
   

  

 Du är strukturerad och kvalitetsmedveten, samtidigt som du är drivande och kommunikativ i ditt arbete. Du trivs med att samarbeta med andra och har lätt för att ta egna initiativ. Vi ser gärna att du är positiv och uppskattar en arbetsmiljö där arbetsuppgifterna kan variera och där du får möjlighet att ta dig an nya utmaningar.
   

  

 Meriterande:
   

  

* Erfarenhet av Siemens Xpedition Enterprise för elektronikkonstruktion och simulering
* Erfarenhet av VHDL eller annat språk för konstruktion av programmerbara kretsar
* Erfarenhet av hårdvarunära programmering i C/C++


 Tjänsten är placerad i Solna och tillhör Saab Dynamics, affärsenheten Missile Systems. Ditt närmaste team finns både i Solna och Karlskoga och din rekryterande chef är placerad i Karlskoga. Tjänsten kan medföra resor både nationellt och internationellt.
   

  

 Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap.
   

  

 Vänligen observera att vi arbetar med löpande urval och att tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum har gått ut.
   

  

**Vad du blir en del av**
 Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas.
   

  

 Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med syfte att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidra till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 28 000 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld.
   

  

 Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här

title: Golang Developer
description:

 ANIMARUM söker en senior systemutvecklare som vill arbeta med Go (Golang), Python och TypeScript. Du har gedigen erfarenhet av molnbaserade lösningar och trivs med att kombinera praktisk utveckling med arkitektur och tekniskt ansvar.

title: Senior Backend Developer - Energy Management Systems
description:
*Do you want to write backend code that actually matters, powering energy efficiency for thousands of buildings across Europe? Are you an experienced Java developer who takes end-to-end ownership, makes deliberate architectural choices, and wants real influence over a platform built on Azure and Kubernetes?*
*Then you might be the Senior Backend Developer our Mestro team in Stockholm is looking for!*
**As Part of the Department**
 We craft the vertical software of tomorrow, bringing sustainable impact to customers and society. At Mestro, we combine data-driven innovation with a genuine passion for energy efficiency and sustainability. As part of EG Group, we are a dedicated team of innovators and problem solvers who take responsibility for our contribution to our customers, each other, and the society we live in.
   

  

 We are now looking for a Senior Backend Developer to join Mestro on a permanent, full-time basis, contributing to the continued development of the platform. This is a hybrid role with our Stockholm office as your base. You will combine days on site with the team and days working remotely.
   

  

**Your Tasks: Design, Build, and Own the Backend**
 As a Senior Backend Developer, you will be one of the people the team relies on for the backend systems powering the Mestro platform. You will design and build new functionality, improve what we already have, and work closely with product owners, architects, and frontend developers to turn business goals into technical solutions that hold up over time.
   

  

**You Will**
* Design, develop, and maintain backend services and APIs for the Mestro platform.
* Drive architectural and technical decisions, and take responsibility for their consequences.
* Deploy, monitor, and operate applications in Azure and Kubernetes. You build it, you run it.
* Identify and address technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and reliability issues.
* Set the bar for code quality through well-tested code and constructive code reviews.
* Break down complex and unclear requirements together with product owners and turn them into solutions that can be delivered.
* Mentor colleagues and raise the level of the whole team, not just your own output.


**Your Profile: An Experienced Developer Who Takes Ownership**
 You have enough experience to know that writing the code is rarely the hard part. You make pragmatic trade-offs, communicate clearly about risk and scope, and take ownership of your work all the way into production. You want to work in a small team where your opinion carries weight, and where you are expected to have one.
   

  

**You Are The Ideal Candidate If You**
* Have 8-10 years of professional experience in backend development.
* Have deep knowledge of Java, and solid experience with MS SQL and Azure.
* Have hands-on experience building and running applications in Kubernetes.
* Have a strong grasp of software architecture and distributed systems, including the trade-offs they involve.
* Have experience mentoring developers and driving technical decisions in a team.
* Communicate confidently in English, both in writing and in technical discussion.


**Nice To Have**
* Experience designing and operating microservice architectures.
* Strong CI/CD and DevOps practices: pipelines, infrastructure as code, and observability.
* Experience with large data volumes, time series data, or integrations with external data sources.
* Background in the energy management, proptech, or data analytics domain.


**What's in it for you?**
* A product with real purpose. Mestro helps buildings across Europe cut energy waste, so your code has tangible impact.
* Real technical influence. You will shape architecture and priorities, not just close tickets.
* A modern tech stack: Java, Azure, Kubernetes, MS SQL.
* Autonomy with support. We trust you to own your work, and we back you when you need it.
* A hybrid setup with our Stockholm office as your base, and a collaborative, low-ego culture.
* The stability and resources of EG Group behind a product team that still moves fast.
* Room to grow, whether deeper into architecture, DevOps, or domain expertise in energy management.


**Our Values**
* Lead the Industry — We bring deep industry expertise and help our customers lead their industry.
* Make it Happen — We take ownership, move fast and deliver real impact.
* Stronger Together — We collaborate across borders with high standards, trust, openness and no politics.


**We look forward to hearing from you!**
 If you are interested in learning more before you apply, please contact Senior Manager Jimmy Persson jiper@eg.se or on +46 702 99 10 49. We review applications on an ongoing basis and will hire once the right candidate is found, so please send your CV and application as soon as possible. All inquiries are handled confidentially.
   

  

**At EG, we build software that makes a difference.**
 Our industry-specific software helps people and businesses work smarter every day. From doctors spending more time with patients to builders running safer, more efficient projects.
   

  

 Our software is built by peers from the industry and backed by EG's scale for stability, innovation, and security. If you're ambitious, curious, and take pride in ownership, you'll thrive here.
   

  

 Join us in creating software that works for people - not software that makes people work.
   

  

**Curious what it's really like to work at EG?**
 Explore life at EG, meet some of your future colleagues, and see our values in action: Working at EG
   

  

 See all our open positions here
   

  

 Learn more about EG here.
   

  

 This position will be in legal entity: Mestro AB.

title: Software Engineer – Framtidens högre taktiska ledningssystem
description:
*Vill du påverka och göra skillnad på riktigt? Här bidrar du till att skapa trygghet för människor och samhällen. Det du gör spelar roll.*
**Din roll**
 I takt med att det taktiska landskapet blir allt mer komplext växer behovet av avancerade system för ledning och kontroll. För att skapa en precis och effektiv operativ lägesbild krävs mjukvara som kan hantera, bearbeta och analysera enorma mängder data i realtid. Vi söker nu dig som vill vara med och driva utvecklingen av våra framtida högre taktiska ledningssystem. Hos oss får du kombinera beprövade principer för robust systemutveckling med moderna, AI-stödda arbetssätt för att skapa lösningar som gör skillnad på riktigt.
   

  

 Som Software Engineer blir du en nyckelspelare i ett tvärfunktionellt team där mjukvaruteknik möter taktiska behov och operativa krav. Du kommer att arbeta nära domänexperter och slutanvändare för att omsätta komplexa operativa behov till skalbar och högpresterande kod. Vi värdesätter hantverket bakom robust, testbar och långsiktigt förvaltbar mjukvara. I rollen kommer du använda moderna AI-baserade utvecklingsverktyg (exempelvis Claude Code) för att utveckla mjukvara, effektivisera kodanalys, refaktorering och dokumentation. Vi ser AI som en kraftfull katalysator, men det är ditt tekniska omdöme och din expertis som säkerställer lösningens kvalitet, säkerhet och funktion.
   

  

 Du behöver inte vara expert på taktiska ledningssystem från start, men vi förväntar oss att du är nyfiken och motiverad att successivt bygga upp en djup domänkunskap för att på sikt bli en av våra främsta specialister inom området.
   

  

**Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden kommer vara att:**
* Utveckla och optimera funktionalitet i våra system för högre taktisk ledning.
* Designa och implementera lösningar för bearbetning, analys och visualisering av taktisk data och sensorinformation.
* Säkerställa hög mjukvarukvalitet genom robust arkitektur, automatiserade tester och noggrann kodgranskning.
* Implementera och utvärdera AI-stödda utvecklingsflöden för att öka teamets effektivitet.
* Samarbeta med produktägare och domänexperter för att bryta ner komplexa behov till tekniska specifikationer.
* Bidra till produktens tekniska roadmap och arkitektoniska vägval.


**Din profil**
 Vi söker en skicklig mjukvaruingenjör med ett analytiskt tänkande och en vilja att förstå komplexa system på djupet. Du trivs i en miljö där teknisk excellens möter höga krav på tillförlitlighet och driftsäkerhet.
   

  

**Vi ser gärna att du har:**
* Högskole- eller civilingenjörsexamen inom datateknik, mjukvaruteknik, teknisk fysik eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet.
* Dokumenterad erfarenhet av professionell mjukvaruutveckling och god förståelse för hela utvecklingslivscykeln (SDLC).
* God kunskap inom mjukvaruarkitektur, API-design och moderna databaslösningar.
* Erfarenhet av programmeringsspråket Rust
* Förmåga att kritiskt granska och kvalitetssäkra AI-genererad kod med ett starkt tekniskt omdöme.
* God kommunikativ förmåga och vana av att arbeta i team över olika kompetensområden.
* Ett stort intresse för försvarsteknik och taktiska system.


**Meriterande erfarenheter:**
 Det är ett plus om du har erfarenhet av taktiska ledningssystem (C2), sensorfusion, distribuerade system, realtidssystem eller GIS/geospatial data.
   

  

 Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap.
   

  

**Vad du blir en del av**
 Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas.
   

  

 Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med uppdrag att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidrar till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 28,000 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld.
   

  

 Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här.

title: Experienced Frontend Gameplay Programmer
description:

 Hacksaw Studios is a Stockholm-based game studio focused on creating innovative, high-quality gaming experiences.  To continue scaling our development efforts, we are looking for an experienced Gameplay Programmer with a focus on frontend development to join our growing team.
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 As an Experienced Gameplay Programmer at Hacksaw Studios, you will play a central role in shaping how our games feel, behave, and perform. title: Staff Embedded Engineer
description:
**YOUR MISSION AT VOI**
 We operate one of the world’s largest connected micromobility fleets, with close to 200,000 vehicles across multiple hardware generations, vehicle models and markets – and we will keep scaling significantly in the coming years. As our fleet grows in scale and complexity, firmware reliability, platform architecture, and operational robustness become increasingly critical to the business. Ultimately, your work ensures that every Voi vehicle feels safe, reliable and effortless to use – even after years of real‑world use, rough weather, and everyday wear and tear.
   

  

 We are now looking for a deeply experienced Staff Embedded Engineer to help lead the next generation of our vehicle and IoT platform. In this highly hands-on technical leadership role you will shape the long‑term embedded platform strategy and architecture, and work across teams, suppliers and partners to make sure our vehicles are consistently reliable.
   

  

**You Will, Among Other Things**
* Translate rider and operator needs into platform‑level design decisions, ensuring our vehicles are intuitive to use, reliable over years in the field and straightforward for local teams to operate and maintain.
* Architect and evolve a large‑scale distributed embedded platform spanning vehicle control systems, battery‑powered IoT devices and multi‑MCU/MPU platforms (including Zephyr / Linux‑capable systems).
* Develop and scale platforms capable of hosting multiple ML models on‑edge based on computer vision and other sensors.
* Drive the evolution of fleet‑wide OTA infrastructure, remote diagnostics and observability for hundreds of thousands of devices across 100+ cities in Europe.
* Lead technical discussions and design reviews with internal teams and external hardware suppliers and manufacturing partners.
* Improve resilience and recovery mechanisms for remotely deployed systems, including safe rollback strategies and recovery of bricked devices.
* Drive improvements in CAN‑based vehicle communication, power systems, GNSS and geofencing in dense urban environments, and sensor reliability, including Bluetooth and NFC user interactions.
* Raise the bar for engineering excellence across embedded and firmware engineering, mentoring others, refining CI/CD, testing and release processes, and introducing best‑in‑class development practices.
* Champion the strategic and pragmatic adoption of Generative AI tools to increase engineering effectiveness while protecting code quality and minimising technical debt.


**What You Need To Embark**
 You are a hands-on, senior technical leader who thrives at the intersection of firmware, hardware, connectivity and large‑scale operations. You are confident in navigating high complexity, balancing strategic architectural choices with pragmatic delivery, and you enjoy mentoring others and setting engineering standards. You care about the end‑to‑end experience: from how a rider feels stepping onto a scooter, to how easy it is for our operations teams to keep the fleet safe, available and healthy over time.
   

  

**We Believe You Will Bring**
* Extensive experience building and operating embedded / firmware systems in real‑world environments at scale (ideally globally distributed connected device fleets).
* Strong skills in embedded C/C++ development and low‑power, real‑time embedded systems.
* Deep understanding of firmware architecture, hardware / software integration and distributed IoT systems.
* Proven experience debugging complex field issues across firmware, hardware, manufacturing and connectivity layers.
* Strong experience with embedded communication protocols such as CAN, SPI, I²C, UART and BLE.


**It’s a Plus If You Have Experience With**
* STM32‑based or other heterogeneous embedded architectures, and modern RTOS platforms such as Zephyr.
* Secure boot, TrustZone, TPMs or other embedded security architectures, as well as Embedded Linux systems.
* GNSS, geofencing, sensor fusion or other edge‑processing systems, and battery‑powered devices with a focus on power optimisation.
* Operating large, globally distributed IoT fleets across varied connectivity environments, including recovering from real‑world operational failures, factory issues or large‑scale fleet incidents.


 This role is likely a strong match if you have scaled firmware deployments globally, built systems that remain reliable under unreliable real-world conditions, and driven architecture decisions across multiple hardware generations with a focus on long‑term maintainability and operational visibility.
   

  

*Don’t meet every requirement? If you are excited about this role and our mission, and have relevant, transferable skills, we encourage you to apply – even if you don’t check every box.*
**WHY VOI?**
 Working At Voi Is More Than Just a Job; Our People Promise Includes a Personal Voyage Where You Will Grow As a Professional And Be a Part Of a Team And Culture That Builds Something Meaningful For Society. In Addition To This You’ll Have The Opportunity To
   

  

* Join Europe’s #1 micromobility operator
* Get “skin in the game” through our employee options programme.
* Enjoy unlimited free Voi rides and a dog‑friendly office.
* Work together with inspiring, motivated and fun colleagues towards a common goal.
* Join the micromobility revolution and be a part of creating sustainable cities made for living, free from noise and pollution.


 Since 2018,
 **Voi** 
 has been on a mission to create safe, sustainable and reliable micromobility for everyone. Today we are the leading shared micromobility operator in Europe, with HQ in Stockholm (Sweden), operating 200,000+ vehicles in 130+ towns and cities across 13 countries, serving 8+ million riders with over 500+ MILLION rides to date, and we have no intention of stopping here! We believe that micromobility will play a central role in changing how people move in our towns and cities in the future and want to ensure that the micromobility transformation happens the right way - through real innovative technology, partnership and transparent dialogue with towns, cities and governments, and by adapting our products to the local needs. In addition to improving quality of life in cities around the world, we are contributing to the solution for climate change by making sustainable transportation options more widely available and promoting renewable energy use and circularity along our supply chain.
   

  

**Diversity Matters**
 As a Voiager, we offer you a friendly, collaborative and fast-paced workplace where you can bring your whole self to work, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability or sexual orientation - and welcome applications from whoever you are, including veterans, those actively serving as a Reservist and their partners. What is most important to us is how you treat others and what skills and value you bring to our team. We believe that having a wide diversity of people with different backgrounds and perspectives within Voi is essential to our success in delivering the best user experience to our equally diverse user base. With employees from over 50 nationalities working within Voi, we believe we have made good progress but know we can still do more - therefore we discourage any photos, personal letters, or disclosure of any information that concerns other information than your professional experience.

title: Senior Fullstack Developer (Python/React)
description:
**A Different Kind Of Job Description**
 At Filed, we believe in radical transparency. Everything is open: company finances, team salaries, stock options, anonymous team feedback. That extends to how we talk about this job, so what you'll read here looks a little different from other job ads. It starts with why this is a terrible job. Then it explains why it might be the best career move you'll ever make.
   

  

**Why this is a terrible job**
 This is an incredibly high-paced, high-tempo environment. We're making a generational bet to change all of our lives, and generational bets are not comfortable.
   

  

 You will build agents for subjective workflows. Tax law is objective, but what applies under it and how professionals interpret it is full of judgment. You can give two tax professionals the same task and get two different results where both are right. We're building agentic systems that have to reach their level of accuracy, not a level we decided is good enough. From an engineering standpoint, this is the hardest thing most of us have ever built. At times it will feel like hitting your head against the wall.
   

  

 Customers will sometimes get frustrated, because they expect deterministic results from probabilistic systems, and we're managing the expectations of some of the biggest firms in the world, including the Big Four.
   

  

 And the rhythm is real: we get to the office, we work, we go home and spend time with our families, and then many of us get back online to support our customers in US hours. It's tough. It's relentless.
   

  

**Why it might be the best career choice you'll ever make**
 It's addictive to be part of a business when you know you're winning. Filed is adding millions of dollars of revenue every quarter, customers are signing up in numbers, and in under two years we've become the market leader in a space with entrenched incumbents and a drastic need for new AI tools. When we come into head-to-heads with competitors, we win every time, because our product is superior. And we stay focused and diligent: we only work with tax firms that have the right expectations, which is why our typical customer is mid-market and enterprise.
   

  

 The industry looks boring from the outside, but the problem is unsolved, and the space has been riddled with products below the mark for decades. When you push through the wall, there's a spark of joy: a customer says "wow, this is phenomenal." That keeps happening.
   

  

 The opportunity here is not only to make a great deal of money. It's to have real impact on our mission: making this profession extraordinary. Nobody became a tax professional for the admin. They got into this work to be creative with tax law, to have fun, and to change the fabric of society. Filed enables them to do exactly that.
   

  

 We've raised $17.2 million to date, led by Northzone, and you can read the story in TechCrunch. Our focus now is to deliver the roadmap and continue to win.
   

  

**What You'll Build**
 As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you'll build the product surface and the platform underneath it:
   

  

* The workflows tax professionals live in every day, from document intake through review to delivery
* Deep integrations with the tax software firms already use, so Filed works where they work
* The pipelines that move documents, data, and returns reliably at scale, through the most intense weeks of tax season


 You'll ship across the stack, own features end to end, and see your work in front of some of the most demanding professional users in the world within days, not quarters.
   

  

**What You'll Be Responsible For**
* Building and maintaining fullstack features across our AI tax prep, planning, and review products
* Owning the UX and backend logic for the workflows tax professionals use every day
* Shipping fast, watching metrics, and deciding what to improve next, without being told
* Learning about LLMs and making them work for our customers to achieve higher accuracy and transparency
* Keeping the codebase clean, typed, and fast as we scale


**Your Hard Skillset**
* Comfortable in TypeScript, React, and Python: you've built complex, data-heavy UIs and backend services before
* Familiar with cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud and/or Azure
* Bonus if you've worked in fast-paced startups or regulated industries
* Even bigger bonus if you've taken a product from 0 to 1 and watched real users depend on it


**Your Soft Skillset**
* Comfortable being uncomfortable and making calls with incomplete data
* Empathetic and curious: building for the user, not just for clean code
* Highly collaborative across product, engineering, and tax
* Detail-oriented but pragmatic: you know when polish matters and when to ship
* You own your work and welcome the accountability that comes with it


**A championship team**
 We think of ourselves as a sports team. Incredibly high performance, incredibly high standards, and real success to show for it. Being a championship team means working with people who are deeply proud of the work they do and have great fun doing it together.
   

  

 We measure employee happiness constantly, and our eNPS is +60. We don't say that to brag. We say it because a team playing at this tempo only holds together if people genuinely love being on it. Every four months, the whole company comes together for an offsite.
   

  

**What Filed Stands For**
 Not posters. Not corporate language. Real operating standards.
   

  

* No problem is someone else's problem If you see it, it's yours. Bugs, customer confusion, missed expectations, internal friction. We don't pass problems sideways and we don't hide behind roles. You fix the typo even if you didn't write it, jump into a customer issue even if it's not your department, escalate early, and close loops fully. Ownership means you drive resolution, not that you suffer silently or burn out doing everything alone.
* Waiting is not a strategy Momentum is our advantage. We don't wait for perfect information or stall because something is unclear. You ship a V1 instead of debating V5, test instead of theorize, run small experiments instead of requesting big approvals, and propose solutions instead of just naming blockers. Speed is powerful. Sloppiness is not, and recklessness has no place in a high-trust industry.
* We run toward the fire When something breaks, we move. Tax is high-stakes and trust is fragile. We acknowledge issues immediately, communicate clearly and often, prioritize customer-impacting problems fast, and stay on it until it's fully resolved. Firefighting is a strength, not panic, and never an excuse for preventable mistakes.
* We win on customer experience AI will commoditize. Features will copy. Pricing will compress. Experience won't. We respond faster than customers expect, communicate proactively, think like a partner rather than a ticketing system, and anticipate needs before they're raised. Overdelivering means raising the standard of care, not overpromising, hero culture, or burning the team out.


**Who This Suits**
 This is a very fun environment, but it only suits people who meet the criteria we're looking for:
   

  

* People who want to win
* People who have a point to prove
* People who want to write their own job descriptions


**How We Pay**
 Nothing at Filed is behind closed doors. Everyone here sees everyone else's salary, because we believe transparency creates trust, and trust is the foundation of excellent teamwork. Compensation isn't a negotiation. Depending on your location, everyone receives the same three offers, and all of our offers are above market benchmarking.
   

  

 This role is assessed at Level 4 (Senior). The salary and equity bandings are:
   

  

* Most Equity: 82,500 SEK per month + $180,000 of equity
* Great Equity: 90,000 SEK per month + $120,000 of equity
* Good Equity: 97,500 SEK per month + $60,000 of equity


 We run performance reviews every four months. Meet your goals and you can expect to double your equity by the end of your first year.
   

  

 One more thing, in the spirit of transparency: some people who apply for this role will be assessed at a different level. If the team determines your level of responsibility sits differently, we'll adjust the offer accordingly. If you're earlier in your journey than this role expects, that's not a problem. Apply to the Fullstack Engineer role instead.
   

  

**Benefits**
* A minimum of 30 days of holiday per year, whether you're in Europe or the US
* In the US: fully covered medical expenses on platinum-level plans, with 100% coverage for your dependents as well
* In Europe: the full set of mandatory benefits, and more on top
* Company-wide offsites every four months


**The process**
* Quick intro call (30 minutes)
* Technical walkthrough and async task (60 minutes)
* Final round with our team (120 minutes)


 In just 3.5 hours, you'll be wanting early access, just like the rest of our team, to get into the stack and start building a generational company, even before your first day.
   

  

**About Filed**
**Filed is the AI tax preparer trusted by America's accounting firms.**
 Taxes might seem boring, but they are the $5 trillion backbone of the US economy. Globally, nearly $15 trillion in taxes is collected every year. Behind every dollar of it sits a professional making judgment calls, and the industry that does this work is breaking under a talent shortage no one has solved. We're fixing it. Today, hundreds of firms run Filed inside the systems they already use, and we're backed by Northzone, Neo, Analog, and Raine.
   

  

 There has never been a more exciting time to work on a problem this complex. Join us while "I was there when it all started" is still true.

title: Senior Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE
description:
We are currently looking to strengthen our organization with developers who have business analyst knowledge of the Dynamics platform and experience with integration technologies in the Azure platform to work on a customer management and trading platform.
   

  

 With your team, you directly contribute to Vattenfall’s vision to become fossil-free within one generation and enable customers to make that choice.
