title: Frontend Engineer
description:
**Introducing evroc**


At evroc, we are building a secure, sovereign, and sustainable hyperscale cloud to reimagine the digital future of Europe. By joining our company, you have an exciting opportunity to contribute to the development of next-generation cloud services. We are seeking intellectually curious and highly motivated team members who are ready to embrace the thrilling challenge of building the first European-owned hyperscale cloud.

**Location:** Stockholm

**Job type:** Permanent position

**Join the Pioneers**


As a Frontend Engineer on the Think team, you will shape the user experience of roc, enterprise AI you can trust with your data. roc delivers sovereign AI to European organizations that demand the highest levels of security and compliance, running on our own cloud and inference platform.


You will help take roc beyond the chat window: building interactive artifacts alongside conversations, an embeddable assistant that organizations can integrate into their own sites, and experiences that bring roc into the tools people already use, from internal systems and knowledge bases to team chat.


Along the way, you will influence our application architecture and engineering culture, building AI products where usability, trust, and transparency are part of the design from the start.

**What You'll Tackle**

* Design and build responsive, intuitive interfaces for enterprise AI chat, retrieval, and tool use.
* Build user experiences for streaming responses, background tool execution, and real-time state changes.
* Develop new ways for users to interact with roc beyond the traditional chat interface.
* Work closely with backend and platform engineers to ensure seamless integration across the product.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering practices that improve quality and maintainability.
* Build reliable frontend systems using testing frameworks such as Playwright and Vitest.
* Explore and apply new technologies, frameworks, and tools that improve both development workflows and user experience.

**Skills We Value**

* Typically 5+ years of professional experience in frontend development.
* Strong experience with modern JavaScript frameworks; familiarity with Svelte or SvelteKit is valued but not required.
* Strong knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, and modern frontend development practices.
* Experience building interfaces for LLM-based products, including streaming responses, markdown rendering, and conversational UX, is a plus.
* Experience with testing frameworks such as Playwright, Vitest, or similar.
* Proficiency with Git and modern collaborative development workflows.
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to both functionality and user experience.
* Ability to work closely with engineers, designers, and other stakeholders in a collaborative environment.

**Why Join evroc?**


We offer a competitive salary and an equity package to attract the best talent. Come join us to help build the next generation cloud!


At evroc, diversity is our strength. We champion an inclusive environment where every background - ethnicity, age, gender identity, beliefs, and culture - is celebrated.


Applicants must possess a valid work permit.

title: Senior Softwate Engineer, Web Development, Google Meet
description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages.
* 3 years of experience with front-end and user interface development.
* 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software product.
* 1 year of experience with software design and architecture.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field.
* 5 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
* 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role.
* Experience developing accessible technologies.

**About the job**
-----------------


Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.  

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

Sweden: kr1000000 - kr1020000 (SEK) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Design web development features for the Google Meet product.
* Work closely with PM and UX to develop delightful user experiences.
* Work with engineers across the video organization to build features end to end.
* Participate in, or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders to decide amongst available technologies.
* Work with Agentic Coding techniques and tools.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

title: Product Manager – Product Development – Husqvarna Group
description:
**Last date to apply:**


03 November 2026
Within **Group PLM**, based in **Huskvarna**, we are responsible for the digital foundation that supports how products are defined, developed, governed, and managed across the entire product lifecycle.

  

The team consists of a mix of roles, including Product Owners, Business Analysts, a dedicated Key User Support function and AI consultants. In total, the team consists of around 13 members with a diverse mix of backgrounds and experience levels. Some team members bring over 20–30 years of experience within PLM and related areas, while others are earlier in their careers, creating a good balance of senior expertise and newer perspectives.

 **Role description**  

The Digital Product Manager leads the strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle of designated PLM and engineering digital products used globally at Husqvarna. The role ensures that these products deliver measurable value through improved engineering efficiency, global standardization, compliance, and reduced time‑to‑market. Furthermore it combines strategic thinking with hands‑on product ownership, working across the entire product lifecycle, and influencing ways of working across engineering, product development and maintenance.

 **Your profile**

* Bachelor degree in relevant area
* Experience in product management, solution ownership, or PLM/digital engineering systems.
* Strong understanding of engineering/PLM processes and global digital solutions.
* Proven experience working in agile product development and leading cross-functional teams.
* Ability to translate strategy into product execution and measurable outcomes.
* Structured way of working, with an understanding of project finances and product roadmaps.
* Strong understanding of the Product Developmentecosystem and its core processes, including spare parts, service plans, and after-sales support.

  

Preferred qualifications

* Experience with Siemens Teamcenter or other major PLM platforms.
* Knowledge of enterprise architecture, data governance, and compliance.
* Experience developing business cases and managing product KPIs.
* Understanding of UX and user journeys.
* Knowledge of CAD systems and CAD integrations
* Experience of working as an engineer in product development projects.

 **Location**  

Huskvarna. We believe the best ideas happen when we are connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This is consistent across all our global offices and helps us maintain a strong culture, support learning and development, and ensure everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive.

 **Your application**  

Please apply with CV and Cover Letter. We do not accept applications via email due to GDPR regulations. For more questions regarding the position please contact:


Hiring Manager: Anders Gerebo, anders.gerebo@husqvarnagroup.com. For more information about the recruitment process, please contact: Recruiter: Gorjana Dubovina,gorjana.dubovina@husqvarnagroup.com.

 *Processing of personal data*


When you send in your application we will process your personal data. In case we choose to proceed with your application, we may ask you to verify your identity before giving you a job offer. For more information about how we process your personal data, who we may share it with and what rights you have, please see our privacy notice.

 **Winning Through Culture**  

We believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters.

  

Our culture is built on three core themes:

* Bold: We push boundaries, embrace challenges, and explore new possibilities.
* Dedicated: We put in the hard work, bring passion and resilience to every challenge we take on.
* Care: We support each other, consider the impact of our actions, and strive to make a lasting difference.

  

Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future!

  

Learn more about our culture *here*.

title: Senior Fullstack Software Engineer
description:
**Company Description**  

Vattenfall is one of Europe’s largest producers and retailers of electricity and heat. Our main markets are Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK. The Vattenfall Group has approximately 21 000 employees. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years.

 **Job Description**  

Do you want to build digital solutions that help millions of customers on their journey towards a fossil-free future?  

  

At Vattenfall IT, we develop and operate digital solutions that create value for both our customers and our business. Innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement are at the heart of everything we do. Together with our business partners, we are shaping modern digital experiences that support Vattenfall's ambition to enable fossil freedom within one generation.


We are now looking for a **Senior Fullstack Software Engineer** to join our team in **Stockholm, Sweden**.  

  

**About the position**  

As a senior member of the team, you will contribute throughout the entire application lifecycle, from solution design and development to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. You will help translate business goals into technical solutions while promoting modern software engineering practices and supporting knowledge sharing across the team.  

  

**Your tasks and responsibilities**

* Design secure, robust, and sustainable end-to-end solutions
* Translate product and business objectives into high-quality technical solutions
* Develop and continuously improve customer-facing applications
* Collaborate closely with software engineers, architects, Product Owners, UX designers, and business stakeholders
* Transform requirements into user stories and technical implementations
* Build automated tests and maintain efficient CI/CD pipelines
* Promote agile development methods and software engineering best practices
* Support knowledge sharing and technical mentoring within the team
* Contribute to continuous delivery of high-quality features and improvements
* Monitor application performance, reliability, and health throughout the application lifecycle

  

**Qualifications**  

You are a passionate and experienced software engineer who enjoys creating high-quality digital products and solving complex technical challenges. You combine strong technical expertise with a collaborative mindset and are motivated by delivering great customer experiences. You take ownership, continuously seek improvements, and enjoy helping others grow through knowledge sharing and teamwork.


As our **Senior Fullstack Software Engineer**, you bring strong fullstack development experience and a solid understanding of modern cloud-based application development.  

  

Next to this, you bring:

* University degree in Information Technology, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
* At least 6 years of professional experience in fullstack software development
* Good knowledge of Swedish
* Experience working with customer-facing digital products
* Experience mentoring developers and driving engineering excellence
* Passion for emerging technologies and continuous learning
* Strong experience with:
	+ Angular 19 or later
	+ TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS
	+ C#, .NET Framework, and .NET 8 or later
* Experience working with Microsoft Azure and cloud-native development
* Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, Git, and Gitflow
* Experience using development and security tools such as Visual Studio, GitHub, SAST, and DAST solutions
* Familiarity with modern AI-supported development tools such as Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor
* Experience working in agile software development environments
* Ability to translate business and product requirements into secure, scalable, and maintainable technical solutions
* Strong collaboration and communication skills
* Fluent English, written and spoken

  

**Additional Information** **Our Offer**  

We offer a challenging and international work environment and the possibility to work with some of the best in the field. You will be working in interdisciplinary teams and you can always count on support from committed colleagues as ‘Ask and Share’ concept is essential for the way we work. We offer attractive employment conditions (smart working, flexible working hours and a good-work-life balance) and opportunities for personal and professional development. Click here for further information.  

  

**Location**  

Stockholm  

  

**For more information:** for more information about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact our recruiter: Marta Jura.  

  

Trade Union representatives in Sweden via Vattenfall´s switchboard +46 8 739 50 00.  

  

**We welcome your application in English no later than 30.09.2026**. We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website and that you refrain from submitting a cover letter with your application. You apply quickly and easily by answering screening questions and attaching your CV.  

  

At Vattenfall, we value being active, positive, open, and safety-conscious. We are looking for employees who share our vision and can contribute to strengthening our corporate culture. We firmly believe that diversity helps build a more profitable and attractive company, and we strive to be good role models when it comes to diversity. Vattenfall actively works to ensure that all employees have the same opportunities and rights regardless of age, ethnic or cultural background, gender identity, religion/belief, sexual orientation, or disability. Read more about how we work with diversity and inclusion here.  

  

The security of Vattenfall and its employees is essential. For that reason, a pre-employment screening will be part of your recruitment process. The screening is based on the role you will fulfill within Vattenfall.  

  

*Working at Vattenfall means working with critical societal infrastructure. Therefore, many of our positions are security-classified, and you may be required to fill a wartime posting. If this position is security-classified, a security clearance will be carried out before employment, in accordance with the Security Protection Act. Any potential wartime posting will be based on the employment contract and the Total Defence Service Act.*  

  

We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Produktspecialist inom börshandel och depåsystem
description:
**Att jobba som Produktspecialist inom börshandel och depåsystem**


Som Produktspecialist blir du en del av Skandiabankens satsning inom sparande och investeringar. Vi söker dig som har en djup förståelse för värdepappersaffären och som vet vad som faktiskt händer bakom kulisserna när en kund lägger en order, genomför en aktieaffär eller handlar via en depålösning.


I rollen arbetar du nära produktägare, utvecklare, UX och externa leverantörer för att utveckla och förbättra våra tjänster inom börshandel och depå. Du blir teamets specialist inom området och bidrar med kunskap om processer, systemflöden och kundbehov för att säkerställa att vi bygger rätt lösningar för våra kunder.


Du kommer bland annat att:


* Genomföra behovsanalyser, kravställning och acceptanstestning
* Driva och följa upp utvecklingsinitiativ tillsammans med Product Owner och utvecklingsteam
* Arbeta med börshandels- och depårelaterade processer och system
* Kravställa nya funktioner och förbättringar utifrån verksamhetens och kundernas behov
* Samverka med externa leverantörer och följa upp leveranser
* Arbeta nära backoffice, mäklarbord, kundservice, UX och andra specialistfunktioner
* Bidra till att modernisera och vidareutveckla bankens sparerbjudande

Du blir en del av ett team med hög specialistkompetens där du får stort eget ansvar och möjlighet att påverka utvecklingen inom ett område som är högt prioriterat för banken. Samtidigt befinner vi oss på en spännande förändringsresa där äldre lösningar successivt ersätts med moderna plattformar och förbättrade kundupplevelser.


**För att lyckas i rollen**


Vi söker dig som har:


* Akademisk examen från högskola/universitet
* Erfarenhet av börshandel, värdepappersadministration, depåverksamhet eller backoffice inom värdepapper
* God kunskap om handelsrelaterade processer och system
* Erfarenhet av kravställning, verksamhetsutveckling eller produktspecialistarbete
* Erfarenhet av handelssystem, marknadsdatasystem och depåsystem
* SwedSec-licens

Meriterande är erfarenhet av:


* ProBroker eller motsvarande handelssystem
* Abasec eller motsvarande system
* Millistream eller motsvarande marknadsdatasystem
* Euroclear-relaterade processer
* Leverantörsstyrning och leverantörsuppföljning

För att trivas och lyckas i rollen är du detaljorienterad, ihärdig och nyfiken. Du uppskattar komplexa frågeställningar och har förmågan att analysera detaljer samtidigt som du ser helheten och förstår affärens behov.


Du är kommunikativ, pedagogisk och trygg i dialogen med olika intressenter. Vi tror också att du har modet att ställa frågor, utmana etablerade arbetssätt och driva frågor framåt när det behövs. Framför allt har du ett genuint intresse för sparande, investeringar och börshandlade instrument, och motiveras av att omsätta din specialistkunskap i lösningar som skapar värde för våra kunder.


**Vad händer nu?**


Vi jobbar med löpande urval så tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan redan idag. I ansökan kommer vi att ställa ett antal urvalsfrågor som ligger till grund för första urvalet. För att göra rekryteringsprocessen så rättvis och objektiv som möjligt kommer det att ingå intervjuer, tester, bakgrundskontroll samt digital referenstagning.


Om du har frågor kring rollen, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef Ulf Ahrner på Ulf.Ahrner@skandia.se.


Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!


**Mer om Banken**


Vi har varit pionjärer inom digital bankverksamhet sedan starten 1994, som Sveriges första helt digitala bank. Med en passion för innovation och kundfokus har vi vuxit till att erbjuda ett brett utbud av produkter och tjänster inom områdena Låna, Spara och Betala – med särskilt fokus på bolån.


Vår verksamhet är fördelad mellan Stockholm och Linköping. I Stockholm finns majoriteten av vår verksamhet, medan vår kundservice har sitt hjärta i Linköping. Tillsammans är vi cirka 270 medarbetare anställda på banken som varje dag skapar smarta lösningar för våra kunder.


**Vårt erbjudande inkluderar:**
  

* **Låna:** Transparenta och attraktivt prissatta bolån
* **Spara:** Sparande i fonder och aktier samt på sparkonto
* **Betala:** Lönekonto samt smidiga kort- och betalningstjänster.

Vi tror på att människor som utvecklas, presterar och mår bra är nyckeln till framgång. Hos oss är kompetensutveckling och lärande självklara delar av vardagen – framåt tillsammans!

Skandiabanken
Plats
Stockholm
Distansarbete
Hybridarbete
Kontakt Linda Bäckström Employer Branding Partner

title: Web Analyst till spännande uppdrag i Sundsvall (hybrid)
description:
Vi söker en erfaren Web Analyst till ett spännande konsultuppdrag hos en kund inom offentlig sektor. I rollen kommer du att arbeta med webbanalys, SEO och datadriven utveckling för att förbättra användarupplevelsen och optimera digitala tjänster. Fokus ligger på att analysera användarbeteenden, identifiera förbättringsområden och skapa smidigare digitala användarresor. Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter: Samla in, analysera och visualisera användardata i Matomo.
  
  

Utveckla och förvalta mätstrategier, spårning och dashboards. Implementera och kvalitetssäkra spårning via Matomo Tag Manager. Arbeta med teknisk SEO, strukturerad data och synlighet i sökmotorer och AI-baserade söktjänster. Säkerställa korrekt hantering av cookies, samtycke och datakvalitet.
  
  

Identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter och omsätta analysresultat till konkreta rekommendationer. Samarbeta med UX-designers, utvecklare och innehållsansvariga för att förbättra digitala användarflöden. Presentera analyser, hålla workshops och bidra med specialistkompetens inom webbanalys och SEO. Om uppdraget Du arbetar i en agil och tvärfunktionell miljö med stort eget ansvar och möjlighet att påverka utvecklingen av digitala tjänster.
  
  

Rollen passar dig som är analytisk, självgående och van att omsätta data till konkreta förbättringar. Erfarenhet av Matomo, Tag Manager, SEO, datalager och agila arbetssätt är särskilt relevant för uppdraget. Kompetensnivåer: Exceptionell: Kompetens som helt motsvarar uppdragets krav och behov. Mycket hög: Kompetens som uppfyller merparten av uppdragets krav och behov.
  
  

**Hög:** Kompetens som motsvarar en stor del av uppdragets krav och behov. Tillräcklig: Kompetens som uppfyller de grundläggande kraven för uppdraget. Skallkrav God samarbetsförmåga, lyhördhet och förmåga att arbeta självständigt och driva arbetet framåt. Mycket god kommunikativ förmåga på svenska, både i tal och skrift.
  
  

Minst kompetensnivå Tillräcklig inom det aktuella uppdragsområdet. Meriterande Kompetensnivå Hög, Mycket hög eller Exceptionell inom relevant område. Övrig information Bakgrundskontroll krävs innan uppdraget kan påbörjas. Tillträde och ansökan: Startdatum: 11 jan 2027 Slutdatum: 31 dec 2027.
  
  

Möjlighet till förlängning t.o.m. den 31 december 2028 Sista ansökningsdagen: 25 okt 2026 Distansarbete: 25% i överenskommelse med kunden Ort: Sundsvall Urval och intervjuer sker löpande! Sway Sourcing är en innovativ rekryteringspartner som specialiserar sig på att matcha rätt talang med rätt företag – snabbt och effektivt. Vårt huvudfokus ligger inom Ekonomi, Administration, HR, Marknad och IT, men vi har även den breda expertis och flexibilitet som krävs för att leverera skräddarsydda rekryteringslösningar inom alla branscher.
  
  

Trots att vi är en relativt ny aktör har vi redan byggt förtroende hos många av Sveriges största företag och arbetar både nationellt och internationellt. Med baser i Sverige och Spanien erbjuder vi en unik kombination av lokal expertis och global räckvidd. Vårt starka nätverk och djupa branschinsikter gör oss till en självklar partner för företag som vill ligga steget före i sin rekrytering. #INDM
