title: Product Manager
description:
**About Sinch** 




 At Sinch, we help businesses connect with their customers through mobile messaging, voice, email, and verification solutions. Every digital relationship starts with a moment of trust, and our Verification products help businesses create secure, seamless, and reliable customer experiences at critical moments such as account creation, login, and transaction approval.
 



  





**The Opportunity** 




 We are looking for a Product Manager III to join our Verification team and help shape the future of digital trust and authentication.
 



 This role is responsible for driving product strategy, roadmap execution, and customer adoption across key areas of Sinch's Verification portfolio. You will work closely with Engineering, Design, Data, and Go-To-Market teams to deliver products that improve authentication experiences and business outcomes for customers worldwide.
 



 A key focus of this role will be helping customers transition from traditional verification methods, including SMS OTP and Flash Call, toward next-generation Data Verification solutions while maintaining strong customer experiences and business performance.
 



 You'll join a collaborative product organization focused on solving some of the most important challenges in digital trust and authentication. This role offers the opportunity to influence product direction, work with global customers, and contribute to products that are used by businesses and consumers around the world.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Own product strategy, prioritization, and roadmap execution for areas of Sinch's Verification portfolio.
* Partner with customers to understand authentication and verification challenges and translate insights into product improvements.
* Work closely with Engineering, Design, and Data teams to deliver products that drive customer and business value.
* Drive adoption of Verification products and support customer migration from SMS OTP and Flash Call to Data Verification solutions.
* Define product requirements, manage trade-offs, and prioritize investments based on customer, business, and technical needs.
* Monitor product performance, customer adoption, and key business metrics to inform product decisions.
* Act as a product subject matter expert for internal stakeholders, partners, and customers.
* Improve developer experience across Verification APIs and integrations.



  





**Requirements** 



* 5+ years of Product Management experience delivering successful technology products.
* Experience owning product strategy, roadmap prioritization, and execution.
* Strong experience working with engineering teams on technical products, APIs, integrations, platforms, or developer-focused solutions.
* Experience partnering directly with customers and translating customer insights into product improvements.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience with AI-assisted software development, including the use of generative AI and AI coding tools across the software development lifecycle.
* Experience in Authentication, Identity, Verification, Trust, Security, or Fraud Prevention products.
* Experience within CPaaS, Telecommunications, SaaS, API platforms, or developer-focused products.
* Familiarity with customer authentication and verification challenges in enterprise environments.
* Experience working on B2B technology products.



  





**Success in This Role** 




 Within your first year, you will:
 


* Develop a deep understanding of Sinch's Verification portfolio, customers, technology, and market landscape.
* Contribute to the evolution of the Verification product strategy and roadmap.
* Help drive adoption of next-generation verification solutions.
* Deliver measurable product improvements that support customer and business outcomes.
* Build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Data, and Commercial teams.



 Our corporate language is English, please submit your application in English.
 



 At Sinch, we value learning, embrace change, and offer opportunities for personal and professional growth. Unfortunately, we are not supporting relocation at this time.
 



 Applicants Must
 


* Hold Swedish or EU/EEA citizenship.
* Have a valid Swedish work permit.



  





**About Our Hiring Process** 




 We are committed to ensuring a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and inclusive. Our approach includes structured, competency-based interviews designed to evaluate your skills, experience, and qualifications relevant to the role. At times, we may include a data-driven assessment to enhance our hiring success and identify candidates likely to excel.
 



 We believe in a two-way process and encourage you to ask questions throughout the journey.
 



 If this role isn't what you're looking for, please explore the other opportunities listed on our career page: https://www.sinch.com/careers/
 



 No matter who you are, we hope you find an exciting path forward, hopefully with us!
 



  





**Compens** 
 ation
 



 The salary range for this position is
 **SEK 45,000-65,000 per month** 
 . Individual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, qualifications, and market factors.

title: Konsult Ledningssystem QHSE och Informationssäkerhet
description:
**Konsult ledningssystem: QHSE och informationssäkerhet** 




  





 Hos oss blir det aldrig stillastående. Som konsult arbetar du med flera kunder och projekt parallellt, ofta i helt olika branscher, från järnväg och infrastruktur till tillverkning, tjänsteföretag och offentlig sektor. Det gör rollen omväxlande och engagerande: du lär känna nya verksamheter hela tiden och ser direkt vilken skillnad ditt arbete gör. Trivs du när det händer mycket och gillar att ha många bollar i luften, då är det här rätt roll för dig.
 



**Rollbeskrivning** 




 Railify söker en konsult inom ledningssystem för QHSE och informationssäkerhet. Tjänsten är på heltid och hybrid med bas i Stockholm, med möjlighet att delvis arbeta hemifrån. Rollen handlar om att stötta kunder i att utforma, införa och förbättra ledningssystem inom kvalitet, arbetsmiljö, miljö (QHSE) och informationssäkerhet.
 



 Arbetet är främst process- och verksamhetsinriktat. Det handlar om att skapa struktur, rutiner och ständiga förbättringar, inte om djup teknisk specialistkunskap. Har du erfarenhet av det ena området ger vi dig goda möjligheter att utvecklas inom det andra.
 



 I det dagliga arbetet analyserar du befintliga processer och genomför gapanalyser mot relevanta standarder, som ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 och ISO 27001. Utifrån dem föreslår du praktiska förbättringar i linje med lagkrav och branschkrav. Du tar fram dokumentation, policyer, rutiner och riktlinjer, och leder riskbedömningar och internrevisioner för att säkerställa ständiga förbättringar. I rollen ingår också att samordna workshoppar och utbildningar för kundernas medarbetare, att samarbeta nära intressenter för ett effektivt förändringsarbete och att skriva tydliga rapporter och rekommendationer på både svenska och engelska.
 



**Kvalifikationer** 



* Du trivs med att driva flera kunduppdrag och projekt samtidigt, och har förmågan att prioritera, hålla deadlines och behålla överblicken när tempot är högt.
* Erfarenhet av ledningssystem inom QHSE (kvalitet, miljö, arbetsmiljö)
 **eller** 
 informationssäkerhet (t.ex. ISO 27001), och vilja att utvecklas inom det andra området
* God förståelse för hur ledningssystem fungerar i praktiken: processer, riskhantering, uppföljning och ständiga förbättringar
* Stark analytisk förmåga och problemlösningsförmåga för processkartläggning, gapanalyser, riskbedömningar och resultatuppföljning
* Förmåga att ta fram tydlig och strukturerad dokumentation som policyer, rutiner, arbetsinstruktioner och revisionsrapporter
* Mycket god kommunikations- och samarbetsförmåga, med erfarenhet av att leda workshoppar, utbildningar och möten med intressenter
* Relevant akademisk bakgrund, exempelvis inom teknik, systemförvaltning, miljövetenskap, informationssäkerhet eller motsvarande
* Flytande svenska och mycket goda kunskaper i engelska, i både tal och skrift
* Förmåga att arbeta självständigt, ta initiativ och trivas i en hybrid arbetsmiljö med bas i Stockholm



**Meriterande** 



* Erfarenhet som konsult eller från en liknande rådgivande roll
* Erfarenhet från järnväg, transport, infrastruktur eller andra reglerade branscher

title: Sr Principal Analyst, ServiceNow Contract Negotiations and Licensing (Remote Europe)
description:
**About the role:** 
  

  

 Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have insights, market predictions and best practices for a broad range of world-leading organizations. A Senior Principal serves as an expert within Gartner’s Business and Technology Insights (BTI) group. Utilizing research and analytical skills, a Senior Principal plays a role in producing pragmatic and provocative insights which Gartner clients consume and apply to propel their business toward key objectives. They are a trusted source of advice for clients, reinforcing Gartner’s value every day by engaging them via in-person meetings, virtual meetings, sales support visits and Gartner conferences to discuss complex client challenges and offer appropriate recommendations.
   

  

 Candidates must have current knowledge of ServiceNow’s commercial programs, contracting models, pricing, and discounting approaches as well as a vision for how ServiceNow licensing, and overall contracting and negotiations with large vendors, will evolve globally and regionally.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Create innovative, thought provoking, and highly leveraged “must-have insights” content
* Develop new insights and ideas through thought leadership and offer compelling, actionable approaches to client's needs and requests that accelerate the client's ability to act
* Develop in-depth analysis to identify the root cause of a client’s barriers or overall needs and reframe thinking to drive strategy forward
* Demonstrate thought leadership in establishing Insights positions across a team of analysts
* Bring provocative, independent insights to Gartner leaders that can evolve the course of a research agenda
* Research, analyze and predict market trends and shifts to provide clients and vendors with actionable insights
* Provide clients and prospects with actionable advice aligned to their designated content area via virtual or face-to-face interactions
* Create and deliver high value presentation materials on and off stage for Gartner events, industry and professional association conferences, and client briefings
* Support BTI and Sales: Provide sales support serving as voice of the market to help Insights teams create content and to drive engagement with clients to make progress against their critical priorities to grow their business
* Provide high quality and timely content peer review
* Build credibility as an industry expert to represent Gartner insights, methodology and strategy
* Actively participate in innovation, ideation, and research discussions and collaborate effectively with peers in the Insights community
* Identify research process improvements or develop new processes that help the team and BTI provide excellent service delivery
* Be client-centric while actively seeking to help clients engage regularly and often with Gartner insights and interactions


**What you will need:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; Graduate degree preferred
* 8+ years of relevant field or industry experience
* 5+ years work experience in SaaS/software contract negotiations, technology procurement, category management, vendor management or software asset management within a buying organization, outsourcer, consulting firm, or reseller.
* Extensive, recent, hands-on experience negotiating with ServiceNow (within last 12 months).
* Subject matter expertise in ServiceNow licensing with understanding of the negotiation process, software and cloud services market trends, the global landscape, and reseller ecosystem.
* Experience with software license compliance risk assessment, management, and/or mitigation in a software audit context, particularly with ServiceNow, is desired.
* Experience with other major vendors (e.g., AWS, Google, Salesforce, SAP, Oracle, or Microsoft) is desired.
* Provide clients and prospects with compelling, actionable advice regarding their ServiceNow pricing and contracting needs, including negotiation strategies and ongoing vendor management, via virtual or face-to-face interactions.
* Develop and publish innovative, high-impact insights on software pricing and contracting, especially ServiceNow, via research articles, webinars, events, and client briefings.
* Research, analyze, and forecast trends in software, SaaS, and cloud licensing to deliver forward-looking guidance.
* Demonstrate executive presence; can immediately establish credibility with executives and additional stakeholders
* Strong organizational skills; ability to work under tight deadlines and produce high quality deliverables
* Demonstrate excellence in research and writing ability
* Strong written and verbal proficiency, analytical and presentation skills; ability to engage clients and respond effectively to questions
* Proficient in analyzing and synthesizing data; can effectively apply patterns and frameworks while drawing and defending conclusions to client challenges
* Strong communication skills - able to explain complex concepts concisely and simply
* Subject matter expertise; comfortable presenting at large and small-scale speaking engagements Strong business and financial acumen
* Deep knowledge of the global and competitive landscape within subject area as well as the interplay in that market
* Ability to work independently, while also being intrinsically motivated to collaborate across teams and support the workflow of others, in a multicultural global team
* Learning agile and adept with navigating highly matrixed environments
* Ability to represent Gartner's research methodology and strategies effectively at all levels
* Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% (where applicable)


**Who are we?**
 At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
   

  

 Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.
   

  

 Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.
   

  

**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**
 Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.
   

  

 We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.
   

  

 Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.
   

  

 We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.
   

  

**Gartner is the world authority on AI**
 At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.
   

  

 It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.
   

  

**What do we offer?**
 Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.
   

  

 In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.
   

  

 Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

title: AI Business Development Lead
description:
Vill du vara med och omsätta AI från potential till affär?
   

  

 Advania ALT hjälper organisationer att använda AI för att skapa verkligt affärsvärde. Nu söker vi en
 **AI Business Development Lead** 
 som vill vara med och utveckla vår AI-affär i Sverige.
   

  

**Det här är en roll för dig som kombinerar kommersiell skärpa med en god förståelse för AI.** 
 Du trivs nära kunden, kan identifiera affärsmöjligheter och skapa progression från första dialog till nästa konkreta steg.
   

  

 Hos oss får du en central roll där du arbetar nära partneransvarig, säljorganisationen och Account Managers samt Marketing och Legal. Du rapporterar till Head of Business Development och samarbetar med BDL-kollegor på andra marknader för att dela lärdomar, arbetssätt och affärsmöjligheter när det är relevant.
   

  

 Ditt uppdrag
   

  

 Ditt uppdrag är att omsätta Advania ALTs globala strategi till en svensk GTM strategi, playbook, kvalificerad pipeline, tydlig progression och konkreta affärsresultat.
   

  

 Du arbetar med både befintliga kunder och nya affärsmöjligheter och ansvarar för att:
   

  

  

* Identifiera, kvalificera och utveckla affärsmöjligheter
* Driva AI-relaterade möjligheter framåt genom discovery, workshops och kunddialoger
* Identifiera kundbehov, affärsvärde och rätt beslutsfattare
* Omsätta marknads- och partnerinitiativ till affärsmöjligheter
* Säkerställa struktur, kvalitet och framdrift i pipelinearbetet


 Du driver Advania ALT-dialogen tillsammans med ansvarig Account Manager och involverar specialistkompetenser som Customer Solutions Arkitekter när det skapar värde för kunden.
   

  

 Du kommer snabbt in i uppdraget genom en koncentrerad introduktion och förväntas tidigt börja skapa värde i kunddialoger och pipeline. Det här är en roll för dig som kan agera med ofullständig information, bygga struktur längs vägen och driva arbetet framåt utan att invänta färdiga processer eller material.
   

  

 Erfarenheten och kompetensen vi söker
   

  

 Vi söker dig som har dokumenterad erfarenhet av komplex B2B-försäljning inom enterprise tech, kombinerat med praktisk erfarenhet av AI och en tydlig förståelse för hur AI-lösningar omsätts till konkret affärsvärde för kunden.
   

  

 Du har 5-7 års erfarenhet av att:
   

  

  

* Arbeta kommersiellt med AI-relaterade kundfrågor
* Kvalificera och utveckla affärsmöjligheter med fokus på AI-lösningar
* Navigera beslutsfattare och komplexa intressentbilder
* Omsätta kundbehov till tydliga nästa steg
* Prioritera rätt möjligheter och fokusera där potentialen är störst
* Skapa struktur och framdrift i miljöer som förändras


 Du har en mycket god förståelse för den svenska AI- och techmarknaden och kommunicerar obehindrat på både svenska och engelska samt har ett relevant nätverk inom AI.
   

  

 Det som kommer göra dig framgångsrik
   

  

 Du driver affärsmöjligheter framåt genom att kvalificera, prioritera och skapa tydliga nästa steg. Du avgör när en möjlighet har tillräcklig potential för fortsatt investering, involverar rätt kompetenser när det behövs och säkerställer att aktiviteter leder till faktisk progression.
   

  

 Du arbetar självständigt inom ditt ansvarsområde men bygger resultat tillsammans med andra. Du agerar även när allt ännu inte är färdigutvecklat, skapar den struktur som behövs och driver kunddialoger och interna samarbeten framåt. Genom att omsätta otydliga förutsättningar i tydliga prioriteringar, arbetssätt och nästa steg hjälper du både kunder och interna team att nå affär och genomförande.
   

  

 Därför Advania ALT
   

  

 AI är ett strategiskt tillväxtområde för Advania och en viktig del av hur vi hjälper våra kunder att utveckla sina verksamheter. Här får du möjlighet att påverka, bygga något långsiktigt och arbeta nära några av marknadens mest spännande AI-relaterade affärer. Vi tror på ansvar nära kunden, mandat att agera och samarbete som en naturlig del av självledarskapet.
   

  

 Vi ser fram emot din ansökan! 👋
   

  

 Visa gärna ditt intresse så snart som möjligt då vi intervjuar löpande. Vi välkomnar sökanden med olika bakgrunder, erfarenheter och synsätt, eftersom vi vet att en bredare mångfald berikar var och en av oss och stärker såväl effektivitet som kreativitet i vårt arbete.
   

  

 Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess genomgår våra slutkandidater en obligatorisk bakgrundskontroll, en för oss kvalitativ kontroll inför ett anställningsbeslut. Advania samarbetar med Ljung & Sjöberg i ärenden kopplat till alkohol-, drog- och spelproblematik och är en certifierad "Proaktiv Arbetsplats".
   

  

 Tveka inte att höra av dig om du har några frågor eller funderingar.☀️
   

  

 Det är du som arbetar nära kunden som vet vad dem behöver och vad som blir den bästa lösningen för just deras unika behov, både i dag och i morgon. Därför tycker vi att det är du som ska fatta besluten. Det är genom att erbjuda säkra, hållbara och kundanpassade lösningar som vi skapar värde för kunderna och samhället i stort.
   

  

 Vi bryr oss om hur våra medarbetare mår – på riktigt. Därför samarbetar Advania med Ljung & Sjöberg för att skapa en trygg, proaktiv arbetsmiljö med stöd kring alkohol-, drog- och beroenderelaterade frågor. Tillsammans bygger vi en hållbar arbetsplats där det är okej att be om hjälp, och där förebyggande arbete gör skillnad – för individen, teamet och företaget.
   

  

 I en miljö präglad av stort kundfokus och frihet under ansvar blir det extra viktigt för oss att bygga starka team bestående av ödmjuka stjärnor. Att arbeta i en inkluderande miljö, med kollegor och kunder som vill utvecklas, ger oss möjligheten att trivas och ha riktigt roligt på jobbet. Vi tror på en platt organisation med agilt arbetssätt och flexibilitet. Detta är det enda sättet för en hållbar framtid.
   

  

 Advania Sverige, ”The tech company with people at heart”, har kontor över hela landet, från Luleå i norr till Malmö i syd. Dagligen hjälper våra 1 700 specialister våra kunder, både inom privat och offentlig sektor, i deras ambitioner och mål att digitalisera sina verksamheter. Genom långsiktiga relationer, ledande teknologier, moderna plattformslösningar och strategiska partnerskap formar vi framtidens IT-landskap. Vårt syfte sträcker sig bortom teknik: att ge människor kraften att skapa hållbara värden.
   

  

 Advaniagruppen levererar tjänster till kunder i Sverige, Norge, Storbritannien, Island, Finland och Danmark inom hållbar och säker digitalisering.

title: Enterprise Account Partner - Nordics
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
   

  

 At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
   

  

 As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
   

  

 Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 Join our team of Enterprise Account Partners with diverse backgrounds in technology, life sciences, and consulting services. You will support Veeva's mission of helping our customers, Europe's top pharmaceutical companies, bring their products to market faster.
   

  

 In the role of an Enterprise Account Partner, you will support our key pharma accounts and drive value by positioning Veeva's Commercial Cloud, including software, data, and business consulting. The goal is to strengthen our strategic partnership with our customers, resulting in long-term success and mutual satisfaction.
   

  

 To achieve this goal, you will nurture existing and build new relationships within the accounts and serve as the primary point of contact for VP and C-level executives. You will drive the process of renewing existing business as well as continuously bringing innovative solutions to the customers to help them meet their business objectives. To support you in doing so, you will be working closely with an international team that consists of various product and service owners who are all aligned toward Customer Success.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Protect and expand Veeva's footprint through robust daily account management, a strong focus on operational excellence, and a passion for understanding and supporting your customer's business and IT goals
* Manage the Client Partnerships and the account for Commercials with the goal of being a trusted long-term partner
* Hold accountability for developing and implementing account vision, strategy, and ways of working
* Serve as the ambassador for your customers within Veeva by focusing on their needs and doing the right thing for them
* Actively nurture relationships with decision-makers and key stakeholders across Commercial, Medical, IT, and procurement, and develop new ones as needed
* Navigate complex sales cycles, articulate contextual value propositions, and negotiate key contracts and annual renewals of licenses
* Manage account administration and actively provide input for accurate forecasting
* Keep current with industry trends and expand knowledge of legacy and novel Veeva offerings


**Requirements**
* 8+ years combined experience across software sales/consulting
* Deep understanding of the Life Sciences industry and familiarity with digital transformation for Commercial within the sector
* Proven track record of cultivating multi-layered relationships across multiple functions, including business, IT, and procurement
* Organizational skills with the right amount of attention to detail
* Strong work ethic with the required sense of urgency towards customers' needs
* Self-starter/Self-motivator with little need for direct supervision
* Professional proficiency in English & Danish


****Nice to Have****
* Professional proficiency in Swedish


**Interviewing with Veeva**
 We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.
   

  

* Follow the application process and submit your resume.
* Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
* Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
* If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
+ A conversation with the hiring manager
+ A practical case exercise
+ A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.

* Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.


**Perks & Benefits**
* Annual allocations for charitable contributions
* Fitness reimbursement
* Work anywhere


**Compensation**
* Total compensation: 1,350,000 - 2,250,000 SEK
* The total compensation range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential total compensation range for this role. Please note that actual total compensation may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position's total compensation may be composed of other types of compensation, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.


 Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
   

  

 As an equal opportunity employer, Veeva is committed to fostering a culture of inclusion and growing a diverse workforce. Diversity makes us stronger. It comes in many forms. Gender, race, ethnicity, religion, politics, sexual orientation, age, disability and life experience shape us all into unique individuals. We value people for the individuals they are and the contributions they can bring to our teams.
   

  

 If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need when applying for a role or in our recruitment process, please contact us at talent\_accommodations@veeva.com.

title: Product Analyst - Data & Risk
description:
**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 Product Analysis and Quality Support
 



  




* Support the Merchant Information product team in analysing product performance, quality signals, customer feedback, and operational data.
* Query, structure, and analyse data to identify patterns, recurring issues, inconsistencies, and opportunities for product improvement.
* Create clear visualisations, reports, and summaries that help stakeholders understand performance, quality, progress, and priority areas.
* Support product discovery and delivery by clarifying requirements, documenting expected behaviour, and translating feedback into structured findings.
* Assist with testing, validation, and quality assurance activities, including validating product behaviour during releases, migrations, and changes to data-processing logic.
* Investigate discrepancies between expected and actual product outputs and work with relevant teams to define and track resolution actions.
* Maintain lightweight documentation of findings, quality assessments, test outcomes, decisions, and follow-up actions.



  





**Data Labeling and AI Quality Validation** 




  




* Label and classify transaction and merchant data used to train and improve machine learning and AI models.
* Review and quality assure labeled datasets to ensure accuracy, consistency, completeness, and adherence to defined guidelines.
* Validate AI-generated labels and model outputs, identifying misclassifications, edge cases, data-quality issues, and improvement opportunities.
* Analyse model and classification performance using appropriate measures, including precision, recall, accuracy, F1 score, and confusion matrices.
* Support validation activities for machine learning models and AI-assisted workflows, including models hosted on platforms such as Google Vertex AI.
* Work with Data Scientists and Machine Learning Engineers to improve labeling guidelines, training-data quality, validation processes, and model performance.
* Contribute to the evolution of internal tools, quality frameworks, validation processes, and operating practices as labeling workflows become increasingly automated.



  





**Required Skills and Experience** 




  




* 1–3 years of relevant experience in a product analyst, data analyst, data quality, QA, product operations, data labeling, or similar role in a technology-driven environment.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with exceptional attention to detail and consistency.
* Comfortable working with data using tools such as SQL, spreadsheets, dashboards, or similar analytical tooling.
* Experience working with large datasets, data-quality processes, testing, validation, or business-rule assessment.
* Ability to investigate issues end-to-end, identify patterns and root causes, and communicate findings clearly.
* Understanding of core machine-learning concepts and workflows, including the importance of high-quality training data and model validation.
* Familiarity with classification problems and/or data annotation, labeling, or taxonomy-based workflows.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and to manage changing priorities.



  





**Preferred Skills and Experience** 




  




* Experience analysing transaction data, merchant data, categorisation systems, or other financial-data classification problems.
* Experience with data labeling, annotation, model validation, or AI-assisted labeling workflows.
* Familiarity with model-evaluation concepts and metrics, including precision, recall, F1 score, accuracy, and confusion matrices.
* Experience supporting AI, machine-learning, MLOps, or data-platform environments.
* Familiarity with Google Vertex AI or comparable machine-learning platforms.
* Experience using SQL to investigate data issues and support product or quality analysis.
* Experience with test planning, regression testing, migration validation, or release-quality activities.
* Experience turning customer feedback or operational issues into structured analysis and product recommendations.



  





**What You Will Deliver** 




  





 During the engagement, Product Analysts will help the team to:
 



  




* Improve the accuracy, consistency, and coverage of merchant and transaction categorisation data.
* Establish reliable quality checks for labeled data, AI-generated outputs, and product behaviour.
* Identify and document product, data, and model-quality issues with clear supporting evidence.
* Provide actionable analysis that helps product, engineering, and data-science teams prioritise improvements.
* Support confident releases and migrations through structured testing and validation.
* Strengthen documentation, reporting, and quality-management practices across Data Enrichment and machine learning models.



  





**Personal Attributes** 




  





 We are looking for people who are:
 



  




* Highly detail-oriented, methodical, and quality-focused.
* Curious about how data, products, and AI systems work.
* Comfortable switching between operational execution and analytical problem-solving.
* Proactive in identifying issues and following them through to resolution.
* Able to work independently while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.
* Comfortable operating in an evolving environment where priorities may shift between product analysis, testing, data validation, and labeling work.

title: PMO Manager
description:
atNorth is a leading Nordic data center company providing cost-effective, scalable high-density colocation and built-to-suit services to industry-leading organizations across Iceland, Sweden, Finland, and Denmark.
   

  

 With sustainability at our core, our data centers run on renewable energy and are designed according to circular economy principles. Through innovative design, power efficiency, and intelligent operations, we deliver reliable, secure, and high-performance infrastructure.
   

  

 Headquartered in Reykjavik, Iceland, atNorth operates eight data centers across the Nordics, with additional sites under development in Finland, Denmark, and Sweden.
   

  

 We combine world-class technology with a people-first culture built on collaboration, ownership, and trust, empowering our teams to grow, take responsibility, and make a real impact.
   

  

 By joining our international team, you will help shape the future of sustainable digital infrastructure.
   

  

**PMO Manager at atNorth**
 As a PMO Manager at atNorth, you will play a key role in supporting the successful delivery of large-scale development projects across our growing data center portfolio. Acting as a bridge between project teams and senior management, you will translate complex project information into clear business insights and help ensure informed decision-making across the organization.
   

  

 This is a hands-on role for an experienced project professional who enjoys working closely with project teams, solving delivery challenges, and driving execution. While the role includes exposure to senior stakeholders and opportunities to influence project outcomes, success comes from actively engaging with project teams and supporting delivery on the ground rather than operating purely from a governance perspective.
   

  

 We are looking for someone who can quickly understand complex project environments, build credibility with stakeholders at all levels, and provide practical guidance and challenge to project teams. You will partner closely with Project Delivery Directors and project teams on a day-to-day basis, helping to improve delivery performance and outcomes.
   

  

 This is a unique opportunity to be part of the delivery of some of the most significant data center development projects in the Nordics. You will have visibility across a portfolio of complex, high-value projects while playing an active role in helping teams navigate challenges and achieve successful results.
   

  

**Key responsibilities:**
* Act as a trusted partner to Project Delivery Directors and project teams, providing practical guidance, challenge, and support throughout the project lifecycle.
* Work closely with project teams to identify risks, dependencies, delivery challenges, and opportunities for improvement.
* Translate technical project information into clear, business-focused insights and recommendations for senior leadership.
* Support the development of project reviews, business cases, governance materials, and executive-level reporting.
* Facilitate effective communication between project teams, commercial stakeholders, and leadership forums.
* Drive consistency in project controls, reporting, planning, and governance across the project portfolio.
* Develop practical tools, templates, and training materials that support high-quality project delivery.
* Support and challenge project planning and schedules, helping teams identify critical milestones, dependencies, risks, and potential delivery impacts.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of PMO processes, methodologies, and ways of working.
* Provide constructive challenge to strengthen project planning, execution, decision-making, and delivery outcomes.


**Your profile:**
* Several years of experience in project management, project controls, PMO, project services, or project delivery roles within large-scale construction, infrastructure, industrial, data center, energy, pharmaceutical, or similar capital project environments.
* Strong understanding of how large capital projects are planned, governed, scheduled, and delivered, including familiarity with construction scheduling principles such as critical path, milestones, dependencies, and schedule risk.
* Experience working closely with both project delivery teams and senior business stakeholders.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical project topics into clear business language.
* Proven ability to influence stakeholders, build credibility, and drive alignment across different functions.
* Experience developing presentations, governance materials, business cases, reports, and executive-level communications.
* Ability to quickly understand complex project situations and identify key risks, opportunities, and priorities.
* Demonstrated ability and willingness to work hands-on with project teams and engage in the day-to-day realities of project delivery.
* Hands-on, proactive, and solution-oriented approach with a strong sense of ownership.
* Comfortable operating in evolving international environments and driving continuous improvement.
* Fluency in English.


**About The AtNorth Culture**
 We believe that sustainable success starts with the wellbeing of our people. For us, an open, transparent, and inclusive culture is more than a priority, it is the core of how we lead and innovate.
   

  

 We don’t just talk about culture; we nurture it. Through regular one-to-one engagements and monthly wellbeing surveys, we listen carefully to our teams, ensuring that every voice is heard and every opportunity for improvement is embraced.
   

  

 We recognize that innovation and collaboration thrive where people feel truly connected, which is why we come together each week to share ideas, strengthen relationships, and nurture a sense of belonging, sometimes over a simple breakfast and good conversation.
   

  

 At atNorth, we are building a community where you can do your best work and shape a sustainable future together.

title: IRIS² Programme Manager– EU Communication Gateway (Ground Segment)

* Thrive in building and scaling organisations while delivering under demanding governance and timelines

 Welcome to SSC Space (formerly Swedish Space Corporation), the perfect workplace for those passionate about technology in general and space in particular.

 Are you fueled by a passion for people and the ambition to create an awesome workplace?
