title: Sr. Platform Engineer | Cloud Infrastructure
description:
**Sr. Platform Engineer | Cloud Infrastructure**
================================================


At TV4, our engineers build and operate the technology behind TV4 Play and MTV Katsomo, used by millions of people every week.


Within Engineering Platform, we build the shared cloud infrastructure and platform capabilities used by engineering teams across TV4. We are now looking for a **Sr. Platform Engineer** to help develop our Internal Developer Platform.

***Before you apply***

*To be considered, you need to* ***already have the right to work and reside in Sweden*** *and be able to work office-first from Stockholm. We are not able to offer relocation or visa sponsorship for this role.*

**What we are building**
------------------------


Our engineering teams own the software they build, from development through production. Engineering Platform provides the shared foundation that supports them.


Our platform is built around AWS, Kubernetes and infrastructure as code. We are moving more shared infrastructure capabilities into the platform, with clearer abstractions and self-service for engineering teams.


We want to provide clear interfaces and sensible defaults without taking ownership away from the teams running the software.


Our users are engineers, and the platform needs to work well for them.

**What you will do**
--------------------


You will work in a small team responsible for our cloud platform and Internal Developer Platform.


You will:

* Build and evolve shared cloud infrastructure and platform capabilities
* Develop self-service capabilities for engineering teams
* Improve how services are provisioned, deployed and operated
* Turn recurring infrastructure needs into shared platform capabilities that teams can use themselves
* Work with teams across TV4 to understand where the platform creates friction or unnecessary work
* Improve reliability, observability, security and operational practices across the platform
* Take responsibility for the capabilities you build in production
* Contribute to technical direction and platform architecture


This is a hands-on engineering role. You will work close to both the underlying infrastructure and the engineers using it.

**About you**
-------------


You are an experienced platform or infrastructure engineer who has built and operated production environments at scale.


You understand cloud infrastructure deeply enough to know where abstraction helps and where it gets in the way. You are comfortable working below the abstraction when needed, but also interested in creating platforms that make good engineering practices easier for other teams.


We are looking for:

* Strong experience with modern cloud infrastructure
* Experience with Kubernetes and containerised production environments
* Infrastructure as code and automated provisioning
* Experience designing or building internal platforms, developer platforms or self-service infrastructure
* Strong understanding of reliability, observability, networking and security
* Experience operating systems in production and handling incidents
* Good software engineering fundamentals and the ability to build platform tooling and services
* The ability to make technical trade-offs across infrastructure, developer experience and operational complexity
* Clear communication and experience working across engineering teams


You don’t have to have experience with all of these things to be a good fit for the role, but they are things you will encounter at TV4. Experience from a specific cloud provider or toolset is less important than understanding the underlying problems.

**Platform as a product**
-------------------------


Our users are engineers across TV4. We work closely with them to understand recurring problems, decide what belongs in the platform and build capabilities that work across teams.


This requires strong infrastructure knowledge as well as an interest in developer experience and product thinking.

**Engineering Platform**
------------------------


Engineering Platform consists of two closely related parts:

**Cloud Infrastructure / Internal Developer Platform** builds the cloud platform and shared capabilities our teams use to build, deploy and operate software, with an increasing focus on self-service and platform abstractions.

**Agent Platform** focuses on how we build software: agentic workflows, developer tooling and AI-assisted engineering.


This role belongs to Cloud Infrastructure, but the two areas work closely together.

**Technical environment**
-------------------------


Your day-to-day may include:

* AWS
* Kubernetes
* Terraform/OpenTofu
* kro and ACK
* GitHub Actions
* Go, TypeScript and other languages used across our engineering organisation
* PostgreSQL, DynamoDB and OpenSearch
* Grafana and OpenTelemetry


You’ll build APIs, CLI tooling and internal developer tooling on top of this. The exact technologies will continue to evolve. We care more about strong platform engineering fundamentals than experience with every tool in our current stack.

**What TV4 offers**
-------------------

* A senior engineering role with significant influence over the platform used across our engineering organisation
* Short paths from idea to decision and high autonomy
* Experienced engineering colleagues and technically challenging problems
* Collective agreement, occupational pension, insurance and wellness allowance
* Benify, your choice of phone and MacBook Pro
* Office with gym, restaurant and garage

**Practical information**
-------------------------


TV4 is office-first and we work from our Stockholm office four days a week.


The position is permanent with a six-month probationary period.


Union affiliation: Unionen.


A background check is part of the recruitment process.


We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Masters Thesis student
description:
SiC MOSFETs have been commercialized over the years in pursuit of lower on-resistance and higher switching performance but there are still some gate oxide related challenges related to material properties. Dynamic Gate Switching (DGS) instability is a phenomenon when a SiC MOSFET is switched in a bipolar mode (from a positive to a negative Vgs) and this leads to permanent shift of the threshold voltage (ΔV th ). This effect occurs during application conditions but can be observed also by using just a gate driver for the switching with the SiC MOSFET drain and gate shorted. Previous investigations into the DGS instability have mostly been limited to room temperature conditions. This Thesis work will involve understanding of this phenomenon as a function of temperature which might lead to creation of a test setup to enable these measurements. Characterization will be done both for packaged devices as well as on wafer level, and the Vth drift behaviour will be modeled.


  
* Responsibilities

  
* Perform electrical characterization of experimentally fabricated SiC MOSFETs.
* Carry out reliability investigation measurements both directly on wafers and on packaged devices.
* Use a semi-automatic wafer-probing system equipped with a Keithley parameter analyzer.
* Use Python and microcontroller programming for automation and data extraction.
* Conduct SEM-cross sections in the Electrum clean room to investigate samples and support the process integration team (not directly connected to the dynamic gate stress analysis).
* Investigate influence of experimental parameters on the dynamic gate stress

  
Qualifications
  
Qualifications – External

To be considered for an internship, you must be currently enrolled in a degree seeking program. This position is specifically looking for someone who will be enrolled in [DEGREE PROGRAM].

The opportunity to shape 5G Standalone evolution and future 6G direction. Significant influence on customer experience, operational resilience and network efficiency. title: Certification Engineer
description:
Rebaba is building circular battery systems from second-life EV batteries. Our products power buildings, industries, and charging infrastructure while reducing costs and emissions. We design and assemble our systems in Sweden and combine hardware, embedded software, and cloud control into one integrated platform. We are now hiring a Certification Engineer to build and own our certification process from the ground up, making sure everything we design, build, and ship meets the standards, directives, and safety requirements.
  
  

You will shape how Rebaba certifies BESS systems today and become one of the few real experts in the world in certifying second-life BESS. If you want to go deep on real electrical systems, own a process end to end, and become a genuine expert in a field that barely exists yet, we would love to hear from you. As Certification Engineer at Rebaba you will own the full certification process for our BESS products, from reading and interpreting the applicable directives and standards, to defining what needs to be tested and how, to producing the technical documentation that proves it. This is a hands-on role that sits between engineering, quality, and delivery.
  
  

You will work closely with our engineering team and external certification partners, and over time become the internal and external authority on what it takes to certify second-life battery systems for European markets. Responsibilities Build, own, and continuously improve Rebaba's certification process for BESS products, covering LVD, EMC, and the EU Battery Regulation Interpret and apply the standards, directives, and regulations governing battery systems, electrical safety, EMC, and enclosures (e.g. IEC 62619, IEC 62933, UN 38.3, CE marking, the Low Voltage and EMC Directives, RoHS), and determine which requirements are applicable to our specific product design Translate standards and customer, grid, and safety requirements into clear, traceable technical requirements for the engineering teams, and maintain requirements traceability across product development Define what tests need to be run, how, and against which acceptance criteria, based on the relevant standards Plan and manage compliance and certification activities as projects - scope, timeline, testing, documentation, and sign-off Coordinate and align certification processes with notified bodies, test labs, and external partners; select and manage external test labs Own technical compliance documentation, including declarations of conformity, technical files, risk assessments, and test reports, ensuring every compliance claim is traceable to a primary source Lead product safety, hazard, and risk analyses for our battery systems Track open regulatory and standard-interpretation questions, escalate where needed, and drive them to closure Work closely with electronics, mechanical, software, and quality teams to build compliance into the design from the start Keep Rebaba ahead of evolving standards and regulatory requirements in energy storage, and feed changes back into the product Lay the path for how certification scales as Rebaba expands into new products and markets Requirements Experience with power electronics and electrical systems in one or more of: UPS systems, PV inverters, LV switchgear, EV charging infrastructure, motor drives/VFDs, EV battery packs, or stationary battery/backup power systems Solid understanding of core electrical concepts relevant to BESS: insulation coordination, DC/DC or DC/AC power conversion, contactor/switching logic, short-circuit protection Comfortable reading and working directly with electrical schematics and system architecture, not just specifications Well-versed and structured in requirements analysis and requirements management Comfortable working across electronics, mechanical, and software teams and translating between them You are exceptionally rigorous and precise, read regulations and standards carefully and literally You have the patience to trace every claim back to its source, and the discipline to keep detailed, structured records over long-running projects Professional English; Swedish is a plus You thrive in an entrepreneurial environment with fast decision cycles and high autonomy You are excited about clean energy and want to build something you believe in Meriting Prior experience with product certification, CE marking, or regulatory compliance Experience with IEC 62933, IEC 62477-1, IEC 61439-1, IEC 62619, or IEC 60664-1 Background in battery chemistry, EV batteries, or second-life applications Prior direct contact with notified bodies or testing laboratories Experience with gap analysis or risk tracking in technical/regulatory projects Benefits Own certification end to end, in a field where the playbook is still being written Become one of the few real experts in certifying second-life BESS, in Europe or anywhere Close collaboration with a small, hands-on engineering team A mission-driven company focused on sustainable energy solutions A clear path to grow as Rebaba scales - in seniority, responsibility, and scope About Rebaba Rebaba is at the forefront of sustainable energy storage solutions. title: Radar Sensing Algorithm Researcher
description:
**Join our Team**
-----------------


**Shape the future of sensing and wireless communication**

  

What if the next generation of mobile networks could do more than connect people and devices? What if they could also sense, interpret, and understand the world around them?  

At Ericsson, we are turning that vision into reality through Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC) research. Join us as a researcher and help develop the sensing and tracking technologies that will influence future 5G and 6G radio networks.

 **About the Opportunity**

  

You will join the AI & Technology Foresight unit within Business Area Networks. We explore what comes next across Ericsson’s full technology portfolio—from antennas and radio systems to cloud, and turn promising ideas into real-world solutions. We are a community of nearly 400 researchers based across our main sites in Kista, Lund, and Paris. Our strength is the breadth of expertise we bring together: the capabilities to research, prototype, and build state-of-the-art mobile networks.

  

Within this environment, you will collaborate with experienced researchers and product teams to prove new concepts, challenge established thinking, and help set the direction for future radio network products. You will be part of Ericsson’s Integrated Sensing and Communication research program, where we research, develop, and validate advanced ISAC systems for 5G and 6G. You will work with one of the world’s most experienced teams in this field, contributing to research that connects theory, experimentation, and product development. Your work will focus on radar sensing, signal processing, and tracking in challenging environments; including dense urban areas and complex sea-clutter scenarios.

 **What you will do**

* Conduct research in radar sensing, signal processing, detection, and tracking algorithms.
* Develop simulations and generate data for synthetic use cases focused on urban environments.
* Investigate methods for robust radar sensing and tracking in challenging urban scenarios.
* Explore extended-object radar trackers suitable for dense urban environments.
* Develop algorithms for tracking sea objects in the presence of dense sea clutter.
* Collaborate with product teams to integrate research results into Ericsson products in an efficient and optimized way.
* Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies in sensing design and wireless communication.
* Generate intellectual property in the ISAC area.
* Share knowledge and communicate results with stakeholders across research and product development.
 **Skills you bring**

* A recently completed PhD, or equivalent research experience, focused on radar detection pipelines, signal processing, or related fields.
* Strong understanding of radar sensing and the characteristics of different sensors, including sensor artefacts such as phase noise.
* Practical experience working with environmental clutter, with hands-on knowledge of sea clutter considered essential.
* Working knowledge of data fusion and end-to-end tracking pipelines.
* Experience developing and evaluating both point-object and extended-object tracking algorithms.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to connect theoretical research to practical prototypes and product solutions.
* A passion for innovation, curiosity to explore new approaches, and the confidence to turn ideas into demonstrable results.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the personal drive to challenge ideas respectfully, work across diverse teams, and deliver results.

We recognize that we all have transferrable skills, and we can support you with the skills that you need to develop.Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, that's why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

title: Financial Controller
description:

Do you thrive in a fast-moving environment where you can take ownership, create structure and develop smarter ways of working?


Collective Minds is looking for a driven Financial Controller to strengthen our finance function and support our continued international growth. This is an opportunity to take on a broad role with real impact in an innovative Healthtech company.

Collective Minds is based in Stockholm/Danderyd and we operate globally across clinical trials and life sciences. We are an imaging platform for clinical trials that connects hospitals, experts, and industry - including CROs, pharma, biotech, medtech, and eClinical vendors - enabling trials with imaging endpoints and the generation of high-quality evidence faster and more efficiently. title: Director of Security Technology
description:
**Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for a Director of Security Technology to team up with the most dedicated team of cyber specialists.**

##### **About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company**


Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.


Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond, and Recover.


Today, we are around 450 employees – and as cybercrime grows, we need to grow. To support that goal, we are now looking for a Director of Security Technology for our Managed Service unit.

##### **The Role**


As Director of Security Technology, you will define and drive the Managed Services security technology vision, strategy and transformation roadmap.


Your focus will be to accelerate the evolution of our security operations model — enhancing today’s expert-led SOC and MDR delivery with an increasingly AI-enabled, automation-driven and agentic operating model. The goal is to improve scalability, speed, consistency, detection and response effectiveness, analyst effectiveness, cost-to-serve and customer outcomes. We are not looking for a powerpoint wizard, but a hands on technology driven enthusiast.


You will act as the primary Managed Services counterpart to Truesec’s Technology organization on security technology strategy, AI, automation and roadmap alignment. Because this transformation directly affects SOC workflows, roles and daily operations, you will work in close partnership with the Head of SOC, who owns SOC adoption, people readiness and sustained delivery quality.

##### **What You Will Do:**

* Define, maintain, develop and execute on the Managed Services security technology vision, with AI-enabled and agentic security operations as the strategic north star.
* Accelerate ongoing transformation initiatives across AI, automation, orchestration, analytics and security operations tooling by teaming up with colleagues and hands on build the solutions needed to achieve it.
* Translate the vision into clear technology principles, roadmap priorities and transformation themes.
* Drive the roadmap toward a more scalable, AI-supported and automation-led operating model.
* Define how humans, automation and AI agents should interact across triage, enrichment, investigation, escalation, response, reporting and quality assurance.
* Identify and prioritize automation opportunities across Managed Services together with SOC, Security Engineering & Architecture, Service Owners and Technology.
* Own Managed Services security technology roadmap input and translate SOC needs, operational pain points and customer outcomes into clear technology requirements.
* Co-lead SOC technology adoption with the Head of SOC, including readiness, training, communication, feedback loops and quality controls.
* Build trust in AI and automation through transparency, analyst involvement, human oversight and measurable quality outcomes.
* Ensure technology capabilities support stronger detection and response outcomes, including investigation quality, threat discovery, response speed and consistency.
* Support Service Owners with technology input for MDR, OT and related managed security services.
* Establish technology-side governance, guardrails and human oversight requirements for AI-enabled and automated security operations.
* Communicate strategy, roadmap progress, risks, dependencies and outcomes to Managed Services leadership and executive stakeholders.
##### **Your Potential Background**


We believe you are an experienced cybersecurity technology leader with a strong understanding of SOC, MDR and managed security operations. You know how to move from promising technology concepts to practical, scalable and trusted operational capabilities and have been implementing solutions on an operational, tactical and strategical level previously.


You combine strategic thinking with operational realism and understand how technology impacts people, workflows, service quality and customer outcomes. You are comfortable accelerating and executing transformation in an environment where skilled experts, established delivery models and emerging AI capabilities need to work together.

**To succeed in this role, you likely have:**

* Extensive experience in cybersecurity technology, SOC/MDR, managed security services, AI-enabled security operations, automation, SIEM/XDR/EDR, cloud platforms or data platforms.
* Strong understanding of SOC/MDR operating models and how to scale security operations through technology.
* Experience defining technology strategy and translating business and operational needs into roadmaps.
* Experience leading technology transformation, automation programs or operating model change.

title: Microsoft Security Consultant
description:
**About Us**

  

Integrity360 is a leading independent cybersecurity and PCI specialist operating across Europe, Africa, the Caribbean, and North America. The company has office locations in Ireland, the UK, Bulgaria, Italy, Sweden, Spain, Lithuania, Ukraine, Africa, the Caribbean, and Canada, supported by eight Security Operations Centres (SOCs) located in Dublin, Sofia, Madrid, Stockholm, Paris, Rome, Johannesburg and Cape Town.

  

With over 900 employees, including more than 600 dedicated cybersecurity professionals, Integrity360 delivers a full suite of professional, support, and managed security services. These span the complete cyber risk lifecycle, from identification and prevention to detection, response, and recovery. Integrity360 supports over 3000 mid-market and enterprise organisations across sectors including financial services, insurance, government, healthcare, retail, telecommunications, and utilities.

  

At Integrity360, people come first. We invest heavily in learning, development and progression, fostering a dynamic culture where innovation, collaboration and continuous growth are at the heart of what we do. If you're ready to take your cyber security career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you.

 **Job Role / Responsibilities**

  

As a Microsoft Security Engineer, you will be responsible for onboarding clients to our managed security service, with Microsoft Sentinel at the centre of the solution. You will configure and integrate Sentinel environments, onboard and validate log sources, and prepare each deployment for effective monitoring and operational handover to the Security Operations Centre.

  

Your primary focus will be the technical delivery of new Microsoft Sentinel onboardings. This includes workspace and connector configuration, data collection design, log-source integration, ingestion filtering, validation, detection tuning and the production of high-level design and implementation documentation. You will work closely with clients, architects and SOC teams to ensure each deployment is supportable, secure and aligned with the contracted service scope.

  

The role also requires hands-on experience, or a clear ability to develop quickly, in onboarding Microsoft Defender XDR workloads such as Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365 and Defender for Cloud Apps. You will help establish the integrations, policies and operational workflows required to provide joined-up detection and response across the Microsoft security ecosystem.

  

This is a client-facing engineering role within Professional Services, reporting to the Head of Cloud Security & Microsoft Security Services. You will manage assigned onboarding activities from discovery and design through implementation, testing, documentation and handover. You will be supported by an experienced team and have access to training and certification opportunities across Microsoft security technologies.

 **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Deliver end-to-end onboarding of client Microsoft Sentinel environments into the MSSP service.
* Configure Sentinel workspaces, content solutions, data connectors, analytics rules, automation rules, watchlists, workbooks and related components in accordance with approved designs and service standards.
* Run technical discovery sessions to identify log sources, connectivity requirements, data volumes, retention needs, dependencies and onboarding priorities.
* Onboard Microsoft, third-party, cloud, network, identity and application log sources using supported collection methods, including Azure Monitor Agent, Data Collection Rules, APIs, syslog, CEF and custom connectors where appropriate.
* Design and implement data filtering and transformation to improve signal quality, control ingestion costs and ensure the service receives the telemetry required for monitoring and detection.
* Validate data ingestion, parsing, field mapping, timestamps, health and coverage, and troubleshoot issues across source systems, collectors, networks and Azure services.
* Tune analytics rules, alert logic and incident generation in collaboration with SOC and detection engineering teams to reduce unnecessary noise while maintaining appropriate coverage.
* Onboard and integrate Microsoft Defender XDR workloads, including Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365 and Defender for Cloud Apps.
* Produce accurate high-level designs, implementation plans, configuration records, test evidence, operational runbooks and handover documentation.
* Coordinate with clients, project managers, architects, SOC analysts and service teams to manage dependencies, risks, actions and readiness for service transition.
* Apply repeatable engineering standards, peer review and change control, and contribute improvements to onboarding templates, technical patterns and internal procedures.
* Support troubleshooting and remediation during onboarding and early-life support, escalating product or service dependencies where required.
* Undertake occasional travel where required to support client delivery.

  

**Essential**

  

* Hands-on experience deploying, configuring or supporting Microsoft Sentinel in production or customer environments.
* Practical knowledge of Sentinel data connectors, Log Analytics workspaces, Azure Monitor Agent, Data Collection Rules, syslog and CEF collection patterns.
* Strong Kusto Query Language skills for data validation, troubleshooting, investigation and detection tuning.
* Experience onboarding and troubleshooting log sources across Microsoft 365, Azure, endpoints, identity, network, security and third-party platforms.
* Understanding of ingestion filtering, data transformation, parsing, normalisation, retention and the cost implications of security telemetry.
* Experience creating clear technical designs and delivery documentation, including HLDs, implementation plans, test records and operational handover materials.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Defender XDR and the integration of its workloads with Microsoft Sentinel.
* Sound understanding of SIEM operations, detection engineering principles, incident workflows and the requirements of a managed security service.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across Azure, APIs, identity, networking and data collection components.
* Confident written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work directly with technical and non-technical client stakeholders.
* Ability to manage assigned work independently while collaborating effectively with project, architecture, SOC and service teams.

  

**Desired**

  

* Experience working for an MSSP, MDR provider, Security Operations Centre or security-focused professional services team.
* Development of custom log parsers, KQL functions, ASIM-compatible content or other normalisation patterns for non-standard data sources.
* Experience with DevOps pipelines and source control for Microsoft Sentinel content, configuration and deployment.
* Practical knowledge of detection as code, including versioning, testing, peer review and controlled promotion of analytics content between environments.
* Experience with infrastructure as code and automation using technologies such as Bicep, ARM templates, Terraform, PowerShell, Azure CLI, Logic Apps or APIs.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Sentinel repositories, content management and repeatable multi-customer deployment patterns.
* Experience integrating Microsoft security services across tenants, subscriptions or delegated administration models such as Azure Lighthouse.
* Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK and its application to detection coverage and use-case mapping.

  

  

**Desired Qualifications**

  

* Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200).
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500/SC-500).
* Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC-100).
* Relevant Microsoft Applied Skills covering Sentinel, Defender XDR, security operations or automation.
* Other relevant security or cloud certifications are beneficial but not essential.

title: Senior AI Engineer - Center of Excellence
description:
### **About this role**


Enterprise software is going through its biggest shift in decades. Applications are moving from deterministic workflows to intelligent, agentic systems that understand context, remember preferences, and act on behalf of users. This isn’t a future prediction, it's happening now, and Columbus is building at the frontier of it.

**We're hiring a Senior AI Engineer to become a key part of our Group AI team.** In this role, you'll help design and build the next generation of AI-powered systems that will transform how thousands of people work across the Nordics and beyond. You'll work directly with the VP Group AI. No layers. No committees. You build, you ship, you learn.


We're looking for a senior engineer who can operate across the full AI stack, from application design and intelligent agents to enterprise integrations, data platforms, and AI infrastructure. You combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution and thrive in an environment where you can influence both architecture and implementation.


This is not a consulting engagement or a proof-of-concept. It's production engineering at enterprise scale, on the Microsoft platform, using the most advanced AI models available today.

### **What you will bring**


We are looking for someone who has:

* Strong expertise in LLM application design, including prompt engineering, agent frameworks, tool integration, and evaluation methodologies.
* A solid understanding of how data platforms and governance enable AI-driven insights and intelligent systems.
* Experience building scalable, production-grade AI solutions, with focus on context management, performance optimisation, observability, and cost control.
* Proven ability to design and implement agentic and multi-agent architectures in enterprise environments.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 technologies, including Graph, Teams, SharePoint, and cloud-native platforms such as Azure.
* Deep knowledge of retrieval systems, vector databases, embeddings, document processing, and RAG architectures.
* Experience building robust event-driven and API-first systems with strong focus on security, compliance, and enterprise-grade reliability.
* Strong understanding of AI Security, Responsible AI, and AI Governance principles.
* The ability to move confidently between AI applications, integrations, infrastructure, architecture, and engineering leadership.

**You are comfortable operating across three key domains:**

#### **AI Applications**


You design and build intelligent AI experiences powered by LLMs, agents, tools, and orchestration frameworks. You understand model behaviour, prompt engineering, evaluation strategies, context management, and how to create reliable AI solutions that deliver measurable business value.

#### **AI Automation & Integration**


You connect AI capabilities with enterprise systems through Microsoft Graph, Teams, SharePoint, APIs, workflows, and cloud services. You understand how to embed AI into business processes while maintaining security, governance, and operational excellence.

#### **AI Infrastructure & Knowledge Systems**


You build the foundation that makes enterprise AI possible. From vector search and document processing to RAG architectures, knowledge retrieval, and governance frameworks, you can design scalable and compliant AI platforms that perform in production environments.

**While no candidate is expected to be a world-class specialist in every discipline, we're looking for a senior AI engineer who has strong experience across all three areas and can bring them together into practical, production-ready solutions.**

### **Application**


At our company, you can easily apply using your LinkedIn profile or your CV, without having to fill out long questionnaires. You do not need to submit a cover letter.


In our recruitment process, we use logic and personality tests. We always check references and conduct a background check before an employment offer is made. If you have any questions, you are welcome to contact the responsible recruiter Daniel Sparrow. Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis.


After the recruitment process has ended, we will ask you about your experience as a candidate. It only takes a few seconds to answer, and it helps us improve our recruitment process.

### **Working at Columbus**


People always come first at Columbus. We are a global consulting firm with local presence, helping companies with their digital transformation and to thrive through technology, data, and human insight. We are also a workplace where you, as an employee, can develop your career and get support through clear and structured career paths.  

  

Our culture is built on trust, collaboration, curiosity, and a shared commitment to deliver value to our clients. Whether you’re experienced or just starting out in your career, you’ll find the freedom to explore ideas, challenge the familiar, and shape your own path with us.  

  

With more than 1,500 colleagues in over 10 countries, we combine global perspectives with local understanding. What unites us is our belief in creating meaningful impact – for our employees, our clients, and the journey ahead.


Let’s thrive, grow, and shape the future together!


### **What others say about us**


Interested in Columbus behind the scenes? Each week, we let a colleague take over our Instagram account.


At Careereye, current and former employees can share their **unfiltered reviews about what it’s like to work with us**. Click below to read their experiences.

Join Cloud Foundations and help build the cloud platform the rest of the bank develops on. We deliver landing zones, guardrails and platform capabilities in Google Cloud so SEB's developers can move fast without compromising on security or compliance.
   

  

 This is a senior developer role with tech lead responsibility for our GCP platform. Our Solution Architect owns the target architecture. You own how it gets built: you lead the development work that turns architecture into a platform in production, and you are the link between the two. When a design meets reality, you are the one who spots what does not hold and takes it back to the architect.
   

  

 You still write code every week. You have no line management responsibility, but you are the technical lead for GCP development in the team, and one of a pair with the architect for the platform.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
* Develop and maintain our landing zones and underlying platform capabilities in Google Cloud together with the team.
* Lead the realisation of the target architecture: break it down into buildable work, set the technical direction for how it is implemented and see it through to production.
* Work side by side with our Solution Architect for GCP: pressure-test designs against implementation reality and from a security perspective, feed back what you learn from building, and support the architecture work with hands-on input.
* Set the bar for code quality, CI/CD and automated testing, and make it easy for the team to do the right thing.
* Take the lead when the situation is unclear: break the problem down, propose a solution and make the call on how it gets built.
* Be the go-to person for GCP implementation in our department, including work that stretches across several teams.
* Drive lifecycle management of the platform and stay ahead of technical debt before it gets expensive.
* Advise architects and development teams across the bank on how to build well on the platform.
* Coach colleagues through code review, pair programming and mentoring, and take part in hiring new team members.


**Who You Are**
 You are a driven, proactive and collaborative engineer who takes ownership and enjoys solving complex problems. You share what you know, you are not satisfied with the first solution that happens to work, and you can move between an architecture discussion and a pull request in the same afternoon. Openness and transparency are your baseline in a team.
   

  

**Skills And Experience**
* Several years of hands-on development in Google Cloud, with a track record of solutions you have built, launched and maintained over time.
* Experience of leading development work without formal line management, in a team or across several teams.

* Financial services or another regulated industry.
* Google Cloud certifications such as Professional Cloud Architect or similar.
* Public speaking and knowledge sharing outside your own organization.


**What We Offer**
* A technical team of around fifteen people where you have real influence over the platform.
* A platform used by development teams across the whole bank, with a long life expectancy on what we deliver.
* A clear technical lead role, with an architect next to you rather than above you.
* Room to broaden into our other cloud platforms, Azure and AWS, further down the road if you want to.
* A hybrid workplace with a balance between office and home.
* SEB staff banking and our wider benefits package.
* An office next door to Mall of Scandinavia in Solna.

title: Systems Developer – föräldravikariat
description:
Hos Adlibris älskar vi böcker och teknik lika mycket. Nu söker vi en Systems Developer till team Core för ett föräldravikariat på 13 månader. Du bygger skalbara tjänster, API:er och integrationer i Azure och får ett tydligt utvecklaransvar från start.
   

  

 Eftersom det är ett vikariat söker vi dig som har gjort liknande arbete tidigare och snabbt kommer in i en ny kodbas och ett nytt team.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Team Core ansvarar för Adlibris kärntjänster, såsom pris, produkt, inköp och kundorder, samt integrationerna mellan dem och vår e-handel. Vi bygger flera core-tjänster in-house, integrerar mer med SaaS-tjänster och flyttar successivt våra applikationer till en ny Kubernetes-baserad plattform i Azure.
   

  

 Som Systems Developer utvecklar du de tjänster och integrationer som körs på plattformen, medan vårt Platform-team ansvarar för själva plattformen.
   

  

**Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden**
* Designa, utveckla och underhålla skalbara och säkra applikationer och tjänster i Azure
* Bygga och vidareutveckla API:er som andra system och team använder
* Utveckla eventdrivna integrationer
* Containerisera och driftsätta tjänster på vår Kubernetes-baserade plattform, i samarbete med Platform-teamet
* Bygga och underhålla CI/CD-pipelines för applikationerna i GitLab och GitHub
* Underhålla och felsöka databaser i SQL Server
* Felsöka och förbättra prestanda och stabilitet i produktion


**Vem söker vi – kvalifikationer (krav)**
* Minst 3 års erfarenhet av backend- eller systemutveckling i produktion, främst i C#/.NET
* Praktisk erfarenhet av att utveckla och driftsätta applikationer i Azure, t.ex. Azure Functions, App Services eller AKS
* Erfarenhet av att designa och bygga API:er (t.ex. REST) och integrationer mellan system
* Erfarenhet av eller god förståelse för eventdriven arkitektur
* Erfarenhet av SQL Server
* Erfarenhet av CI/CD, gärna i GitLab och GitHub
* Erfarenhet av att använda AI-verktyg i utvecklingsarbetet, t.ex. GitHub Copilot, Cursor eller Claude Code
* Stark problemlösningsförmåga och analytiskt arbetssätt – du är van att felsöka och förbättra applikationer i produktion
* Relevant eftergymnasial utbildning, t.ex. högskola eller YH, eller motsvarande erfarenhet
* Behärskar svenska flytande i tal och skrift


**Meriterande**
* Erfarenhet av JavaScript eller TypeScript
* Erfarenhet av stora datavolymer
* Erfarenhet av integration med SaaS-tjänster
* Erfarenhet av Infrastructure as Code, t.ex. Terraform
* Erfarenhet av containerisering och att driftsätta tjänster i Kubernetes


**Som person**
 Du är självgående och kommer snabbt in i en ny kodbas och ett nytt team. Du tar ansvar för helheten i det du bygger, från design till drift, och samarbetar gärna med utvecklare, arkitekter och Platform-teamet. Du kommunicerar tydligt, både i dokumentation och i dialog med verksamheten.
   

  

**Varför Adlibris & Tech?**
 Inom Tech på Adlibris driver vi bolaget framåt med nyfikenhet, mod och teknisk spetskompetens – vi bygger inte bara för dagens behov, utan för det som ännu inte finns. Som Systems Developer blir du en del av team Core, som bygger kärntjänsterna för pris, produkt, inköp och kundorder som hela vår e-handel vilar på. Vi arbetar cloud-native med containrar, mikrotjänster och API:er, och automatiserar det mesta – från bygg och test till deploy – så att vi kan leverera ofta och tryggt. Vi tror på SaaS first där det är rätt val, och vi experimenterar, lär av både framgångar och misstag, och delar kunskap med varandra längs vägen.
   

  

**Anställningsform och startdatum**
* Föräldravikariat på heltid i 13 månader, med möjlighet till förlängning
* Start 1 december 2026
* Vi tillbringar större delen av vår arbetstid i våra fina kontorslokaler i centrala Stockholm


**Låter detta som din nästa utmaning? Urval sker löpande, så skicka in din ansökan redan idag!**
*Adlibris hanterar rekryteringsprocessen internt och ber vänligen att inte bli kontaktade av rekryteringsföretag eller externa rekryterare som erbjuder kandidater.*

title: Regional Marketing Manager - Nordic Region
description:
We’re looking for a commercially minded, full-funnel Marketing Manager to lead enterprise and acquisition marketing across the Nordic region, with a strong focus on high-growth AI/Digital Natives. The role reports to the Head of Northern Europe Marketing and will be part of the International Marketing organisation.
   

  

 This role blends regional field marketing expertise with a modern, data-driven growth mindset: building awareness, creating qualified pipeline, accelerating conversion, and establishing MongoDB as the partner of choice for AI-native companies and Enterprise organisations.
   

  

 The successful candidate will own the regional marketing strategy and execution across the region. They will partner closely with Sales, SDRs, Partner Marketing, Product Marketing, Developer Relations, and Growth teams to drive focused acquisition programs for AI/Digital Natives across the region.
   

  

 We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Stockholm for our hybrid working model.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

 Regional strategy and execution
   

  

* Build and execute an integrated marketing plan for the Nordics, aligned to revenue priorities, target accounts, segments, and country-specific market dynamics
* Translate global & EMEA campaigns into locally relevant programs that generate awareness, engagement, and measurable pipeline
* Own the regional marketing mix, including field events, executive programs, digital demand generation, partner motions, communities, and third-party activations
* Manage regional budget, agency relationships, timelines, and performance reporting
* Ensure programs reflect local languages, culture, buying behaviours, and regulatory requirements where appropriate


 AI/Digital Natives acquisition
   

  

* Design and run acquisition campaigns that identify, engage, and convert early-stage and scaling AI/Digital Natives
* Define priority startup audiences, buying centres, use cases, triggers, and conversion paths in partnership with Sales, Product Marketing, and Developer Relations
* Develop high-value offers and experiences for technical founders, builders, data leaders, and platform teams, such as workshops, community programs, ecosystem events, webinars, and nurture journeys
* Build account-based and lifecycle programs that move startup prospects from awareness through activation, opportunity creation, and expansion readiness
* Work with ecosystem partners, venture capital firms, accelerators, cloud providers, and developer communities to extend reach and credibility


 Revenue partnership and optimisation
   

  

* Partner with regional Sales leadership to set shared pipeline targets, prioritise accounts, and convert campaign engagement into next-best actions
* Establish clear measurement across sourced and influenced pipeline, conversion rates, cost efficiency, account engagement, event performance, and acquisition velocity
* Use campaign and customer data to continually test audiences, messages, channels, offers, and follow-up motions
* Communicate insights, risks, and recommendations to regional and global stakeholders; scale successful programs to other markets where relevant


 What you’ll bring
   

  

* 6+ years of B2B marketing experience, including field, demand generation, growth, or acquisition marketing in technology, SaaS, cloud, developer tools, or data platforms
* Demonstrated experience building integrated regional marketing plans that drive measurable pipeline and revenue outcomes
* Strong understanding of the Nordic technology market, including its enterprise, startup, partner, and developer ecosystems
* Experience marketing to startups or technical audiences; familiarity with AI, data, cloud, developer, or infrastructure buying journeys is strongly preferred
* Proven ability to work cross-functionally with Sales and technical stakeholders, translating business priorities into executable campaigns
* Excellent analytical skills and comfort using marketing automation, CRM, intent, and campaign-performance data to make decisions
* Strong project-management skills, including managing multiple programs, partners, and budgets in a fast-moving environment
* Exceptional written and verbal English. One or more additional European languages are highly valued


**About MongoDB**
 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
   

  

 With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
   

  

 Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
   

  

 To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
   

  

 MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
   

  

 MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

title: Cybersäkerhetskonsult
description:
Vi på Atea i Stockholm söker engagerade och erfarna cybersäkerhetskonsulter för att stärka vårt team. Vill du forma framtidens digitala samhälle och ständigt utvecklas genom spännande och komplexa kundprojekt? Våra kunder har ett stort behov av säkra och innovativa it-lösningar, och vi behöver din expertis. Då kan det här vara det perfekta nästa steget för dig!
   

  

**Din roll**
 Våra kunder genomgår en digital förändringsresa där du som cybersäkerhetskonsult kommer att ha en nyckelroll. Du kommer att arbeta med allt från kravställning, granskning och uppföljning av it-säkerhetslösningar till att leda projekt och säkerställa hög säkerhet i skala. Konsultrollen erbjuder ett varierande arbete, både i längre uppdrag och flera parallella projekt, på egen hand eller i team med andra kollegor.
   

  

**Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter som cybersäkerhetskonsult:**
* Kravställning inom it- och cybersäkerhetsområdet
* Granskning och uppföljning av it-säkerhetslösningar
* Rådgiva och stödja kunder i deras it-säkerhetsarbete
* Omvärldsbevaka it-säkerhetsområdet och utveckla strategier inför framtiden


**Vad rollen erbjuder dig:**
* En dynamisk och inspirerande arbetsmiljö
* Möjlighet att arbeta med utvecklande och komplexa kundprojekt
* Stöd för din personliga och professionella utveckling
* Ett starkt och engagerat team som stöttar varandra


**Vem är du?**
 Vi tror på dig och dina personliga egenskaper, som är viktiga för att lyckas och trivas hos oss. Du är drivande, resultatinriktad, analytisk och lösningsorienterad med lätt för att anpassa dig till nya förhållanden. Du är kommunikativ, skapar goda relationer och har ett affärsmässigt fokus där du verkligen vill bidra med dina kunskaper för att skapa verkligt värde för kunden.
   

  

**För rollen som cybersäkerhetskonsult har du med dig:**
* Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att leda eller driva säkerhetsinitiativ i komplexa it-miljöer
* Djup förståelse för säkerhetsramverk och standarder såsom NIST CSF, CIS Controls, Zero Trust och ISO 27001
* Erfarenhet av säkerhetsgranskningar, riskanalyser, sårbarhetsbedömningar och säkerhetsutredningar
* Erfarenhet av design och implementation av säkerhetslösningar inom nätverk, identitet, klient, server och moln
* God förståelse för säkerhetsarkitektur och säkerhetsprinciper inom moderna hybrid- och molnmiljöer
* Mycket goda kunskaper inom it-infrastruktur, nätverk, Windows, Linux och identitetshantering
* Erfarenhet av att kommunicera säkerhetsrisker och rekommendationer till såväl tekniska team som ledning
* Högskole- eller civilingenjörsexamen eller motsvarande relevant arbetslivserfarenhet
* Flytande svenska och engelska i tal och skrift


**Meriterande:**
* Certifieringar såsom CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CEH, OSCP, Azure Security Engineer Associate, AWS Security Specialty eller GIAC-certifieringar
* Erfarenhet av molnsäkerhet inom Microsoft Azure, AWS eller Google Cloud
* Erfarenhet av säkerhetsövervakning, SIEM, SOC eller threat hunting
* Erfarenhet av säkerhetsarbete inom OT-, industri- eller samhällskritiska miljöer


**Om Atea**
 Visste du att Atea är den ledande leverantören av it-infrastruktur i Norden och Baltikum? I Sverige är vi runt 2700 medarbetare fördelade på 35 kontor runt om i hela landet. Vår styrka ligger i vår kombination av lokal närvaro, vårt omfattande och heltäckande erbjudande samt alla våra specialister. Tillsammans med våra kunder och partners bygger vi Sverige med it och förbättra vardagen för skolbarn, lärare, äldre, sjukvård och näringslivet. Hos oss får du vara en del av världens mest hållbara it-servicebolag, där vi är med och påskyndar omställningen mot en mer hållbar it-värld.
   

  

 På Atea blir du en del av en vardag och en kultur som präglas av framåtanda, laganda och humor. Vi har en vision om att vara "The Place to Be" – en plats där alla växer och trivs, med kollegor som bryr sig om dig, om kunderna och om samhället.
   

  

 Läs mer om våra förmåner:
 **Ateas förmåner | Atea**
**Kontakt & mer information**
 Har du frågor om tjänsten är du varmt välkommen att kontakta Christian Hedén, Konsultchef, via christian.heden@atea.se. Vi hanterar ansökningar löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum, ansök därför redan idag!
   

  

 Som en kvalitativ del i vår rekryteringsprocess genomgår slutkandidater en bakgrundskontroll för att öka kännedomen om dig som vår framtida medarbetare. En anställning hos oss kan innebära placering i säkerhetsklassat uppdrag. Därmed kan en säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll komma att genomföras både före och under anställning.
   

  

**Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!**

title: Full Stack AI Developer (Python/React)
description:
**A Different Kind Of Job Description**
 At Filed, we believe in radical transparency. Everything is open: company finances, team salaries, stock options, anonymous team feedback. That extends to how we talk about this job, so what you'll read here looks a little different from other job ads. It starts with why this is a terrible job. Then it explains why it might be the best career move you'll ever make.
   

  

**Why this is a terrible job**
 This is an incredibly high-paced, high-tempo environment. We're making a generational bet to change all of our lives, and generational bets are not comfortable.
   

  

 You will build agents for subjective workflows. Tax law is objective, but what applies under it and how professionals interpret it is full of judgment. You can give two tax professionals the same task and get two different results where both are right. We're building agentic systems that have to reach their level of accuracy, not a level we decided is good enough. From an engineering standpoint, this is the hardest thing most of us have ever built. At times it will feel like hitting your head against the wall.
   

  

 Customers will sometimes get frustrated, because they expect deterministic results from probabilistic systems, and we're managing the expectations of some of the biggest firms in the world, including the Big Four.
   

  

 And the rhythm is real: we get to the office, we work, we go home and spend time with our families, and then many of us get back online to support our customers in US hours. It's tough. It's relentless.
   

  

**Why it might be the best career choice you'll ever make**
 It's addictive to be part of a business when you know you're winning. Filed is adding millions of dollars of revenue every quarter, customers are signing up in numbers, and in under two years we've become the market leader in a space with entrenched incumbents and a drastic need for new AI tools. When we come into head-to-heads with competitors, we win every time, because our product is superior. And we stay focused and diligent: we only work with tax firms that have the right expectations, which is why our typical customer is mid-market and enterprise.
   

  

 The industry looks boring from the outside, but the problem is unsolved, and the space has been riddled with products below the mark for decades. When you push through the wall, there's a spark of joy: a customer says "wow, this is phenomenal." That keeps happening.
   

  

 The opportunity here is not only to make a great deal of money. It's to have real impact on our mission: making this profession extraordinary. Nobody became a tax professional for the admin. They got into this work to be creative with tax law, to have fun, and to change the fabric of society. Filed enables them to do exactly that.
   

  

 We've raised $17.2 million to date, led by Northzone, and you can read the story in TechCrunch. Our focus now is to deliver the roadmap and continue to win.
   

  

**What You'll Build**
 As a Fullstack AI Developer, you'll build the agentic systems at the heart of Filed:
   

  

* Agentic workflows that mirror how tax professionals actually work, judgment call by judgment call
* Evaluation and verification systems that measure our accuracy against professional standards, not benchmarks we invented for ourselves
* The model integrations and tooling that turn probabilistic systems into something firms trust with high-stakes work


 You'll work at the frontier of applying AI to subjective domains, where two different answers can both be correct, and where shipping means earning the trust of professionals who scrutinize every output.
   

  

**What You'll Be Responsible For**
* Building and maintaining fullstack features across our AI tax prep, planning, and review products
* Owning the UX and backend logic for the workflows tax professionals use every day
* Shipping fast, watching metrics, and deciding what to improve next, without being told
* Making LLMs work for our customers to achieve higher accuracy and transparency
* Keeping the codebase clean, typed, and fast as we scale


**Your Hard Skillset**
* Comfortable in TypeScript, React, and Python: you've built complex, data-heavy UIs and backend services before
* Familiar with cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud and/or Azure
* Bonus if you've worked in fast-paced startups or regulated industries
* Even bigger bonus if you've taken a product from 0 to 1 and watched real users depend on it


**Your Soft Skillset**
* Comfortable being uncomfortable and making calls with incomplete data
* Empathetic and curious: building for the user, not just for clean code
* Highly collaborative across product, engineering, and tax
* Detail-oriented but pragmatic: you know when polish matters and when to ship
* You own your work and welcome the accountability that comes with it


**A championship team**
 We think of ourselves as a sports team. Incredibly high performance, incredibly high standards, and real success to show for it. Being a championship team means working with people who are deeply proud of the work they do and have great fun doing it together.
   

  

 We measure employee happiness constantly, and our eNPS is +60. We don't say that to brag. We say it because a team playing at this tempo only holds together if people genuinely love being on it. Every four months, the whole company comes together for an offsite.
   

  

**What Filed Stands For**
 Not posters. Not corporate language. Real operating standards.
   

  

* No problem is someone else's problem If you see it, it's yours. Bugs, customer confusion, missed expectations, internal friction. We don't pass problems sideways and we don't hide behind roles. You fix the typo even if you didn't write it, jump into a customer issue even if it's not your department, escalate early, and close loops fully. Ownership means you drive resolution, not that you suffer silently or burn out doing everything alone.
* Waiting is not a strategy Momentum is our advantage. We don't wait for perfect information or stall because something is unclear. You ship a V1 instead of debating V5, test instead of theorize, run small experiments instead of requesting big approvals, and propose solutions instead of just naming blockers. Speed is powerful. Sloppiness is not, and recklessness has no place in a high-trust industry.
* We run toward the fire When something breaks, we move. Tax is high-stakes and trust is fragile. We acknowledge issues immediately, communicate clearly and often, prioritize customer-impacting problems fast, and stay on it until it's fully resolved. Firefighting is a strength, not panic, and never an excuse for preventable mistakes.
* We win on customer experience AI will commoditize. Features will copy. Pricing will compress. Experience won't. We respond faster than customers expect, communicate proactively, think like a partner rather than a ticketing system, and anticipate needs before they're raised. Overdelivering means raising the standard of care, not overpromising, hero culture, or burning the team out.


**Who This Suits**
 This is a very fun environment, but it only suits people who meet the criteria we're looking for:
   

  

* People who want to win
* People who have a point to prove
* People who want to write their own job descriptions


**How We Pay**
 Nothing at Filed is behind closed doors. Everyone here sees everyone else's salary, because we believe transparency creates trust, and trust is the foundation of excellent teamwork. Compensation isn't a negotiation. Depending on your location, everyone receives the same three offers, and all of our offers are above market benchmarking.
   

  

 This role is assessed at Level 3 (Mid-Level). The salary and equity bandings are:
   

  

* Most Equity: 68,750 SEK per month + $150,000 of equity
* Great Equity: 75,000 SEK per month + $100,000 of equity
* Good Equity: 81,250 SEK per month + $50,000 of equity


 We run performance reviews every four months. Meet your goals and you can expect to double your equity by the end of your first year.
   

  

 One more thing, in the spirit of transparency: some people who apply for this role will be assessed at a different level. If the team determines your level of responsibility sits differently, we'll adjust the offer accordingly. If you know you're suited to a more senior role, don't shrink to fit. Apply to the Senior Fullstack AI Engineer role instead.
   

  

**Benefits**
* A minimum of 30 days of holiday per year, whether you're in Europe or the US
* In the US: fully covered medical expenses on platinum-level plans, with 100% coverage for your dependents as well
* In Europe: the full set of mandatory benefits, and more on top
* Company-wide offsites every four months


**The process**
* Quick intro call (30 minutes)
* Technical walkthrough and async task (60 minutes)
* Final round with our team (120 minutes)


 In just 3.5 hours, you'll be wanting early access, just like the rest of our team, to get into the stack and start building a generational company, even before your first day.
   

  

**About Filed**
**Filed is the AI tax preparer trusted by America's accounting firms.**
 Taxes might seem boring, but they are the $5 trillion backbone of the US economy. Globally, nearly $15 trillion in taxes is collected every year. Behind every dollar of it sits a professional making judgment calls, and the industry that does this work is breaking under a talent shortage no one has solved. We're fixing it. Today, hundreds of firms run Filed inside the systems they already use, and we're backed by Northzone, Neo, Analog, and Raine.
   

  

 There has never been a more exciting time to work on a problem this complex. Join us while "I was there when it all started" is still true.

title: Utvecklare Dynamics 365 CE
description:

 Tjänsten är en direktrekrytering så anställningen blir direkt hos vår kund i Stockholm
 



  





**Dina arbetsuppgifter** 




 Som utvecklare inom Dynamics 365 CE kommer du att arbeta med utveckling, anpassning och vidareutveckling av organisationens CRM-plattform. Plattformen används inom flera verksamhetsområden och är en central del av den digitala kundupplevelsen.
 



  





*I rollen kommer du bland annat att:* 



* Utveckla och konfigurera lösningar i Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE)

* Utveckla och optimera integrationer mellan Dynamics 365 och andra interna system

* Samarbeta nära utvecklare, arkitekter, testare, Scrum Masters och produktägare i agila team
* Bidra till kontinuerliga förbättringar av arbetssätt, arkitektur och tekniska lösningar



  





 Arbetet sker i hybridform med möjlighet att kombinera arbete från kontor och på distans.
 



  





**Din profil** 




 Vi söker dig som är en nyfiken och lösningsorienterad person med ett genuint intresse för teknik och utveckling. Du trivs i en föränderlig miljö där du får möjlighet att lära dig nytt, ta ansvar och bidra med egna idéer.
 



  





 Du har lätt för att samarbeta med andra, kommunicerar tydligt och delar gärna med dig av din kunskap. Samtidigt arbetar du strukturerat och har förmågan att driva ditt arbete framåt på ett självständigt sätt.
 



  





 Vi tror att du motiveras av att utveckla både tekniska lösningar och arbetssätt, och uppskattar att arbeta i en kultur som präglas av öppenhet, samarbete och ständig utveckling.
 



  





*Krav* 



* Flera års erfarenhet av utveckling och förvaltning inom Dynamics 365 CE
* Erfarenhet av arbete med Power Platform
* God förståelse för Dynamics 365 CE-plattformens möjligheter och begränsningar
* Erfarenhet av integrationsutveckling, exempelvis via API:er eller Azure-tjänster
* Erfarenhet av eller intresse för utveckling inom .NET/C#
* Erfarenhet av arbete i komplexa IT-miljöer
* Förmåga att arbeta i en verksamhet med hög förändringstakt
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift



  





*Meriterande* 



* Erfarenhet av Scrum Master-rollen
* Erfarenhet av Azure-baserade integrationslösningar

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
**YOUR MISSION AT VOI**
 You will be joining a team focused on predicting the near-future demand for our vehicles. Specifically, where and when they will be needed, and how to handle this at scale for a fleet of 150 thousand vehicles spread across over more than 100 cities. This is a complex and meaningful problem from both an analytical as well as an engineering perspective, and you'll be handed ambiguous, high-leverage problems and are expected to reason from first principles about what to build — not a spec to implement.
   

  

 As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer at Voi, you'll work closely with a small, cross-functional team to design, build and maintain machine learning models. You will work on problems where you will get to utilize your skills in such interrelated disciplines as machine learning, AI engineering, software engineering, data science, optimization as well as data engineering.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities Will Include**
* Own and contribute to end-to-end machine learning and AI projects, in close collaboration with business stakeholders, and the rest of your team
* Formulating solution hypotheses, defining data requirements, prototyping, implementing in production, and continuously monitoring model health and business impact
* Maintain and improve Voi's machine learning platform to ensure our machine learning products adhere to state-of-the-art MLOps standards, with support from the team
* Work with colleagues to improve team processes and support mutual learning and knowledge sharing


**What You Need To Embark**
 We’re looking for a Machine Learning professional with experience from a fast-paced environment. In addition to being fluent in English, we believe the right person has:
   

  

* A clear focus on business value and user impact
* A strong analytical mindset, and comfortable setting up simplified first-principles models for complex problems, built on well-thought-through assumptions
* Forward-leaning attitude towards LLM-based and agentic approaches: you explore new AI tooling before it’s obviously the standard, and pair that curiosity with strong Python and software engineering fundamentals
* Experience contributing to projects from start to finish, from understanding business challenges to planning, building, launching and following up on results
* Hands-on experience with real-time inference and/or MLOps in one of the major cloud environments
* Experience writing production-quality, maintainable software
* Higher education in one of the mathematical sciences such as computer science, mathematics, physics, bioinformatics or with a similar data-centric degree


*Don’t meet every requirement? If you are excited about this role and our mission, and have relevant, transferable skills, we encourage you to apply – even if you don’t check every box.*
**WHY VOI?**
 Working At Voi Is More Than Just a Job; Our People Promise Includes a Personal Voyage Where You Will Grow As a Professional And Be a Part Of a Team And Culture That Builds Something Meaningful For Society. In Addition To This You’ll Have The Opportunity To
   

  

* Join Europe’s #1 micromobility operator and one of the fastest growing scale-ups
* Get “skin in the game” through our employee options programme
* Enjoy unlimited free Voi rides and a dog-friendly office
* Work together with inspiring, motivated and fun colleagues towards a common goal
* Join the micromobility revolution and be a part of creating sustainable cities made for living, free from noise and pollution


 Since 2018,
 **Voi** 
 has been on a mission to create safe, sustainable and reliable micromobility for everyone. Today we are the leading shared micromobility operator in Europe, with HQ in Stockholm (Sweden), operating 200,000+ vehicles in 130+ towns and cities across 13 countries, serving 8+ million riders with over 500+ MILLION rides to date, and we have no intention of stopping here! We believe that micromobility will play a central role in changing how people move in our towns and cities in the future and want to ensure that the micromobility transformation happens the right way - through real innovative technology, partnership and transparent dialogue with towns, cities and governments, and by adapting our products to the local needs. In addition to improving quality of life in cities around the world, we are contributing to the solution for climate change by making sustainable transportation options more widely available and promoting renewable energy use and circularity along our supply chain.
   

  

**Diversity Matters**
 As a Voiager, we offer you a friendly, collaborative and fast-paced workplace where you can bring your whole self to work, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability or sexual orientation - and welcome applications from whoever you are, including veterans, those actively serving as a Reservist and their partners. What is most important to us is how you treat others and what skills and value you bring to our team. We believe that having a wide diversity of people with different backgrounds and perspectives within Voi is essential to our success in delivering the best user experience to our equally diverse user base. With employees from over 50 nationalities working within Voi, we believe we have made good progress but know we can still do more - therefore we discourage any photos, personal letters, or disclosure of any information that concerns other information than your professional experience.

 Within Tietoevry,
